seg.abda31761e23.src: Plain answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.
seg.abda31761e23.t: खरीददारें दे सुआलें दे सिद्धे जवाब, शुरूआत घरै च हल्दी पाउडर जांचने दे तरीके कन्नै.
seg.abda31761e23.back: Straight answers to buyers' questions, starting with the way to check turmeric powder at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI दे मानक मताबक हल्दी पाउडर च नां ते उप्परा पाया गेदा कोई रंग होना चाहिदा, लेड क्रोमेट समेत, ते नां गै बाह्रला स्टार्च. इसदी जांच पुस्तिका च दस्सेआ गेदा ऐ जे इंस्पेक्टर हल्दी च के-के जांचदे न: मेटानिल येलो जनेह् पाए दे रंग, लेड साल्ट, ते चाक पाउडर.
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: According to the FSSAI standard, turmeric powder should have neither any colour added from outside, including lead chromate, nor foreign starch. Its testing manual explains what inspectors check in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: इस चा किश चीजां तुस अपनी रसोई च जांची सकदे ओ, ते किश सिर्फ लैब गै फड़ी सकदी ऐ. एह् गाइड दौनें बारै दसदी ऐ, ते दो मशहूर टेस्टें बारै बी जेह्ड़े हल्दी पर कम्म नेईं करदे. एह् जांचां कुसै बी हल्दी पर करो जो तुस खरीददे ओ, साढ़ी बी.
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these things you can check in your own kitchen, and some only a lab can catch. This guide tells about both, and also about two famous tests that do not work on turmeric. Do these checks on any turmeric that you buy, ours too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: हल्दी दी जांच दे बाद पानी दे दो गलास. खब्बे: हल्का पीला पानी, पाउडर थल्लै बैठे दा. सज्जे: गूढ़ा पीला पानी, ते पाउडर थमां थल्लै जंदियां पीलियां लकीरां.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: light yellow water, powder settled at the bottom. Right: dark yellow water, and yellow streaks going down from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧पानी आह्ली जांच⟦/1⟧खब्बे: पाउडर थल्लै बेही गेदा ऐ ते पानी हल्का पीला ऐ. सज्जे: पाउडर दे डुब्बदे होई उस थमां गूढ़ियां पीलियां लकीरां निकलियां, ते पानी गूढ़ा पीला होई गेआ. उसदा लैब टेस्ट करोआना बनदा ऐ.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled at the bottom and the water is light yellow. Right: as the powder sank, dark yellow streaks came out of it, and the water became dark yellow. It deserves to have a lab test done.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: पानी दे गलास उप्पर इक निक्का चमचा हल्दी छिड़को ते बिना हलाए बैठन देओ. हल्दी डुब्बी जंदी ऐ ते पानी हल्का पीला रेही जंदा ऐ; जेकर पानी फौरन गूढ़ा पीला होई जा, तां एह् पाए दे रंगै आह्ली बक्खी इशारा ऐ. एह् जांच लेड क्रोमेट जां चाक नेईं फड़ी सकदी, इस करी पक्के जवाब आस्तै फूड टेस्टिंग लैब बरतो. आयोडीन टेस्ट छोड़ी देओ: हल्दी च शुरू थमां गै स्टार्च होंदा ऐ.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle a small spoon of turmeric on top of a glass of water and let it sit without stirring. Turmeric sinks and the water stays light yellow; if the water immediately turns dark yellow, then this is a sign pointing towards added colour. This check cannot catch lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric has starch from the start.

seg.9b20e15186d4.t: FSSAI हल्दी च के-के जांचदा ऐ

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: जि'यां मेटानिल येलो, जेह्ड़ा फिक्की हल्दी गी होर चमकीली दस्सी सकदा ऐ. FSSAI हल्दी च पाए दे रंगै दी इजाजत नेईं दिंदा.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Like metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not permit added colour in turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: लेड क्रोमेट ते दूए लेड साल्ट
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड क्रोमेट इक पीला रंग ऐ जेह्ड़ा पेंट च बरतोंदा ऐ. 2019 ते 2024 च छपे दे स्टैनफोर्ड दी अगुआई आह्ले अध्ययनें च एह् दक्खनी एशिया दे किश हिस्सें दी हल्दी च लब्भा. FSSAI हल्दी च इसदी बिल्कुल इजाजत नेईं दिंदा.
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour which is used in paint. In Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 it was found in turmeric from some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: इक सस्ता चिट्टा पाउडर जेह्ड़ा भार बधांदा ऐ.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: दूइयें फसलें दा आटा जां स्टार्च. FSSAI दा मानक इसी बी मना करदा ऐ.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. The FSSAI standard forbids this too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: इक पारदर्शी गलास कमरे दे तापमान आह्ले पानी कन्नै भरो.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: उप्पर इक पद्धरा निक्का चमचा हल्दी पाउडर छिड़को. हलाओ नेईं.
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level small spoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: पाउडर डुब्बदे बेल्लै पैह्ला मिंट ध्यान कन्नै दिक्खो. उस थमां थल्लै जंदियां रंगीन लकीरां दिक्खो.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch carefully for the first minute while the powder sinks. Look for coloured streaks going down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: इसी 15 थमां 20 मिंट तगर छोड़ी देओ. फ्ही गलास गी इक चिट्टी कंधा जां कागज दे सफे दे सामनै फड़ो ते बैठे दे पाउडर दे उप्पर पानी गी दिक्खो.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Light yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.t: पाए दे रंगै दा कोई नशान नेईं.

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गूढ़ियां पीलियां लकीरां, जां किश मिंटें च गूढ़ा पीला पानी
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Dark yellow streaks, or dark yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: होई सकदा ऐ रंग पाया गेदा होऐ. उस बैच दा बरतना बंद करो ते उसदा टेस्ट करोआओ.
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧एह् कीं कम्म करदा ऐ.⟦/1⟧ हल्दी दा अपना पीला रंग, करक्यूमिन, पानी च मुश्कल्लें घुलदा ऐ, इस करी पाउडर डुब्बी जंदा ऐ ते पानी गी बस हल्का रंगदा ऐ. मेटानिल येलो जनेह् रंग सौखे घुली जंदे न ते पानी गी झट्ट रंगी दिंदे न.
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, dissolves in water with difficulty, so the powder sinks and only lightly colours the water. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧एह् के नेईं फड़दा.⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट ते चाक बी पानी च नेईं घुलदे, इस करी इंदे कन्नै रलाई दी हल्दी इस जांच च पास होई सकदी ऐ. सिर्फ लैब टेस्ट गै पक्का दस्सी सकदा ऐ जे एह् इस च नेईं न.
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this does not catch.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can tell for sure that these are not in it.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: बड़ा बारीक पाउडर किश चिर पानी गी धुंधला रक्खी सकदा ऐ. धुंधला होना ठीक ऐ; दिक्खना एह् ऐ जे पानी साफ ते गूढ़ा पीला ते नेईं.
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for some time. Being cloudy is fine; what to see is whether the water is clear and dark yellow.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: जांच 2: जेकर तुस साबत हल्दी खरीददे ओ
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: सुक्की हल्दी दी इक गंढ गी अद्धे च तोड़ो. हल्दी अंदर तगर पीली-संतरी होंदी ऐ, इस करी अंदरला हिस्सा बाह्रले आंह्गर गै लब्भना चाहिदा. फिक्के जां मद्धम अंदरले हिस्से उप्पर चमकीली पीली छिल्ल दा मतलब होई सकदा ऐ जे उप्परले पासे रंग पाया गेआ. बेचने आह्ले कोला इस बारै पुच्छो, जां टेस्ट करोआओ.
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a knob of dry turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through to the inside, so the inner part should look the same as the outer. A bright yellow skin over a dull or faint inner part can mean that colour was added on the outer side. Ask the seller about this, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: स्टार्च कन्नै मिलने पर आयोडीन नीला-काला होई जंदा ऐ, ते हल्दी च आटा फड़ने आस्तै अक्सर इसदी सलाह् दित्ती जंदी ऐ. पर हल्दी आपूं स्टार्च आह्ली होंदी ऐ, इस करी एह् दौनें सूरतें च नीला-काला होई जंदा ऐ. इस्सै करी FSSAI दी अपनी पुस्तिका आयोडीन टेस्ट हल्दी गी छोड़ियै दूए पिस्से दे मसालें आस्तै बरतदी ऐ.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: On meeting starch iodine turns blue-black, and it is often advised for catching flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself is starchy, so it turns blue-black in both cases. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हल्दी च लेड, मेटानिल येलो ते चाक आस्तै FSSAI दे टेस्टें च गाढ़ा हाइड्रोक्लोरिक जां सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड बरतोंदा ऐ. एह् एसिड चमड़ी ते अक्खीं गी साड़ी दिंदे न. एह् लैब दी चीज न, रसोई दी नेईं.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. These are lab things, not kitchen things.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: पक्के जवाब आस्तै: फूड टेस्टिंग लैब
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL-मान्यता आह्ली फूड टेस्टिंग लैब हल्दी च लेड ते पाए दे रंगें दा टेस्ट करी सकदी ऐ. लैब कोला पुच्छो जे कितना नमूना चाहिदा, पाउडर गी उसदे बंद पैक च जां साफ बंद थैली च रक्खो, ते पैक पर छपे दा बैच नंबर लिखी लैओ. FSSAI अपनी वेबसाइट पर अधिसूचित फूड टेस्टिंग लैबें दी लिस्ट छापदा ऐ.
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the lab how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed pack or in a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI लाइसेंस जां रजिस्ट्रेशन नंबर. तुस इसी FSSAI दी FoSCoS वेबसाइट पर दिक्खी सकदे ओ.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: जिसने इसी बनाया जां पैक कीता, उसदा नां ते पता.
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: कुल मात्रा, MRP, बैच जां लाट नंबर, ते बेस्ट-बिफोर तरीक.
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Total quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: एह् कुत्थें उगाई गेई. बक्ख-बक्ख इलाकें दी हल्दी दा रंग बक्ख होंदा ऐ, इस करी इलाके दा नां होने कन्नै तुस इक जनेही चीजें दी तुलना करी सकदे ओ.
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions has different colour, so having the region's name lets you compare similar things.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पैक दी जिप बंद रक्खो, जां पाउडर गी सुक्के, हवाबंद डब्बे च पाई देओ.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or put the powder in a dry, airtight box.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: सुक्का चमचा बरतो. सिल्ला चमचा गै हल्दी च डले बनांदा ऐ.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes lumps in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: इसी सिद्धी धुप्पै शा दूर रक्खो, जेह्ड़ी रंग फिक्का करदी ऐ.
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep it away from direct sunlight, which fades the colour.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: के बड़ी चमकीली पीली हल्दी माड़ा नशान ऐ?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: अपने आप च नेईं. रंग किस्म, उगाने दी थाह्र, ते इसी कि'यां सुकाया ते पीसेआ गेआ, इस पर बदलदा ऐ, इस करी हल्दियें च मता फर्क होंदा ऐ. ध्यान इस गल्लै दा रक्खो जे रंग पाउडर गी बड़ा सौखा ते नेईं छोड़ी दिंदा, जि'यां पानी आह्ली जांच च.
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by itself. The colour changes with variety, growing place, and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. Watch whether the colour leaves the powder very easily, as in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: के पानी आह्ली जांच दस्सी सकदी ऐ जे हल्दी च लेड नेईं ऐ?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check tell that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: नेईं. लेड क्रोमेट पानी च नेईं घुलदा, इस करी पानी आह्ली जांच उसी नेईं दिक्खी सकदी. सिर्फ लैब टेस्ट गै दिक्खी सकदा ऐ.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can see it.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.t: हल्दी च डले कीं बनी जंदे न?
seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: नमी. गिल्ला चमचा जां खुल्ला पैक पाउडर गी पानी खिच्चन दिंदा ऐ. डलें गी सुक्के चमचे कन्नै तोड़ो ते पैक बंद रक्खो.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder pull in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: जेकर कोई जांच ठीक नेईं लग्गै तां के करां?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: If some check does not seem right, what should I do?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: उस बैच दा बरतना बंद करो, पैक संभाली रक्खो, ते बैच नंबर कन्नै बेचने आह्ले कन्नै गल्ल करो. तुस FSSAI गी उसदे Food Safety Connect ऐप राहें बी शकैत करी सकदे ओ. जेकर एह् साढ़ी ऐ, तां असें गी पैक ते गलास दी फोटो WhatsApp करो.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack aside, and talk to the seller with the batch number. You can also complain to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: एह् जांचां साढ़ी हल्दी पर बी करो. जेकर किश बी ठीक नेईं लग्गै, तां पैक परा बैच नंबर कन्नै इक फोटो ⟦1⟧असें गी WhatsApp करो⟦/1⟧.
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these checks on our turmeric too. If anything does not seem right, then ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: कोडी कूरा ओह् चिकन करी ऐ जेह्ड़ी ऐतवार दी दपैह्रीं आंध्र दे घरें च बनदी ऐ: हड्डी आह्ला चिकन मिर्च ते हल्दी च लपेटियै रक्खेआ जंदा ऐ, गूढ़े सुनैह्री प्याज ते टमाटरें दी ग्रेवी च रिज्झदा ऐ, ते अखीर च गरम मसाला पांदा ऐ. एह् गर्म चौलें कन्नै मेज पर औंदी ऐ, ते बची दी करी रातीं डोसा जां चपाती कन्नै खाई जंदी ऐ.
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi kura is that chicken curry which is made on Sunday afternoon in Andhra homes: bone-in chicken is kept coated in chilli and turmeric, simmers in a gravy of deep golden onions and tomatoes, and at the end garam masala is added. It comes to the table with hot rice, and the leftover curry is eaten at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: इस च तिखास साढ़े तेजा मिर्च पाउडर थमां औंदी ऐ, गुंटूर दी ओह् बड़ी तेज़ मिर्च जेह्ड़ी आंध्र दियें करियें गी उंदा तिक्खापन ते चमकदा लाल रंग दिंदी ऐ, ते मसाले च साढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर बी ऐ. एह् रेसिपी 4 जनें आस्तै ऐ ते सच्चें गै बड़ी तिक्खी ऐ; नुक्तें च दस्सेआ गेदा ऐ जे इसदी तिखास किस चाल्ली घट्ट करनी ऐ.
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: The heat in it comes from our Teja chilli powder, that very hot chilli of Guntur which gives Andhra curries their pungency and bright red colour, and our turmeric powder is also in the masala. This recipe is for 4 people and is truly very hot; the tips tell how to reduce its heat.

seg.6037465ed8d2.src: Total includes 30 minutes for the marinade.
seg.6037465ed8d2.t: कुल समें च मसाला लाइयै रक्खने दे 30 मिंट बी शामल न.
seg.6037465ed8d2.back: The total time also includes 30 minutes of keeping it marinated.

seg.9cb820880217.src: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in a deep-golden onion and tomato gravy. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
seg.9cb820880217.t: चिकन गी दई, तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर ते लूण च लपेटियै रक्खो, फ्ही गूढ़े सुनैह्री प्याज ते टमाटर दी ग्रेवी च पकाओ. अखीर च गरम मसाला ते हरा धनिया पाओ.
seg.9cb820880217.back: Keep the chicken coated in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a gravy of deep golden onion and tomato. At the end add garam masala and green coriander.

seg.d35e8cdc661c.src: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.t: 750 g चिकन ⟦1⟧हड्डी आह्ले, करी आस्तै कट्टे दे टुकड़े, धोइयै पानी चंगी चाल्ली नचोड़ी दा⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.back: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, pieces cut for curry, washed and water squeezed out well⟦/1⟧

seg.c84970cf7b6f.t: ½ कप दई ⟦1⟧गाढ़ा, फेंटियै मुलायम कीता दा⟦/1⟧

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.t: 2 निक्के चमचे तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧बड़ा तिक्खा; दरम्यानी तिखास आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा बरतो⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.t: 1 निक्का चमचा लूण ⟦1⟧अखीर च सुआद मताबक होर⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧more at the end as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧आंध्र च आमतौर पर मूंगफली दा तेल बरतेआ जंदा ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra groundnut oil is usually used⟦/1⟧

seg.de3654151f5d.t: 3 लौंग, 2 हरी लाचियां, 1 इंच दालचीनी दा टुकड़ा ⟦1⟧साबत⟦/1⟧
seg.de3654151f5d.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1 inch piece of cinnamon ⟦1⟧whole⟦/1⟧

seg.4a1335d92ae2.t: 2 बड्डे प्याज ⟦1⟧बारीक कट्टे दे, तकरीबन 2 कप⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 कप गर्म पानी ⟦1⟧पतली ग्रेवी आस्तै थोढ़ा होर⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.0dbf0d0a9f88.t: 2 बड्डे चमचे कट्टे दा हरा धनिया

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.t: ⟦1⟧सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर⟦/1⟧ कन्नै बी बधिया बनदी ऐ.
seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: It also turns out excellent with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: चिकन पर दई, तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर ते लूण मलो. 30 मिंट रक्खी देओ. जेकर तुंदी रसोई गर्म ऐ तां बर्तन ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt onto the chicken. Leave it for 30 minutes. If your kitchen is hot then cover the vessel and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: इक भारी पतीले जां कड़ाही च मध्धम अग्गी पर तेल गर्म करो. लौंग, लाचियां ते दालचीनी पाओ ते किश सकिंटें तगर चटकन देओ.
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil in a heavy pot or kadai on medium flame. Add cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them crackle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: प्याज, हरी मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता पाओ.
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onions, green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: प्याजें गी तेलै च गूढ़े सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो. मध्धम अग्गी पर इस च 12–15 मिंट लगदे न; बार-बार हलांदे रवो तां जे ओह् बिना सड़े इक बरोबर भूरे होन.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onions in the oil until deep golden. On medium flame this takes 12–15 minutes; keep stirring again and again so that they brown evenly without burning.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: अदरक-लसन दा पेस्ट पाओ, फ्ही टमाटर, ते नरम होने तगर पकाओ. पेस्ट गी 1 मिंट भुन्नो जिच्चर कच्ची बास्सना नेईं चली जंदी, फ्ही टमाटरें गी 5–6 मिंट दबांदे होई पकाओ, जिच्चर ओह् गली नेईं जंदे ते कंढें पर तेल नेईं लब्भन लगदा.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook until soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes away, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes while pressing them, until they melt and oil starts to show at the edges.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.t: धनिया पाउडर पाइयै हलाओ ते 30 सकिंट भुन्नो.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry for 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: चिकन पाओ ते मध्धम अग्गी पर ढक्कियै पकाओ जिच्चर हड्डी कोल कोई गुलाबीपन नेईं बचदा. पैह्ले 5 मिंट बिना ढक्के भुन्नो जिच्चर टुकड़ें दा रंग बदलियै ओह् अपारदर्शी नेईं होई जंदे, फ्ही गर्म पानी पाओ, ढक्की देओ ते तकरीबन 20 मिंट पकाओ, बिच-बिच च हलांदे होई.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium flame until no pinkness remains near the bone. First fry uncovered for 5 minutes until the pieces change colour and become opaque, then add hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring in between.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: इक मोटा टुकड़ा जांचो: चिकन तां पक्का ऐ जिसलै हड्डी कोल कोई गुलाबीपन नेईं बचदा ते रस साफ निकलदा ऐ. ग्रेवी चक्खो ते लोड़ होऐ तां लूण पाओ.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Check a thick piece: the chicken is done when no pinkness remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: गरम मसाला ते हरा धनिया पाइयै हलाओ. 3 मिंट बिना ढक्के मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ, जिच्चर ग्रेवी तुंदी पसंद मताबक गाढ़ी नेईं होई जंदी ते उप्पर तेलै दी लाल परत नेईं तरन लगदी.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Add garam masala and green coriander and stir. Let it simmer slowly uncovered for 3 minutes, until the gravy becomes thick as per your liking and a red layer of oil starts to float on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: अग्ग बंद करो ते परोसने शा पैह्लें करी गी 10 मिंट रक्खी देओ; ग्रेवी टिकी जंदी ऐ ते सुआद रली जंदा ऐ.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the flame and leave the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour blends.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: प्याजें गी गूढ़ा सुनैह्री भुन्नो; ग्रेवी दा रंग ते गाढ़ापन उंदे थमां गै औंदा ऐ.
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the onions deep golden; the colour and thickness of the gravy come from them alone.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ. दरम्यानी करी आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा बरतो, जां लाल रंग ते हल्की तिखास आस्तै सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर बरतो.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour and mild heat use Sannam chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: हड्डी आह्ले टुकड़े बरतो; हड्डियां ग्रेवी गी गैह्राई दिंदियां न.
seg.57940a63282d.back: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give depth to the gravy.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: चिकन पाने शा पैह्लें टमाटर मसाले चा तेल बक्खरा होन देओ, नेईं तां ग्रेवी कच्ची लगदी ऐ.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Before adding the chicken let the oil separate from the tomato masala, otherwise the gravy tastes raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: कोब्बरी कोडी कूरा: 3 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीते दे नारियल गी 1 बड्डे चमचे खसखस ते थोढ़े पानी कन्नै पीसो, ते होर गाढ़ी ग्रेवी आस्तै एह् पेस्ट गरम मसाले कन्नै गै पाइयै हलाओ.
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut with 1 tablespoon poppy seeds and a little water, and for a thicker gravy add this paste along with the garam masala and stir.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: पीसेआ दा मसाला: 1 बड्डा चमचा साबत धनिया, 1 निक्का चमचा सौंफ, 3 लौंग ते दालचीनी दा इक निक्का टुकड़ा बिना तेलै दे भुन्नो, पीसो, ते धनिया पाउडर ते गरम मसाले दी थाह्र बरतो.
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast without oil 1 tablespoon whole coriander, 1 teaspoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use in place of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: प्रेशर कुकर: चिकन ते पानी पाने दे बाद 2 सीटियां लाओ ते प्रेशर अपने आप उतरन देओ.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water, take 2 whistles and let the pressure release on its own.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: गर्म-गर्म उबले दे चौलें ते इक चमचा घ्यो कन्नै परोसो, ऐतवार आह्ले तरीके कन्नै. चपाती, डोसा जां रागी संगटि कन्नै बी बधिया लगदी ऐ.
seg.8b4376996905.back: Serve with piping hot boiled rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also tastes excellent with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: ढक्कियै फ्रिज च 2 दिनें तगर रक्खो; दबारा गर्म करदे बेल्लै अंदर तगर भाप निकलने तगर गर्म करो. अगले दिन करी दा सुआद होर गैह्रा होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; while reheating, heat until steam comes out right through the inside. The next day the curry's flavour becomes even deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: आंध्र चिकन करी गी घट्ट तिक्खा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How to make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर घट्ट करियै 1 निक्का चमचा करी देओ, जां सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर बरतो, जेह्ड़ा उऐ लाल रंग हल्की तिखास कन्नै दिंदा ऐ. अखीर च इक चमचा दई रलाने कन्नै बी तिक्खापन घट्ट होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce the Teja chilli powder to 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with mild heat. Mixing in a spoon of curd at the end also reduces the pungency.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: आंध्र चिकन करी इन्नी तिक्खी कीं होंदी ऐ?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: आंध्र दे खाने च तेजा जनेहियां गुंटूर मिर्चां बरतियां जंदियां न, जेह्ड़ियां मते दूए इलाकें दियें करियें च बरतोने आह्ले मिर्च पाउडर शा कुतै मतियां तिक्खियां होंदियां न. तिखास इस पकवान दा हिस्सा ऐ.
seg.ada87f188506.back: In Andhra food, Guntur chillies like Teja are used, which are far hotter than the chilli powder used in the curries of many other regions. The heat is part of this dish.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: मिगी कि'यां पता लग्गै जे चिकन अंदर तगर पक्की गेआ ऐ?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How do I know that the chicken has cooked through to the inside?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: हड्डी कोल सारें शा मोटे टुकड़े गी कट्टियै दिक्खो. चिकन तां पक्का ऐ जिसलै हड्डी कोल कोई गुलाबीपन नेईं बचदा ते रस साफ निकलदा ऐ.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut and look at the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is done when no pinkness remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: के अ'ऊं दई दे बगैर कोडी कूरा बनाई सकनां?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can I make kodi kura without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: हां. चिकन गी मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, लूण ते 1 बड्डे चमचे निंबू दे रस कन्नै लपेटियै रक्खो, ते ग्रेवी च इक टमाटर होर पाओ.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Keep the chicken coated with chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · आंध्र कोडी कूरा दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. आंध्र दी ऐतवार आह्ली चिकन करी: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ते हल्दी पाउडर च लपेटेआ चिकन, गरम मसाले कन्नै गूढ़ी प्याज-टमाटर ग्रेवी च पकाया दा.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken coated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: आंध्र कोडी कूरा: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.dd8d5de6151e.t: 3 लौंग, 2 हरी लाचियां, 1 इंच दालचीनी दा टुकड़ा
seg.dd8d5de6151e.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1 inch piece of cinnamon

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · बेल्लम पोंगली · गुड़ आह्ला मिट्ठा पोंगल
seg.d04209f30de4.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · sweet pongal with jaggery

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: बेल्लम पोंगली ओह् मिट्ठा पोंगल ऐ जेह्ड़ा तेलुगु घरें च संक्रांति आह्ली सवेर बनदा ऐ: चौल ते भुन्नी दी मूंगी दी दाल बड़ी नरम होने तगर पकाई जंदी ऐ, फ्ही गुड़ कन्नै मिट्ठी कीती जंदी ऐ ते घ्यो कन्नै भरपूर बनाई जंदी ऐ. त्यौहार दे खाने शा पैह्लें इसी नैवेद्यम दे तौर पर चढ़ाया जंदा ऐ, ते मते सारे मंदरें ते शुक्करवार दी पूजाएं च एह् परशाद बी ऐ.
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is that sweet pongal which is made on Sankranti morning in Telugu homes: rice and roasted moong dal are cooked until very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and made rich with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festival meal, and it is also prasad in many temples and Friday pujas.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: गन्ने दा गुड़ इसी हल्का भूरा रंग ते टॉफी जनेही गोल-मटोल मिठास दिंदा ऐ, ते साढ़े जीडिपप्पु पैक दे घ्यो च तले दे साबत काजू कुरकुरापन जोड़दे न. एह् रेसिपी 4 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.17053455adbb.back: Sugarcane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a toffee-like rounded sweetness, and the whole cashews fried in ghee from our jeedipappu pack add crunch. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: पकाने दा समां प्रेशर कुकर दा ऐ; पतीले च तकरीबन 15 मिंट होर लगदे न.
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is for the pressure cooker; in a pot it takes about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: भुन्नी दी मूंगी दी दाल ते चौलें गी बड़ा नरम होने तगर पकाओ, पिघलेआ दा गन्ने दा गुड़ रलाओ ते चमकदार होने तगर मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ. अखीर च घ्यो च तले दे काजू, किशमिश ते लाची पाओ.
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook the roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, mix in melted sugarcane jaggery and let it simmer slowly until glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ कप मूंगी दी दाल ⟦1⟧छिल्के बिना पीली मूंगी दी दाल (पेसरपप्पु), तकरीबन 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧skinless yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 कप कद्दूकस कीता दा गन्ने दा गुड़ ⟦1⟧हल्का दबाइयै भरेआ, तकरीबन 150 g; जेकर होर मिट्ठा पसंद ऐ तां थोढ़ा होर⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed and filled, about 150 g; if you like it sweeter then a little more⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧for melting the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: इक चुटकी खाने आह्ला कपूर (पच्चा कर्पूरम) ⟦1⟧मर्जी मताबक; बड़ी निक्की चुटकी⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpuram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.b1655e025b6c.t: इसी ⟦1⟧ताड़ दे गुड़⟦/1⟧ कन्नै मिट्ठा करो.

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: मूंगी दी दाल गी हल्का सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो, फ्ही चौलें कन्नै बड़ा नरम ते गुलगुला होने तगर पकाओ. शुरू च दाल गी प्रेशर कुकर जां भारी थल्ले आह्ले पतीले च मट्ठी अग्गी पर बिना तेलै दे हलांदे होई भुन्नो, जिच्चर उदे चा मेवे आह्ली खुशबो नेईं औन लगदी ते ओह् हल्की सुनैह्री नेईं होई जंदी, तकरीबन 3–4 मिंट.
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast the moong dal until light golden, then cook with the rice until very soft and mushy. At first roast the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low flame without oil, stirring, until a nutty aroma starts coming from it and it becomes light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: भुन्नी दी दाल च चौल पाओ, दोनें गी इक्कठे 2–3 बारी पानी बदलियै धोओ, ते पानी कड्ढी देओ.
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add rice to the roasted dal, wash both together changing the water 2–3 times, and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 कप पानी पाओ. मध्धम अग्गी पर 4–5 सीटियां लाओ ते प्रेशर अपने आप उतरन देओ, जां पतीले च ढक्कियै 25–30 मिंट मट्ठा-मट्ठा पकाओ, ते जेकर सुक्कन लग्गै तां थोढ़ा गर्म पानी पाओ.
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. On medium flame take 4–5 whistles and let the pressure release on its own, or cook slowly covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, and if it starts drying add a little hot water.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: खोलो ते चौल ते दाल गी कड़छी दी पिट्ठ कन्नै हल्का मसलो. एह् नरम ते दलिये आंगर होना चाहिदा ऐ, सुक्का नेईं.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and lightly mash the rice and dal with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: गुड़ गी ¼ कप पानी च पिघलाओ ते चौलें च पाओ. गुड़ ते पानी गी इक निक्के पैन च मट्ठी अग्गी पर हलांदे होई बस घुलने तगर गर्म करो, तकरीबन 2–3 मिंट; इसी उबालने दी लोड़ नेईं.
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and add to the rice. Heat the jaggery and water in a small pan on low flame while stirring just until dissolved, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to be boiled.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: गाढ़ा ते चमकदार होने तगर हलांदे होई मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ, 5–7 मिंट; 2 बड्डे चमचे घ्यो रलाओ. अग्ग मट्ठी रक्खो ते थल्ले तगर हलांदे रवो, कीजे गुड़ पाने दे बाद पोंगली झट्ट थल्ले लग्गी जंदी ऐ.
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Let it simmer slowly while stirring until thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; mix in 2 tablespoons ghee. Keep the flame low and keep stirring to the bottom, because after adding jaggery the pongali quickly sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: चक्खो, ते जेकर होर मिट्ठी चाहिदी ऐ तां थोढ़ा होर पिघलेआ दा गुड़ रलाओ.
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want it sweeter then mix in a little more melted jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: काजुएं गी बचे दे घ्यो च तलो; लाची कन्नै पाओ. बचे दे 2 बड्डे चमचे घ्यो इक निक्के पैन च मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर गर्म करो ते काजुएं गी सुनैह्री होने तगर हलाओ, तकरीबन 1 मिंट, ते अखीरी किश सकिंटें च किशमिश पाओ जिच्चर ओह् फुल्ली नेईं जंदियां.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry the cashews in the remaining ghee; add with cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee in a small pan on medium-low flame and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, and in the last few seconds add the raisins until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: काजू, किशमिश ते घ्यो पोंगली पर पाओ, लाची पाउडर ते, जेकर बरता करदे ओ तां, कपूर छिड़को, ते चंगी चाल्ली हलाओ.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and, if you are using it, camphor, and stir well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: अग्ग बंद करो ते गर्म परोसो. पेदा रेहने पर पोंगली गाढ़ी होई जंदी ऐ; लोड़ होऐ तां किश चमचे गर्म पानी पाइयै पतली करो.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the flame and serve hot. On standing the pongali becomes thick; if needed thin it by adding a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: चौल ते दाल पूरी चाल्ली नरम पकाओ; गुड़ पाने दे बाद ओह् होर नरम नेईं होंदे.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; after adding jaggery they do not become any softer.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: मूंगी दी दाल भुन्नने कन्नै पोंगली च मेवे आह्ली खुशबो औंदी ऐ; अग्ग मट्ठी रक्खो तां जे ओह् सुनैह्री होऐ, भूरी नेईं.
seg.c5408f916731.back: Roasting the moong dal brings a nutty aroma to the pongali; keep the flame low so that it turns golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: भारी थल्ले आह्ला पैन बरतो ते गुड़ पाने दे बाद हलांदे रवो; एह् झट्ट थल्ले लग्गियै सड़ी जंदा ऐ.
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring after adding jaggery; it quickly sticks to the bottom and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: पोंगली गी अग्गी परा उसलै गै लाही लैओ जिसलै ओह् अजें थोढ़ी पतली होऐ; ठंडी होने पर ओह् जम्मी जंदी ऐ.
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the fire right when it is still a little thin; on cooling it sets.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: ताड़ दा गुड़: उन्ना गै कद्दूकस कीता दा ताड़ दा गुड़ बरतो; पोंगली गूढ़े रंगै दी बनग ते मिठास होर गैह्री ते धूंएं आह्ली होग.
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the pongali will be darker in colour and the sweetness deeper and smoky.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: चक्केरा पोंगली: गुड़ दी थाह्र ¾ कप चीनी बरतो; फिक्के रंगै दी, चीनी आह्ली मिठास आह्ली पोंगली बनग.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of jaggery; it will make a pale-coloured pongali with sugary sweetness.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: संक्रांति आह्ली सवेर इसी नैवेद्यम दे तौर पर चढ़ाओ, फ्ही त्यौहार दे खाने कन्नै पुलिहोरा ते गारेलु दे नाल गर्म परोसो.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: On Sankranti morning offer it as naivedyam, then serve hot with the festival meal along with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: बची दी पोंगली ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. परोसने शा पैह्लें थोढ़ा गर्म पानी ते थोढ़ा घ्यो पाइयै हलांदे होई गर्म करो.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Keep leftover pongali covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving, heat it while stirring with a little hot water and a little ghee added.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: पोंगली ते चक्केरा पोंगली च के फर्क ऐ?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: सिर्फ पोंगली दा मतलब अक्सर काली मिर्च ते जीरे कन्नै बनने आह्ली नमकीन पोंगली होंदा ऐ. चक्केरा पोंगली ते बेल्लम पोंगली मिट्ठियां किस्मां न, जेह्ड़ियां चीनी जां गुड़ कन्नै बनदियां न.
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Just pongali often means the salty pongali made with black pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are sweet varieties, which are made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: के अ'ऊं बेल्लम पोंगली प्रेशर कुकर च बनाई सकनां?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: हां. भुन्नी दी दाल ते चौलें गी 3 कप पानी कन्नै 4–5 सीटियां लाइयै पकाओ, प्रेशर अपने आप उतरन देओ, फ्ही पिघलेआ दा गुड़ पाइयै खुल्ले कुकर च मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ.
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure release on its own, then add the melted jaggery and let it simmer slowly in the open cooker.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: ठंडी होने पर मेरी पोंगली सख्त कीं होई गेई?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard on cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: ठंडी होने पर पोंगली जम्मी जंदी ऐ, ते गुड़ पाने दे बाद मता चिर रिज्झने कन्नै ओह् होर सख्त होई जंदी ऐ. इसी उसलै गै लाही लैओ जिसलै ओह् अजें थोढ़ी पतली होऐ, ते बची दी पोंगली गी गर्म पानी कन्नै पतली करो.
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: Pongali sets on cooling, and simmering for a long time after adding jaggery makes it even harder. Take it off right when it is still a little thin, and thin leftover pongali with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: के अ'ऊं पोंगली आस्तै ताड़ दा गुड़ बरती सकनां?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: हां. उन्ना गै कद्दूकस कीता दा ताड़ दा गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) बरतो. पोंगली गूढ़े रंगै दी होई जंदी ऐ ते उसदा सुआद होर गैह्रा ते हल्का धूंएं आह्ला होंदा ऐ.
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The pongali becomes darker in colour and its flavour deeper and lightly smoky.

seg.d63c3cc4eeac.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి · बेल्लम पोंगली दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి. संक्रांति आस्तै बेल्लम पोंगली: चौल ते भुन्नी दी मूंगी दी दाल नरम पकाई दी, गन्ने दे गुड़ कन्नै मिट्ठी कीती दी ते घ्यो च तले दे काजुएं कन्नै सजाई दी. 4 जनें आस्तै.
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery and garnished with cashews fried in ghee. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: बेल्लम पोंगली: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.28c87ea23a5c.t: 1 कप कद्दूकस कीता दा गन्ने दा गुड़

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.t: इक चुटकी खाने आह्ला कपूर (पच्चा कर्पूरम)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpuram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(इमली आह्ली आंध्र मच्छी करी)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra fish curry with tamarind)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: चेपला पुलुसु समुंदरी कंढे आह्ले आंध्र दी इमली आह्ली मच्छी करी ऐ, जेह्ड़ी गोदावरी जिलें च खास ध्यान कन्नै बनदी ऐ: मच्छी दे मोटे टुकड़े प्याज, हरी मिर्चें ते कड़ी पत्ते कन्नै खट्टी, लाल इमली दी ग्रेवी च मट्ठे-मट्ठे रिज्झदे न. एह् ऐतवार दी दपैह्रीं दा खाना ऐ, ते मते घर इसी मिट्टी दी हांडी च बनांदे न ते अगले दिन आस्तै रक्खदे न, जिसलै ग्रेवी मच्छी दे अंदर तगर रची जंदी ऐ.
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, which is made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick pieces of fish simmer slowly in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday afternoon meal, and many homes make it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy soaks right into the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: साढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर मसाले ते ग्रेवी दोनें च पांदा ऐ. सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर पुलुसु गी गूढ़ा लाल रंग ते इक टिकी दी तिखास दिंदा ऐ जेह्ड़ी इमली कन्नै तोल बनांदी ऐ. एह् रेसिपी 4 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes into both the masala and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and a steady heat which makes a balance with the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: त्यारी च मसाला लाइयै रक्खने दे 15 मिंट शामल न. किश घैंटे पेदा रेहने दे बाद करी दा सुआद होर बी बधिया होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: Preparation includes 15 minutes of keeping it marinated. After standing a few hours the curry's flavour becomes even better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: मच्छी गी लूण, हल्दी ते मिर्च पाउडर लाइयै रक्खो, प्याज ते मसाले भुन्नो, उनेंगी इमली दे पानी च उबालो, फ्ही बिना हलाए मच्छी गी ग्रेवी च मट्ठे-मट्ठे रिज्झन देओ.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Keep the fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder applied, fry onion and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then let the fish simmer slowly in the gravy without stirring.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g मच्छी दे टुकड़े ⟦1⟧सख्त मच्छी, मोटे गोल टुकड़ें च कट्टी दी: रोहू (बोचा), कोरमीनु (मरल) जां सुरमई (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish, cut into thick round pieces: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g इमली ⟦1⟧निंबू जिन्नी गोली, 2 कप कोसे पानी च 15 मिंट भिज्जी दी⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ निक्का चमचा हल्दी पाउडर ⟦1⟧¼ निक्का चमचा मसाला लाने आस्तै, ¼ निक्का चमचा ग्रेवी आस्तै⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for marinating, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 बड्डे चमचे सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧1 निक्का चमचा मसाला लाने आस्तै, बाकी ग्रेवी आस्तै⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for marinating, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 निक्का चमचा लूण ⟦1⟧ग्रेवी आस्तै, जां सुआद मताबक⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.t: ⟦1⟧तेजा मिर्च पाउडर⟦/1⟧ कन्नै बी बधिया बनदी ऐ.
seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: It also turns out excellent with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: मच्छी दे टुकड़ें गी पानी च दो-त्रै बारी हल्के हत्थें धोओ ते पानी चंगी चाल्ली नचोड़ी देओ.
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two-three times and squeeze out the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: मच्छी पर लूण, हल्दी ते 1 निक्का चमचा मिर्च पाउडर मलो; 15 मिंट रक्खी देओ. मसाले आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा लूण ते ¼ निक्का चमचा हल्दी पाउडर बरतो.
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder on the fish; leave for 15 minutes. For the masala use 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: भिज्जी दी इमली गी उसदे पानी च चंगी चाल्ली नचोड़ो ते छानी लैओ. तुंदे कोल तकरीबन 2 कप पतला इमली दा पानी होना चाहिदा ऐ.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: इक चौड़े पैन जां मिट्टी दी हांडी च मध्धम अग्गी पर तेल गर्म करो. मेथी दाने, राई ते जीरा पाओ ते तिड़कन देओ, ध्यान रक्खो जे मेथी गूढ़ी नेईं होऐ.
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat oil on medium flame in a wide pan or clay pot. Add fenugreek seeds, mustard and cumin and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: प्याज, मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता तेलै च नरम होने तगर भुन्नो; मसाले दे पाउडर पाओ. प्याजें गी तकरीबन 6–8 मिंट भुन्नो जिच्चर ओह् नरम ते हल्के सुनैह्री नेईं होई जंदे, अदरक-लसन दा पेस्ट ते टमाटर पाइयै 2 मिंट पकाओ, फ्ही बाकी हल्दी पाउडर, बाकी सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ते धनिया पाउडर पाइयै 30 सकिंट हलाओ.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry onions, chillies and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until they become soft and light golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: इमली दा पानी पाओ ते 10 मिंट उबालो जिच्चर तेल उप्पर नेईं आई जंदा. ग्रेवी आस्तै लूण पाओ; इमली दी कच्ची बास्सना चली जानी चाहिदी ऐ ते ग्रेवी थोढ़ी गाढ़ी होनी चाहिदी ऐ.
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Add the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until the oil comes up. Add salt for the gravy; the raw smell of tamarind should go away and the gravy should become a little thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: ग्रेवी चक्खो. एह् साफ तौर पर खट्टी, लूणी ते तिक्खी होनी चाहिदी ऐ, कीजे उसदा किश हिस्सा मच्छी अपने अंदर लेई लैग.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish will take part of it into itself.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: मच्छी हौली-हौली अंदर सरकाओ ते ढक्कियै 10–12 मिंट मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ; बर्तन गी घुमाओ, हलाओ नेईं. टुकड़ें गी इक गै तैह् च रक्खो, उंदे पर चमचे कन्नै ग्रेवी पाओ ते अग्ग मट्ठी रक्खो.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Slide the fish in gently and let it simmer slowly covered for 10–12 minutes; swirl the vessel, do not stir. Keep the pieces in a single layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the flame low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: इक टुकड़े गी सारें शा मोटे हिस्से पर जांचो: मच्छी तां पक्की ऐ जिसलै मास अंदर तगर चिट्टा जां अपारदर्शी होई जा ते सौखा गै हड्डी थमां बक्खरा होई जा.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check one piece at its thickest part: the fish is done when the flesh becomes white or opaque right through to the inside and separates easily from the bone.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: हरा धनिया छिड़को, अग्ग बंद करो ते परोसने शा पैह्लें पुलुसु गी ढक्कियै घट्टोघट्ट 30 मिंट रक्खी देओ.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle green coriander, turn off the flame and keep the pulusu covered for at least 30 minutes before serving.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: हलाने दी थाह्र पैन गी घुमाओ तां जे मच्छी साबत रौह्.
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Instead of stirring, swirl the pan so that the fish stays whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: मोटे टुकड़ें आह्ली सख्त मच्छी चुनो; पतले फिले लम्मे समें तगर रिज्झने कन्नै टुट्टी जंदे न.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose firm fish with thick pieces; thin fillets break from simmering for a long time.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर दरम्यानी तिखास दिंदा ऐ. हल्के पुलुसु आस्तै 1½ बड्डा चमचा बरतो, जां आंध्र दी आम तिखास आस्तै पूरे 2 बड्डे चमचे.
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a mild pulusu use 1½ tablespoons, or for the usual Andhra heat the full 2 tablespoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: मच्छी पाने शा पैह्लें इमली दी ग्रेवी गी चंगी चाल्ली उबालो; मच्छी पाने दे बाद तुस उसी मता चिर नेईं पकाई सकदे, नेईं तां ओह् टुट्टी जंदी ऐ.
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; after adding the fish you cannot cook it for long, otherwise it breaks.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर: होर तिक्खे पुलुसु आस्तै ग्रेवी च सन्नम दी थाह्र 1 बड्डा चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बरतो. तेजा बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ; जेकर पक्का नेईं पता तां 2 निक्के चमचें कन्नै शुरू करो.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu use 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy in place of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if not sure then start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: रोय्याला पुलुसु: 400 g साफ कीते दे झींगे बरतो ते सिर्फ 5–6 मिंट रिज्झन देओ, जिच्चर ओह् गुलाबी होइयै मुड़ी नेईं जंदे.
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and let them simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: मामिडिकाया पुलुसु: गर्मियें च गोदावरी दे घर कच्चे अंब दियां फांकां पांदे न ते इमली घट्ट बरतदे न.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer Godavari homes add raw mango slices and use less tamarind.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: गर्म उबले दे चौलें ते कट्टे दे प्याजें कन्नै परोसो. गोदावरी दे मते घर इसी अगले दिन परोसदे न, जिसलै सुआद टिकी जंदे न.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot boiled rice and chopped onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours settle.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: बची दी करी ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. पैन च बिना हलाए हौली-हौली दबारा गर्म करो.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Keep the leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in a pan without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: चेपला पुलुसु आस्तै केह्ड़ी मच्छी सारें शा बधिया ऐ?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: दरेआ जां समुंदर दी सख्त मच्छी, मोटे टुकड़ें च कट्टी दी: रोहू (बोचा), मरल (कोरमीनु), कतला जां सुरमई. कंडें आह्लियां निक्कियां मच्छियां बी चली जंदियां न पर उनेंगी हौली हत्थें बरतना पौंदा ऐ.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Firm river or sea fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Small bony fish also work but they have to be handled gently.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: चेपला पुलुसु दा सुआद अगले दिन बधिया कीं लगदा ऐ?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: पेदा रेहने कन्नै मच्छी गी इमली ते मिर्चें दी ग्रेवी अपने अंदर लैने दा समां मिलदा ऐ, ते खट्टापन ते तिखास इक बरोबर होई जंदे न. इस्सै करी मते घर इसी सवेरै बनांदे न, रातीं दे खाने जां अगले दिन आस्तै.
seg.566bd302c316.back: By standing, the fish gets time to take the tamarind and chilli gravy into itself, and the sourness and heat become even. That is why many homes make it in the morning, for dinner or the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: करी च मच्छी गी टुट्टने शा कि'यां बचाचै?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: How to save the fish from breaking in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: मोटे टुकड़े बरतो, उनेंगी ग्रेवी उबलने दे बाद गै पाओ, अग्ग मट्ठी रक्खो ते चमचे कन्नै हलाने दी थाह्र पैन गी घुमाओ.
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Use thick pieces, add them only after the gravy boils, keep the flame low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: तकरीबन 40 g, निंबू जिन्नी गोली, 2 कप कोसे पानी च भिज्जी दी. जेकर टमाटर जां कच्चा अंब पांदे ओ तां थोढ़ी घट्ट बरतो.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups lukewarm water. If you add tomato or raw mango then use a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: చేపల పులుసు · आंध्र मच्छी करी दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: చేపల పులుసు. गोदावरी तरीके दी मच्छी करी: प्याज, साढ़ी हल्दी ते सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर कन्नै चटपटी इमली दी ग्रेवी च रिज्झी दी मच्छी. 4 जनें आस्तै, नुक्तें ते सुआल-जवाब कन्नै.
seg.03c44db05afe.back: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onion, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and questions-answers.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु (इमली आह्ली आंध्र मच्छी करी) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra fish curry with tamarind) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6750578e7aac.t: गुंटूर दा मशहूर पकवान · 4 जनें आस्तै

seg.a6f8caae0640.t: गोंगुरा मामसम ⟦1⟧(खट्टे गोंगुरा पत्तें आह्ला मटन)⟦/1⟧
seg.a6f8caae0640.back: Gongura Mamsam ⟦1⟧(mutton with sour gongura leaves)⟦/1⟧

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: गोंगुरा मामसम गोंगुरा कन्नै पकाया दा मटन ऐ; गोंगुरा ओह् खट्टा पत्ता ऐ जिसी आंध्र, ते सारें शा बद्ध गुंटूर, अपना मनदा ऐ. मटन गी मिर्च ते हल्दी कन्नै नरम पकाया जंदा ऐ, फ्ही उस गोंगुरा कन्नै रिज्झाया जंदा ऐ जेह्ड़ा भुन्नी-भुन्नी गूढ़ा, चटपटा पेस्ट बनी गेदा होंदा ऐ, जिच्चर करी गाढ़ी नेईं होई जंदी ते तेल उप्पर नेईं आई जंदा.
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura; gongura is that sour leaf which Andhra, and most of all Guntur, considers its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has become a deep, tangy paste by frying and frying, until the curry becomes thick and the oil comes up.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: गोंगुरा दे तेज़ खट्टेपन दा मकाबला करने आस्तै तगड़ी तिखास चाहिदी ऐ, ते ओह् साढ़े तेजा मिर्च पाउडर थमां औंदी ऐ, गुंटूर दी बड़ी तेज़ मिर्च, कन्नै साढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर बी. चौलें कन्नै 4 जनें आस्तै.
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To match the sharp sourness of gongura, strong heat is needed, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, Guntur's very hot chilli, along with our turmeric powder too. For 4 people with rice.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: मटन गी तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर ते अदरक-लसन दे पेस्ट कन्नै प्रेशर कुकर च पकाओ, फ्ही प्याज दे मसाले ते भुन्ने दे गोंगुरा पत्तें कन्नै गाढ़ा होने तगर ते उप्पर तेल तरने तगर रिज्झन देओ.
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then let it simmer with onion masala and fried gongura leaves until thick and until oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g मटन ⟦1⟧हड्डी आह्ला करी कट, धोइयै पानी नचोड़ी दा⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and water squeezed out⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा पत्ते ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 2 गुच्छे (150 g), डंडियें थमां तोड़े दे, धोइयै पानी चंगी चाल्ली नचोड़ी दा⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), plucked from the stems, washed and water squeezed out well⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 बड्डे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧आमतौर पर मूंगफली दा तेल बरतेआ जंदा ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.back: 4 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: मटन गी प्रेशर कुकर च पाओ, कन्नै तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, अदरक-लसन दा पेस्ट ते लूण, चंगी चाल्ली रलाओ ते 15 मिंट रक्खी देओ.
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the mutton in the pressure cooker, with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: मटन गी तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी, अदरक-लसन दे पेस्ट, लूण ते पानी कन्नै प्रेशर कुकर च पकाओ. 1½ कप पानी पाओ ते मध्धम अग्गी पर 5–6 सीटियां लाओ, फ्ही प्रेशर अपने आप उतरन देओ.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the mutton in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and take 5–6 whistles on medium flame, then let the pressure release on its own.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: कुकर खोलो ते इक टुकड़ा जांचो: मटन तां पक्का ऐ जिसलै ओह् नरम होऐ ते चमचे कन्नै सौखा गै हड्डी थमां बक्खरा होई जा. जेकर नेईं, तां 1–2 सीटियां होर लाओ.
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is soft and separates easily from the bone with a spoon. If not, then take 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: जिच्चर मटन पकदा ऐ, इक पैन च मध्धम अग्गी पर 1 बड्डा चमचा तेल गर्म करो.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the mutton cooks, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan on medium flame.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: गोंगुरा गी हरी मिर्चें कन्नै थोढ़े तेलै च भुन्नो जिच्चर ओह् गली-गली गूढ़ा पेस्ट नेईं बनी जंदा. इस च 8–10 मिंट लगदे न; बार-बार हलाओ ते पत्ते मुरझांदे होई चमचे दी पिट्ठ कन्नै मसलदे रवो.
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with green chillies in a little oil until it melts down into a deep paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir again and again and keep mashing the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: इक भारी कड़ाही च मध्धम अग्गी पर 4 बड्डे चमचे तेल गर्म करो ते लौंग, लाचियां ते दालचीनी पाओ.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 tablespoons oil on medium flame in a heavy kadai and add cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: प्याजें गी साबत मसालें कन्नै सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो. प्याजें कन्नै कड़ी पत्ता बी पाओ, ते बार-बार हलांदे होई 10–12 मिंट देओ.
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onions with the whole spices until golden. Add curry leaves along with the onions too, and give 10–12 minutes stirring again and again.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: धनिया पाउडर पाइयै हलाओ ते 30 सकिंट भुन्नो. मटन ते उसदा शोरबा पाओ, फ्ही गोंगुरा.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: गाढ़ा होने ते उप्पर तेल तरने तगर मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ. अग्ग मट्ठी रक्खो, बिच-बिच च हलाओ, ते 12–15 मिंट देओ. गोंगुरा दा खट्टापन रली जाने दे बाद हुन चक्खियै लूण ठीक करो.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Let it simmer slowly until thick and oil floats on top. Keep the flame low, stir in between, and give 12–15 minutes. After the gongura's sourness has blended, now taste and correct the salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: गरम मसाला पाइयै हलाओ. 2 मिंट होर पकाओ, फ्ही अग्ग बंद करो ते परोसने शा पैह्लें 10 मिंट रक्खी देओ.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Add garam masala and stir. Cook 2 minutes more, then turn off the flame and leave for 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: गोंगुरा पाने दे बाद चक्खो; उसदा खट्टापन हर गुच्छे च बक्खरा होंदा ऐ.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding the gongura; its sourness differs in every bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ. दरम्यानी तिखास आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा बरतो, जां सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर; इसी पूरी चाल्ली नेईं छोड़ो, नेईं तां गोंगुरा फिक्का ते सिर्फ खट्टा लगदा ऐ.
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; do not leave it out entirely, otherwise the gongura tastes flat and only sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
