seg.62683a58a9fd.t: गोंगुरा आस्तै एल्यूमीनियम दा पैन नेईं बरतो; उसदा खट्टापन धातु कन्नै रलियै करी गी काला करी दिंदा ऐ. स्टील जां ढलवें लोहे दा बर्तन बरतो.
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium pan for gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and turns the curry black. Use a steel or cast-iron vessel.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: जेकर गोंगुरा बड़ा खट्टा ऐ, तां तोल बनाने आस्तै मसाले च 1 प्याज होर पाओ.
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, then to make a balance add 1 more onion to the masala.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: गोंगुरा चिकन: 750 g हड्डी आह्ला चिकन बरतो, प्रेशर कुकर नेईं बरतो ते गोंगुरा पाने शा पैह्लें उसी मसाले च ढक्कियै 20–25 मिंट पकाओ, जिच्चर हड्डी कोल कोई गुलाबीपन नेईं बचदा.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, do not use the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes before adding gongura, until no pinkness remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: 500 g साफ कीते दे झींगे बरतो, उनेंगी प्याजें दे बाद पाओ ते 5–6 मिंट पकाओ, बस जिच्चर ओह् गुलाबी होइयै मुड़ी नेईं जंदे, फ्ही गोंगुरा पाओ.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: लाल मिर्च गोंगुरा: 6 सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां गोंगुरा कन्नै भुन्नो ते इक्कठे पीसो; करी होर गूढ़ी ते तेज़ बनग.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dry red chillies with the gongura and grind together; the curry will become deeper and sharper.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: गर्म उबले दे चौलें ते इक चमचा घ्यो कन्नै परोसो, जां जोन्ना रोट्टे (ज्वार दी रोटी) कन्नै. कन्नै इक सादा कच्चा प्याज, एह् गुंटूर दा तरीका ऐ.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve with hot boiled rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte (jowar roti). Alongside a plain raw onion, this is the Guntur way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: ढक्कियै फ्रिज च 3 दिनें तगर रक्खो; दबारा गर्म करदे बेल्लै अंदर तगर भाप निकलने तगर गर्म करो. मतियें खट्टियें करियें आंगर, अगले दिन एह् होर बधिया लगदी ऐ.
seg.a4e072616940.back: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; while reheating, heat until steam comes out right through the inside. Like many sour curries, it tastes even better the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.t: गोंगुरा गी अंग्रेज़ी च के आखदे न?
seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: गोंगुरा गी अंग्रेज़ी च सॉरेल (sorrel) आखदे न, इसी रोज़ेल जां रेड सॉरेल बी आखदे न (मराठी च अंबाडी, हिंदी च पितवा). पत्ते खट्टे होंदे न ते पकियै गूढ़ा पेस्ट बनी जंदे न.
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is called sorrel in English, it is also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and on cooking become a deep paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: के अ'ऊं गोंगुरा पत्तें दी थाह्र गोंगुरा दा अचार बरती सकनां?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can I use gongura pickle in place of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: हां, लोड़ पौने पर. भुन्ने दे पत्तें दी थाह्र 3–4 बड्डे चमचे गोंगुरा दा अचार रलाओ ते लूण ते मिर्च पाउडर घट्ट करो, कीजे अचार च पैह्लें गै दोऐ होंदे न.
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, when needed. In place of fried leaves mix in 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and reduce the salt and chilli powder, because the pickle already has both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: गोंगुरा मामसम आस्तै मटन गी प्रेशर कुकर च किन्ना चिर पकाना चाहिदा ऐ?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long should the mutton be cooked in the pressure cooker for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: हड्डी आह्ले करी कट मटन आस्तै मध्धम अग्गी पर तकरीबन 5–6 सीटियां. मटन तां पक्का ऐ जिसलै मास सौखा गै हड्डी थमां बक्खरा होई जा; बड्डी उमरी दे बकरे दे मटन गी 1–2 सीटियां होर लग्गी सकदियां न.
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For bone-in curry cut mutton about 5–6 whistles on medium flame. The mutton is done when the meat separates easily from the bone; older goat mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: गोंगुरा मटन गी घट्ट तिक्खा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How to make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 निक्का चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बरतो जां उसदी थाह्र सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर पाओ, ते 2 हरी मिर्चां बरतो. किश तिखास रक्खो, कीजे एह् गोंगुरा दे खट्टेपन कन्नै तोल बनांदी ऐ.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or add Sannam chilli powder in its place, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, because it makes a balance with the gongura's sourness.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: గోంగూర మాంసం. गुंटूर तरीके दा गोंगुरा मटन: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ते हल्दी पाउडर कन्नै पकाया दा मटन, फ्ही खट्टे गोंगुरा पत्तें कन्नै गाढ़ा होने तगर रिज्झाया दा.
seg.df5186f8f459.back: గోంగూర మాంసం. Guntur-style gongura mutton: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour gongura leaves until thick.

seg.ba26416f3fd1.t: गोंगुरा मामसम (खट्टे गोंगुरा पत्तें आह्ला मटन) · 1acrefarms
seg.ba26416f3fd1.back: Gongura Mamsam (mutton with sour gongura leaves) · 1acrefarms

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: गोंगुरा मामसम: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.91eb7853c772.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी ⟦1⟧(आंध्र दी गोंगुरा पत्तें दी चटनी)⟦/1⟧

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी ओह् चटनी ऐ जिसदे करी आंध्र सारें शा मता जानेआ जंदा ऐ: खट्टे गोंगुरा पत्ते तेलै च गलने तगर भुन्ने जंदे न ते भुन्ने दे मसालें, लसन ते लाल मिर्च कन्नै पीसे जंदे न. गुंटूर ते पल्नाडु दे आसै-पासै एह् तकरीबन रोज़ मेज पर होंदी ऐ, गर्म चौलें च इक चमचा घ्यो कन्नै रलाइयै, कन्नै कट्टे दा प्याज.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is that chutney for which Andhra is known most of all: sour gongura leaves are fried in oil until melted and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost daily, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with chopped onion alongside.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर इसी गूढ़ा लाल रंग ते ओह् तेज़ तिखास दिंदा ऐ जेह्ड़ी पत्तें दे खट्टेपन दा मकाबला करदी ऐ. इस रेसिपी कन्नै तकरीबन 1½ कप बनदी ऐ, 6 जनें आस्तै काफी.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that sharp heat which matches the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: कुल समें च पीसने शा पैह्लें पत्तें ते मसालें गी ठंडा करने दा समां बी शामल ऐ.
seg.1689d390a49e.back: The total time also includes the time for cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: गोंगुरा पत्तें गी तेलै च भुन्नो जिच्चर ओह् गूढ़ा भुरता नेईं बनी जंदे, फ्ही भुन्ने दे धनिये, मेथी, लसन, तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण कन्नै पीसो. अखीर च राई ते दाल दा तड़का लाओ.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry the gongura leaves in oil until they become a deep mash, then grind with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. At the end temper with mustard and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा पत्ते ⟦1⟧2 बड्डे गुच्छें थमां तोड़े दे, तकरीबन 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧plucked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 बड्डा चमचा तिलें दा तेल ⟦1⟧जिंजली तेल, पत्ते भुन्नने आस्तै⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ निक्का चमचा मेथी दाने ⟦1⟧मेंतुलु; इस शा मते नेईं, नेईं तां पच्चडी कौड़ी होई जंदी ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧mentulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 निक्के चमचे तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧बड़ा तिक्खा; हल्की पच्चडी आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा बरतो⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a mild pachadi use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.7e344ce94138.t: ¾ निक्का चमचा लूण ⟦1⟧जां सुआद मताबक⟦/1⟧
seg.7e344ce94138.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: गोंगुरा पत्तें गी डंडियें थमां तोड़ो ते 2–3 बारी पानी बदलियै धोओ. उनेंगी कप्पड़े पर फलाओ ते पूरी चाल्ली सुक्के होने तगर थपथपाओ; पत्तें पर बचे दा पानी तेलै च छिड़कदा ऐ ते पच्चडी दे टिकने दा समां घट्ट करी दिंदा ऐ.
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pluck the gongura leaves from the stems and wash 2–3 times changing the water. Spread them on a cloth and pat until fully dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and reduces how long the pachadi keeps.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: धनिया, जीरा ते मेथी खुशबो औने तगर भुन्नो; ठंडा होन देओ. मट्ठी अग्गी पर सुक्का पैन बरतो ते लगातार हलांदे रवो: मेथी इक रंग गूढ़ी होनी चाहिदी ऐ, तकरीबन 2 मिंट, पर भूरी नेईं.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander, cumin and fenugreek until aroma comes; let cool. Use a dry pan on low flame and keep stirring continuously: the fenugreek should become one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: गोंगुरा पत्तें गी 1 बड्डे चमचे तेलै च भुन्नो जिच्चर ओह् मुरझाइयै गूढ़ा भुरता नेईं बनी जंदे, 6–8 मिंट. मध्धम अग्गी पर चौड़ा पैन बरतो ते बार-बार हलाओ; पत्ते झट्ट सुंगड़दे न, हरे थमां फिक्के जैतूनी-भूरे होई जंदे न, ते उंदा तकरीबन सारा पानी सुक्की जंदा ऐ.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil until they wilt and become a deep mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium flame and stir again and again; the leaves shrink quickly, turn from green to pale olive-brown, and almost all their water dries up.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: पत्तें गी इक थाली च फलाओ ते पूरी चाल्ली ठंडा होन देओ, तकरीबन 10 मिंट.
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool fully, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: मसालें गी लसन, मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण कन्नै पीसो, फ्ही पत्ते पाइयै थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा चलाओ. पैह्लें भुन्ने दे मसाले, 6 लसन दियां तुरियां, तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण गी मोटा पाउडर पीसी लैओ.
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and pulse a little at a time. First grind the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: ठंडे पत्ते पाओ ते बिना पानी दे 3–4 बारी चलाइयै मोटा पेस्ट बनाओ. आंध्र दे मते घर इसदी थाह्र इसी पत्थरै दी कुंडी (रोलु) च कुट्टदे न.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and without water pulse 3–4 times to make a coarse paste. Many Andhra homes instead pound it in a stone mortar (rolu).

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: चक्खो: एह् खट्टी, तिक्खी ते चंगी लूणी होनी चाहिदी ऐ. जेकर खट्टापन बड़ा तेज़ लग्गै तां इक चुटकी लूण होर पाओ.
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. If the sourness feels very sharp then add a pinch more salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: बचे दे तेलै च राई, दालें, लाल मिर्चें ते कड़ी पत्ते दा तड़का लाओ; रलाई देओ. इक निक्के पैन च 2 बड्डे चमचे तिलें दा तेल गर्म करो, राई गी चटकन देओ, छोलें दी दाल ते माह् दी दाल सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो, फ्ही लाल मिर्चां, कुट्टे दा लसन, कड़ी पत्ता ते हींग किश सकिंटें आस्तै पाओ. इसी पच्चडी पर पाओ ते चंगी चाल्ली हलाओ.
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: In the remaining oil temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves; mix in. Heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal until golden, then add red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour this over the pachadi and stir well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: जेकर होई सकै तां पच्चडी गी 30 मिंट पेदा रौह्न देओ, तां जे सुआद रली जान, फ्ही इसी इक साफ, सुक्के कच्चै दे मर्तबान च भरो.
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible let the pachadi stand 30 minutes, so that the flavours blend, then fill it in a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: भुन्नने शा पैह्लें पत्तें गी पूरी चाल्ली सुकाओ तां जे पच्चडी मता चिर टिकै.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Dry the leaves fully before frying so that the pachadi keeps for a long time.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ. हल्की पच्चडी आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा बरतो, जां अद्धा तेजा ते अद्धा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर.
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a mild pachadi use 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: मेथी ¼ निक्के चमचे तगर गै रक्खो ते उसी सिर्फ इक रंग गूढ़ा भुन्नो; इस शा मती, जां इस शा गूढ़ी, मेथी पच्चडी गी कौड़ा करी दिंदी ऐ.
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep the fenugreek to only ¼ teaspoon and roast it only one shade darker; more than this, or darker than this, fenugreek makes the pachadi bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा चलाओ, बारीक नेईं पीसो: गोंगुरा पच्चडी मोटी होनी चाहिदी ऐ, जिस च पत्तें दे टुकड़े लब्भन.
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse a little at a time, do not grind fine: gongura pachadi should be coarse, in which pieces of leaves are visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: तेलै च कंजूसी नेईं करो; उप्पर तेलै दी परत पच्चडी गी टिकाने च मदद करदी ऐ.
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not be stingy with oil; the layer of oil on top helps preserve the pachadi.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: प्याज कन्नै: परोसने शा ठीक पैह्लें इक हिस्से च 1 निक्का प्याज, बारीक कट्टेआ दा, रलाओ, ते उसी उस्सै दिन खाई लैओ.
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: just before serving mix 1 small onion, finely chopped, into one portion, and eat it the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: साबत लाल मिर्चां: मिर्च पाउडर दी थाह्र 12–15 सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां थोढ़े तेलै च भुन्नो ते मसालें कन्नै पीसो.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: in place of chilli powder fry 12–15 dry red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: हरी मिर्च गोंगुरा: 6–8 हरी मिर्चां पत्तें कन्नै भुन्नो ते मिर्च पाउडर घट्ट करियै 1 निक्का चमचा करी देओ; तिखास होर तेज़ ते हरी-हरी होग.
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and reduce the chilli powder to 1 teaspoon; the heat will be sharper and greener.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: इक चमचा गर्म चौलें च घ्यो कन्नै रलाओ ते कन्नै कट्टे दे कच्चे प्याज कन्नै खाओ. डोसा, इडली कन्नै बी बधिया लगदी ऐ ते आंध्र दी कुसै बी थाली च इक साइड दे तौर पर.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with chopped raw onion alongside. It also tastes excellent with dosa, idli and as a side in any Andhra thali.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: इक साफ, सुक्के कच्चै दे मर्तबान च फ्रिज च 2 हफ्तें तगर रक्खो, हमेशां सुक्का चमचा बरतो. उप्पर तेलै दी इक पतली परत इसी टिकाने च मदद करदी ऐ.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always use a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps preserve it.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.t: गोंगुरा गी अंग्रेज़ी च के आखदे न?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: गोंगुरा रोज़ेल (roselle) बूह्टे दा पत्ता ऐ, जेह्ड़ा अक्सर सॉरेल पत्ते जां रेड सॉरेल दे नां कन्नै बिकदा ऐ. हिंदी ते मराठी बोलने आह्ले इलाकें च इसी अंबाडी आखदे न.
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, which is often sold under the name sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी गी घट्ट खट्टा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How to make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: थोढ़ा होर लूण ते मिर्च पाओ, जां 1 निक्का चमचा कद्दूकस कीता दा गुड़ रलाओ. पत्तें गी चंगी चाल्ली भुन्नने कन्नै बी उंदा खट्टापन नरम होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or mix in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. Frying the leaves well also softens their sourness.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: मेरी गोंगुरा पच्चडी कौड़ी कीं ऐ?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: आमतौर पर बड़ी मती मेथी, जां बड़ी गूढ़ी भुन्नी दी मेथी करी. इसी ¼ निक्के चमचे तगर रक्खो ते इक रंग गूढ़ी होंदे गै भुन्नना बंद करो.
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Usually because of too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ teaspoon and stop roasting as soon as it is one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी किन्ना चिर टिकदी ऐ?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How long does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: सुक्के कच्चै दे मर्तबान च फ्रिज च तकरीबन 2 हफ्ते, जेकर पत्ते चंगी चाल्ली सुकाए गेदे होन ते तुस हमेशां सुक्का चमचा बरतो. फ्रिज दे बाह्र, 2–3 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ.
seg.693b158b80df.back: In a dry glass jar in the fridge about 2 weeks, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat within 2–3 days.

seg.2202d49bd92b.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి · गोंगुरा पच्चडी दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. गुंटूर तरीके दी गोंगुरा पच्चडी: गोंगुरा पत्ते भुन्नियै, भुन्ने दे मसालें, लसन ते तेजा मिर्च पाउडर कन्नै पीसे दे, फ्ही तड़का लाया दा. 6 जनें आस्तै.
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Guntur-style gongura pachadi: gongura leaves fried, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.0f19ba49c232.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी (आंध्र दी गोंगुरा पत्तें दी चटनी) · 1acrefarms

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.d8fb97ac630c.t: हफ्ते दे आम दिनें दी करी · 4 जनें आस्तै

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(इमली दी ग्रेवी च आंध्र आंडा करी)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु आंध्र दी आंडा करी ऐ जेह्ड़ी मते घर उसलै बनांदे न जिसलै घर च मास नेईं होंदा: उबले दे आंडे इमली ते हौली-हौली भुन्ने दे प्याजें दी चटपटी ग्रेवी च रिज्झदे न. एह् उत्तर भारत दी आंडा करी शा पतली ते मती खट्टी होंदी ऐ, ते मते सारे गर्म चौलें च रलाइयै खाने आस्तै बनदी ऐ.
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry which many homes make when there is no meat in the house: boiled eggs simmer in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onions. It is thinner and more sour than north Indian egg curry, and is made mostly for mixing into hot rice and eating.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: साढ़ा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर पुलुसु गी लाल रंग ते इक टिकी दी दरम्यानी तिखास दिंदा ऐ, ते साढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर (पसुपु) सुनैह्री आधार दिंदा ऐ. थोढ़ा गुड़ खट्टेपन गी संतुलत करदा ऐ.
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden base. A little jaggery balances the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: आंडे उबालो ते चीरो. प्याज भुन्नो, हल्दी, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ते इमली दा पानी पाओ, मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ, फ्ही आंडें गी ग्रेवी च गाढ़ा होने तगर पकाओ.
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, let simmer slowly, then cook the eggs in the gravy until thick.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.t: इक चुटकी हल्दी पाउडर ⟦1⟧आंडे भुन्नने आस्तै (मर्जी मताबक)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: A pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g इमली ⟦1⟧निंबू जिन्नी गोली, 1½ कप कोसे पानी च भिज्जी दी⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧मूंगफली जां तिलें दा तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 निक्के चमचे सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧दरम्यानी तिखास; हल्की आस्तै 1½ निक्का चमचा बरतो⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for mild use 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.654942936ff6.t: 1 निक्का चमचा कद्दूकस कीता दा गुड़ ⟦1⟧मर्जी मताबक⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: इमली गी कोसे पानी च 15 मिंट भिगोओ. चंगी चाल्ली नचोड़ो, छानो ते इमली दा पानी रक्खी लैओ; रेशे ते बीज सुट्टी देओ.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in lukewarm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away the fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: आंडें गी 10 मिंट उबालो, छिल्लो ते हर इक पर 3–4 हल्के चीरे लाओ. उनेंगी कमरे दे तापमान आह्ले पानी च रक्खियै शुरू करो, उबाल औने थमां 10 मिंट गिनो, फ्ही छिल्लने शा पैह्लें पानी च ठंडा करो. जर्दी अंदर तगर सख्त ते फिक्की पीली होनी चाहिदी ऐ.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and make 3–4 light slits on each one. Start by keeping them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil coming, then cool in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm right through and pale yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: मर्जी मताबक: 1 निक्का चमचा तेल इक चुटकी हल्दी कन्नै गर्म करो ते आंडें गी 2 मिंट उस च घुमाओ जिच्चर उंदे पर हल्के फफोले नेईं पेई जंदे. बक्खरे रक्खी देओ.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: Optional: heat 1 teaspoon oil with a pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until light blisters form on them. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: बचे दा तेल कड़ाही च मध्धम अग्गी पर गर्म करो. मेथी दाने पाओ ते उनेंगी हल्के भूरे होन देओ; गूढ़े होने पर ओह् कौड़े होई जंदे न.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in the kadai on medium flame. Add fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; on becoming dark they become bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: राई, कड़ी पत्ता ते प्याज तेलै च नरम ते सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो. पैह्लें राई पाओ ते तिड़कन देओ, फ्ही कड़ी पत्ता, हरी मिर्चां ते हींग, फ्ही प्याज तकरीबन 8 मिंट आस्तै.
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard, curry leaves and onions in the oil until soft and golden. First add mustard and let it splutter, then curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then onions for about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: अग्ग मट्ठी करो. हल्दी, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण पाओ, फ्ही इमली दा पानी; 10 मिंट मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ. धनिया पाउडर मिर्च पाउडर कन्नै गै पाओ तां जे ओह् पैह्लें किश सकिंट भुन्नोई जा.
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Make the flame low. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; let it simmer slowly for 10 minutes. Add coriander powder together with the chilli powder so that it gets fried for a few seconds first.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: इमली दी कच्ची बास्सना चली जानी चाहिदी ऐ ते ग्रेवी चमकदार लब्भनी चाहिदी ऐ. जेकर एह् बड़ी जल्दी गाढ़ी होऐ तां ½ कप पानी पाओ.
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of tamarind should go away and the gravy should look glossy. If it thickens too quickly then add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: आंडे हौली-हौली अंदर सरकाओ ते 5 मिंट होर रिज्झन देओ जिच्चर ग्रेवी गाढ़ी नेईं होई जंदी. बिच-बिच च चमचे कन्नै आंडें पर ग्रेवी पांदे रवो.
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Slide the eggs in gently and let it simmer 5 minutes more until the gravy becomes thick. In between keep spooning gravy over the eggs.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: गुड़ रलाओ, चक्खियै लूण जां खट्टापन ठीक करो, ते हरा धनिया छिड़को.
seg.299781c49104.back: Mix in the jaggery, taste and correct salt or sourness, and sprinkle green coriander.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: अग्ग बंद करो ते परोसने शा पैह्लें पुलुसु गी 10 मिंट रक्खी देओ तां जे आंडें च ग्रेवी रची जा.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the flame and leave the pulusu 10 minutes before serving so that the gravy soaks into the eggs.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: चीरें कन्नै चटपटी ग्रेवी आंडें दे अंदर जंदी ऐ.
seg.feebbb94999b.back: Through the slits the tangy gravy goes inside the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: छिल्लने शा पैह्लें उबले दे आंडें गी पानी च ठंडा करो; छिल्के सफाई कन्नै उतरी जंदे न.
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर दरम्यानी तिखास दिंदा ऐ; होर तिक्खे पुलुसु आस्तै इसदे कन्नै ½ निक्का चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर पाओ.
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder along with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: पेदा रेहने दे बाद पुलुसु दा सुआद बधिया होई जंदा ऐ, ते अगले दिन होर बी, कीजे आंडे इमली अपने अंदर लेई लैंदे न.
seg.fc1643db807e.back: After standing the pulusu's flavour becomes better, and even more the next day, because the eggs take the tamarind into themselves.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: टमाटर: नरम, घट्ट खट्टी ग्रेवी आस्तै प्याजें दे बाद 1 कट्टेआ दा टमाटर पाओ.
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a softer, less sour gravy add 1 chopped tomato after the onions.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: तिल: होर गाढ़ी, मेवे आह्ली ग्रेवी आस्तै अखीरी 5 मिंटें च 1 बड्डा चमचा भुन्ने दे तिलें दा पाउडर रलाओ.
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thicker, nutty gravy mix in 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: मामिडिकाया: गर्मियें च अद्धी इमली दी थाह्र कच्चे अंब दे किश टुकड़े पाओ ते उनेंगी ग्रेवी च पकाओ.
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer, in place of half the tamarind add a few pieces of raw mango and cook them in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: गर्म उबले दे चौलें ते इक चमचा घ्यो कन्नै परोसो, कन्नै कोई कुरकुरी तली दी सब्जी जां पापड़ (अप्पडालु). चपाती जां डोसा कन्नै बी चलदी ऐ.
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve with hot boiled rice and a spoon of ghee, with some crispy fried vegetable or papad (appadalu) alongside. It also goes with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: बची दी करी ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. पुलुसु गी पैन च थोढ़ा पानी पाइयै हौली-हौली गर्म करो.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Keep leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu gently in a pan adding a little water.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: आंडा करी आस्तै आंडें गी किन्ना चिर उबालना चाहिदा ऐ?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long should eggs be boiled for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: पानी उबलने दे समें थमां तकरीबन 10 मिंट. आंडें गी ग्रेवी च पाने शा पैह्लें जर्दी अंदर तगर सख्त ते फिक्की पीली होनी चाहिदी ऐ, बिच्चा पतली नेईं.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. Before adding the eggs to the gravy the yolk should be firm right through and pale yellow, not runny in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.t: पुलुसु आस्तै आंडें पर चीरे कीं लांदे न?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits made on the eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: हल्के चीरें कन्नै इमली दी ग्रेवी आंडे दी सफेदी दे अंदर रची जंदी ऐ. इंदे बगैर ग्रेवी उप्पर गै रेही जंदी ऐ ते आंडा फिक्का लगदा ऐ.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: With light slits the tamarind gravy soaks into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays only on top and the egg tastes bland.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.t: पुलुसु दा खट्टापन कि'यां घट्ट करचै?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How to reduce the sourness of the pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: इसी किश मिंट होर रिज्झन देओ, इक निक्का चमचा कद्दूकस कीता दा गुड़ पाओ, जां थोढ़ा पानी रलाओ. अगली बारी इमली दी निक्की गोली बरतो.
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Let it simmer a few more minutes, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or mix in a little water. Next time use a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: आंडा पुलुसु ते आंडा करी च के फर्क ऐ?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: पुलुसु इक पतली, चटपटी इमली दी ग्रेवी ऐ जेह्ड़ी चौलें च रलाने आस्तै बनदी ऐ. आम आंडा करी आमतौर पर प्याज ते टमाटर पर बनदी ऐ, बिना इमली दे ते गाढ़े मसाले कन्नै.
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, tangy tamarind gravy which is made for mixing into rice. Regular egg curry is usually made on onion and tomato, without tamarind and with thick masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · आंडा पुलुसु दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु, आंध्र दी आंडा करी: उबले दे आंडे चटपटी इमली-प्याज दी ग्रेवी च रिज्झे दे, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ते हल्दी कन्नै रंगी दी. 4 जनें आस्तै.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy, coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु (इमली दी ग्रेवी च आंध्र आंडा करी) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.583485fac40c.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.7b6878de1955.t: 1 निक्का चमचा कद्दूकस कीता दा गुड़

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा ⟦1⟧(आंध्र दे भरवें बताऊं)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा भरवें बताऊं दी ओह् सब्जी ऐ जेह्ड़ी आंध्र दे घर ऐतवार दे दपैह्र दे खाने, ब्याहें ते परौह्ने औने पर बनांदे न. निक्के, गोल, जामनी बताऊं चीरे जंदे न, उंदे च भुन्नी दी मूंगफली, तिल ते नारियल दा मसाला भरेआ जंदा ऐ, ते तेलै च हौली-हौली पकाए जंदे न जिच्चर ओह् नरम नेईं होई जंदे ते मसाला उंदे कन्नै चिपकी नेईं जंदा.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya kura is that stuffed brinjal dish which Andhra homes make for Sunday lunch, weddings and when guests come. Small, round, purple brinjals are slit, a masala of roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut is filled in them, and they are cooked slowly in oil until they become soft and the masala sticks to them.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: साढ़ा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर भरने आह्ले मसाले गी लाल रंग ते दरम्यानी तिखास दिंदा ऐ, ते हल्दी पाउडर उसी पूरा करदा ऐ. इसी गर्म चौलें जां चपाती कन्नै परोसो. एह् रेसिपी 4 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing masala red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder completes it. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: मूंगफली, तिल, सुक्का नारियल ते साबत धनिया भुन्नो, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर ते लूण कन्नै पीसो, निक्के बताऊं च भरो ते तेलै च नरम होने तगर हौली-हौली पकाओ.
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast groundnuts, sesame, dry coconut and whole coriander, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, fill into small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे मूंगफली ⟦1⟧कच्ची, छिल्के कन्नै जां बिना छिल्के⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons groundnuts ⟦1⟧raw, with skin or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.8be0f88d515d.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा सुक्का नारियल ⟦1⟧खोपा⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 निक्के चमचे सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧होर तिक्खी सब्जी आस्तै 1 बड्डे चमचे तगर⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter dish⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12 निक्के बताऊं ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 500 g, निक्के गोल जामनी⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.t: 2 बड्डे चमचे हरा धनिया ⟦1⟧कट्टेआ दा, अखीर च पाने आस्तै⟦/1⟧
seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons green coriander ⟦1⟧chopped, for adding at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: मूंगफली, तिल, नारियल ते साबत धनिया बिना तेलै दे भुन्नो; मसालें कन्नै पीसो. पैह्लें मूंगफली गी मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर 3–4 मिंट भुन्नो, फ्ही धनिया, जीरा ते तिल 1 मिंट आस्तै पाओ, ते नारियल अखीरी 30 सकिंटें आस्तै, जिच्चर ओह् हल्का सुनैह्री नेईं होई जंदा. ठंडा होन देओ.
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Roast groundnuts, sesame, coconut and whole coriander without oil; grind with the spices. First roast the groundnuts on medium-low flame for 3–4 minutes, then add coriander, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it becomes light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: मिक्सर च भुन्ने दे मसाले गी लसन, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, लूण ते इमली कन्नै बिना पानी दे मोटा पाउडर पीसो. दबाने पर एह् इक्कठा होई जाना चाहिदा ऐ.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In a mixer grind the roasted masala with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind without water to a coarse powder. On pressing it should come together.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: बताऊं धोओ ते हरी टोपी थोढ़ी कट्टी देओ, डंडी रौह्न देओ.
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leave the stem on.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: हर बताऊं गी थल्लेआ जमा (+) आंगर चीरो, डंडी रौह्न देओ, ते मसाला भरो. तकरीबन तिन्न-चौथाई उप्पर तगर कट्टो तां जे चारै हिस्से उप्परा जुड़े दे रौह्न. हर इक गी कटदे-कटदे लूणे पानी दे कटोरे च पांदे जाओ, फ्ही पानी कड्ढी देओ.
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Slit each brinjal from the bottom like a plus (+), leave the stem on, and fill the masala. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so that all four parts stay joined at the top. As you cut each one keep putting it into a bowl of salted water, then drain the water.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: हर बताऊं च तकरीबन 1 भरोचा निक्का चमचा मसाला दबाइयै भरो. बचे दा मसाला बक्खरा रक्खी देओ.
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 heaped teaspoon of masala into each brinjal. Keep the remaining masala aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: इक चौड़े, भारी पैन च मध्धम अग्गी पर तेल गर्म करो. राई पाओ ते, जिसलै ओह् तिड़कै, कड़ी पत्ता ते प्याज, जेकर बरता करदे ओ. प्याज नरम होने तगर भुन्नो, तकरीबन 3 मिंट.
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat oil on medium flame in a wide, heavy pan. Add mustard and, when it splutters, curry leaves and onion, if you are using it. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: भरवें बताऊं पैन च इक गै तैह् च रक्खो.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Place the stuffed brinjals in the pan in a single layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: बताऊं गी गर्म तेलै च, ढक्कियै, मट्ठी अग्गी पर पकाओ, हर 4–5 मिंटें बाद हौली-हौली पलटदे होई. चमचा जां चिमटा बरतो तां जे मसाला अंदर रौह्, ते 15–18 मिंट पकाओ, जिच्चर छिल्के पर झुर्रियां नेईं पेई जंदियां.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so that the masala stays inside, and cook 15–18 minutes, until wrinkles form on the skin.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: बचे दा मसाला ½ कप पानी कन्नै पाओ; बताऊं नरम होने तगर मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ. ढक्कियै मट्ठी अग्गी पर 8–10 मिंट होर पकाओ, जिच्चर मसाला गाढ़ा नेईं होई जंदा ते कंढें पर तेल नेईं लब्भन लगदा.
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the remaining masala with ½ cup water; let it simmer slowly until the brinjals are soft. Cook covered on low flame for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala becomes thick and oil starts to show at the edges.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: पकने दी जांच करो: सारें शा मोटे बताऊं च छुरी बिना कुसै रोक दे लंघी जानी चाहिदी ऐ. हरा धनिया छिड़को ते अग्ग बंद करो.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check for doneness: a knife should pass through the thickest brinjal without any resistance. Sprinkle green coriander and turn off the flame.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: डंडियां रौह्न देओ तां जे पकदे ते पलटदे बेल्लै बताऊं जुड़े दे रौह्न.
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Leave the stems on so that the brinjals stay joined while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: इक्कै साइज दे निक्के, चमकदार बताऊं चुनो, तां जे ओह् इक बरोबर पकन; बड्डे बताऊं बिच्चा सख्त रेही जंदे न.
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small, shiny brinjals of one size, so that they cook evenly; big brinjals stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: मूंगफली ते तिल मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर भुन्नो; सड़े दे तिल सारे मसाले गी कौड़ा करी दिंदे न.
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast groundnuts and sesame on medium-low flame; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: हल्की सब्जी आस्तै 1½ निक्का चमचा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर बरतो; होर तिखास आस्तै 1 बड्डे चमचे तगर पाओ.
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a mild dish use 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for more heat add up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: प्याज दे मसाले कन्नै: नरम, हल्की मिट्ठी ग्रेवी आस्तै भरने आह्ले मसाले च 1 निक्का प्याज पीसी देओ.
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a softer, lightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion into the stuffing masala.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: बिना नारियल: नारियल नेईं पाओ ते 1 बड्डा चमचा होर मूंगफली ते तिल बरतो.
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: do not add coconut and use 1 tablespoon more groundnuts and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: ग्रेवी आह्ली: अखीरी कदम च ½ कप दी थाह्र 1 कप पानी पाओ, तां जे चौलें च रलाने आस्तै पतली सब्जी बनै.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: With gravy: in the last step add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup, so that a thinner dish is made for mixing into rice.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: गर्म उबले दे चौलें ते इक चमचा घ्यो कन्नै परोसो, जां चपाती जां जोन्ना रोट्टे कन्नै.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve with hot boiled rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. थोढ़ा पानी पाइयै हौली-हौली गर्म करो.
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat gently adding a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: गुत्ति वंकाया आस्तै केह्ड़े बताऊं सारें शा बधिया न?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: निक्के, गोल, जामनी बताऊं, तकरीबन आंडे जिन्ने, चमकदार छिल्के ते हरी डंडी आह्ले. ओह् मसाला पकने जिन्ने समें च गै अंदर तगर पकी जंदे न ते मसाले गी चंगी चाल्ली संभाली रक्खदे न.
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Small, round, purple brinjals, about egg-sized, with shiny skin and green stem. They cook through to the inside in the same time as the masala cooks and hold the masala well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.t: मिगी कि'यां पता लग्गै जे बताऊं पक्की गेदे न?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How do I know that the brinjals have cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: छिल्के पर झुर्रियां पेई जंदियां न ते ओह् नरम होई जंदे न, ते सारें शा मोटे बताऊं च छुरी बिना कुसै रोक दे लंघी जंदी ऐ. कच्चे बताऊं बिच्चा सख्त ते स्पंज आंगर लगदे न.
seg.c65656faa952.back: Wrinkles form on the skin and they become soft, and a knife passes through the thickest brinjal without any resistance. Raw brinjals feel hard and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: के अ'ऊं बिना नारियल दे गुत्ति वंकाया बनाई सकनां?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: हां. नारियल दी थाह्र 1 बड्डा चमचा होर मूंगफली ते 1 बड्डा चमचा होर तिल बरतो; मसाले च मेवे आह्ला सुआद होर बधी जंदा ऐ.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. In place of coconut use 1 tablespoon more groundnuts and 1 tablespoon more sesame; the nutty flavour in the masala increases further.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.t: मेरे बताऊं टुट्टी कीं जंदे न?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: डंडी कड्ढी दित्ती गेई ही जां जमा आह्ला चीरा पूरा आर-पार कट्टी दित्ता गेआ हा. डंडी रौह्न देओ, चीरा उप्परा तकरीबन इक चौथाई पैह्लें रोकी देओ ते उनेंगी हौली-हौली पलटो.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stem had been removed or the plus slit had been cut fully right through. Leave the stem on, stop the slit about a quarter short of the top and turn them gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. निक्के बताऊं च भुन्नी दी मूंगफली, तिल ते नारियल भरेआ, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ते हल्दी पाउडर कन्नै पीसेआ दा, फ्ही तेलै च हौली-हौली पकाया दा.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals filled with roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked slowly in oil.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा (आंध्र दे भरवें बताऊं) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6338aa32f352.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा सुक्का नारियल

seg.5fd655ec9c39.t: चाह् दे बेल्लै दा नाश्ता · 4 जनें आस्तै

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि ओह् काजू पकौड़ा ऐ जेह्ड़ा आंध्र दियां मिठाई दियां हट्टियां ते घर चाह् दे बेल्लै, त्यौहारें ते परौह्नें आस्तै तलदे न: साबत काजू बेसन ते चौलें दे आटे दी पतली, मसालेदार परत च, कुरकुरे होने तगर तले दे. प्याज दे बगैर बनने करी एह् मर्तबान च कई दिन चलदा ऐ, इस करी मते घर दीवाली ते संक्रांति दे परौह्नें आस्तै इसदा इक घान तली लैंदे न.
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi is that cashew pakora which Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea-time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coating of gram flour and rice flour, fried until crisp. Because it is made without onion it lasts several days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch of it for Diwali and Sankranti guests.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: साढ़े जीडिपप्पु पैक दे साबत काजू परत दे अंदर कुरकुरे रौंह्दे न, ते सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर दरम्यानी तिखास ते निग्घा लाल रंग दिंदा ऐ. एह् रेसिपी 4 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews of our jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: कुल समें च पकोडि गी ठंडा ते कुरकुरा होने आस्तै 5 मिंट बी शामल न.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: The total time also includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and become crisp.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: साबत काजुएं गी बेसन, चौलें दे आटे, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर, लूण ते इक चमचा गर्म तेलै कन्नै रलाओ, बस परत चढ़ने जिन्ना पानी छिड़को, ते सुनैह्री ते कुरकुरे होने तगर डूंह्गे तेलै च तलो.
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix whole cashews with gram flour, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle just enough water for the coating to stick, and fry in deep oil until golden and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 कप साबत काजू ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 150 g; बड़े बड्डे काजुएं गी अद्धा करी लैओ⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; halve very big cashews⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ कप बेसन ⟦1⟧छोलें दा आटा, तकरीबन 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 बड्डे चमचे चौलें दा आटा ⟦1⟧होर कुरकुरी परत आस्तै⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 निक्का चमचा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧दरम्यानी तिखास; होर तिक्खे पकोडि आस्तै ½ निक्का चमचा होर पाओ⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for hotter pakodi add ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.40a2a51a64aa.t: ½ निक्का चमचा लूण ⟦1⟧जां सुआद मताबक⟦/1⟧
seg.40a2a51a64aa.back: ½ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.3a1f0206d086.t: 2 बड्डे चमचे हरा धनिया ⟦1⟧बारीक कट्टेआ दा⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 बड्डा चमचा गर्म तेल ⟦1⟧तलने आह्ले तेलै चा लैता दा⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧
seg.a24adfc46507.t: 2–3 बड्डे चमचे पानी ⟦1⟧थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा करियै छिड़केआ दा⟦/1⟧
seg.a24adfc46507.back: 2–3 tablespoons water ⟦1⟧sprinkled a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: डूंह्गे तेलै च तलने आस्तै तेल ⟦1⟧आमतौर पर मूंगफली दा तेल बरतेआ जंदा ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: Oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: काजुएं गी हल्का धोओ ते पानी चंगी चाल्ली नचोड़ी देओ; थोढ़ी गिल्ली सतह कन्नै आटा चिपकी जंदा ऐ.
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews lightly and drain the water well; with a slightly damp surface the flour sticks.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: कड़ाही च मध्धम अग्गी पर तलने आस्तै तेल गर्म करो.
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat oil for frying in a kadai on medium flame.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: बेसन, चौलें दा आटा, मिर्च पाउडर, लूण, अदरक-लसन दा पेस्ट ते कड़ी पत्ता रलाओ. चौड़ी कटोरी बरतो, ते उस्सै बेल्लै हरी मिर्चां, हरा धनिया ते हींग बी पाओ.
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix gram flour, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and at the same time also add green chillies, green coriander and asafoetida.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 बड्डा चमचा गर्म तेल रलाइयै मलो, काजू पाओ ते इन्ना पानी छिड़को जे आटा बस उंदे पर चढ़ी जा. कड़ाही चा गर्म तेल ध्यान कन्नै चमचे कन्नै कड्ढो ते पैह्लें उसी उंगलियें दे सिरें कन्नै आटे दे मसाले च मलो, फ्ही काजू पाओ ते इक-इक बड्डा चमचा पानी छिड़कदे होई उछालदे रवो, जिच्चर आटा हर काजू कन्नै चिपकी नेईं जंदा. मसाला गिल्ले भुरभुरे आंगर लब्भना चाहिदा ऐ, घोल आंगर नेईं.
seg.346911fb291b.back: Mix in 1 tablespoon hot oil and rub, add the cashews and sprinkle just so much water that the flour just coats them. Carefully take hot oil from the kadai with a spoon and first rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips, then add the cashews and keep tossing while sprinkling one tablespoon of water at a time, until the flour sticks to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not like a batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: तेल जांचो: मसाले दी इक चुटकी पाने पर ओह् 2–3 सकिंटें च लगातार बुलबुलें कन्नै उप्पर आई जानी चाहिदी ऐ. जेकर ओह् फौरन भूरी होई जा, तां तेल बड़ा गर्म ऐ.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Check the oil: on adding a pinch of the mix it should come up within 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns immediately, then the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: मध्धम-गर्म तेलै च निक्के-निक्के गुच्छे पाओ. इक बारी च 3–4 लेपे दे काजू उंगलियें कन्नै चुक्को ते उनेंगी ढिल्ले-ढिल्ले तेलै च सुट्टो, कड़ाही च भीड़ नेईं करो.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Add small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and drop them loosely into the oil, do not crowd the kadai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: पलटदे होई सुनैह्री ते कुरकुरे होने तगर तलो, 5–6 मिंट; कागज़ पर कड्ढो. पकने पर पकोडि दे आसै-पासै दे बुलबुले निक्के होई जंदे न ते हौले होई जंदे न.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry while turning until golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; take out onto paper. When cooked, the bubbles around the pakodi become small and slow down.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: बाकी गी बी इस्सै चाल्ली घानें च तलो, हर घान दे बिच्च तेल गी फ्ही गर्म होन देओ.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest too in batches the same way, letting the oil heat again between each batch.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: पकोडि गी कागज़ पर 5 मिंट रक्खी देओ; ठंडे होंदे-होंदे ओह् होर कुरकुरे होई जंदे न. जेकर चाहो तां उप्पर इक चुटकी लूण जां मिर्च पाउडर छिड़को.
seg.8ab193492427.back: Leave the pakodi on paper 5 minutes; as they cool they become crisper. If you want then sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: घोल गाढ़ा ते सुक्का रक्खो, पतला नेईं, नेईं तां पकोडि नरम होई जंदे न.
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the batter thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi become soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: मध्धम अग्गी पर तलो: काजू झट्ट भूरे होई जंदे न, ते तेज़ अग्गी पर अंदर दा काजू भुन्नोने शा पैह्लें गै परत दा रंग बदली जंदा ऐ.
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium flame: cashews brown quickly, and on high flame the coating changes colour even before the cashew inside is roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: आटे च मले दा इक चमचा गर्म तेल पकोडि गी हल्का ते कुरकुरा बनांदा ऐ.
seg.76602f605fc8.back: A spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर दरम्यानी तिखास ते चंगा लाल रंग दिंदा ऐ; बच्चें आस्तै ½ निक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and good red colour; for children use ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: होर तिक्खा: अद्धे सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर दी थाह्र तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बरतो, जेह्ड़ा कुतै मता तिक्खा ऐ.
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: in place of half the Sannam chilli powder use Teja chilli powder, which is far hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: प्याज कन्नै: नरम, मिट्ठे पकोडि आस्तै काजुएं कन्नै 1 निक्का प्याज, पतला-पतला कट्टेआ दा, पाओ, ते उनेंगी उस्सै दिन खाई लैओ.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for soft, sweet pakodi add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews, and eat them the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: पुदीना: हरे धनिये कन्नै गै 2 बड्डे चमचे कट्टे दे पुदीने दे पत्ते पाओ.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: along with the green coriander add 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: संञां दी चाह् जां फिल्टर काफी कन्नै गर्म परोसो. एह् लंच बॉक्स च बी जंदे न जां चौल-पप्पु आह्ली थाली दे इक पासै.
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve hot with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go in the lunch box or on one side of a rice-pappu thali.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: पूरी चाल्ली ठंडा होने दे बाद, उनेंगी कमरे दे तापमान पर हवाबंद डब्बे च रक्खो ते 4–5 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. जेकर नरम होई जान, तां सुक्के पैन च मट्ठी अग्गी पर 2–3 मिंट गर्म करो.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After cooling fully, keep them in an airtight box at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they become soft, then heat in a dry pan on low flame for 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: मेरे काजू पकोडि नरम कीं होई गे?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: आटे च बड़ा मता पानी, जां मट्ठी अग्गी पर तलना. मसाले गी गिल्ले भुरभुरे आंगर रक्खो ते मध्धम अग्गी पर तलो जिच्चर बुलबुले हौले नेईं होई जंदे.
seg.346050614d3a.back: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low flame. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium flame until the bubbles slow down.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.t: के पकोडि बनाने शा पैह्लें काजू भिगोने चाहिदे न?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Should cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: भिगोने दी लोड़ नेईं. आटा चिपकाने आस्तै झट्ट धोना काफी ऐ; मता चिर भिज्जे दे काजू अपना किश कुरकुरापन गुआई बौंह्दे न.
seg.e6e487728264.back: No need to soak. A quick wash is enough to make the flour stick; cashews soaked a long time lose some of their crunch.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: के अ'ऊं चौलें दे आटे दे बगैर काजू पकोडि बनाई सकनां?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: हां. 2 बड्डे चमचे होर बेसन, जां 1 बड्डा चमचा कॉर्नफ्लोर बरतो. चौलें दा आटा सारें शा कुरकुरी परत दिंदा ऐ, इस करी उसदे बगैर पकोडि थोढ़े नरम होंगन.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Use 2 tablespoons more besan, or 1 tablespoon cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: काजू पकोडि किन्ना चिर कुरकुरे रौंह्दे न?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How long do cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: हवाबंद डब्बे च तकरीबन 4–5 दिन, बशर्ते डब्बे च पाने शा पैह्लें ओह् पूरी चाल्ली ठंडे होई जान.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: About 4–5 days in an airtight box, provided they have cooled fully before putting in the box.

seg.60df05d4b9d3.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ · काजू पकोडि दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. साढ़े जीडिपप्पु पैक दे साबत काजू, बेसन, चौलें दे आटे ते सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर कन्नै कुरकुरे काजू पकोडि. कदम-ब-कदम तरीका, नुक्ते ते सुआल-जवाब.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.7d26dc20462c.t: डूंह्गे तेलै च तलने आस्तै तेल

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: उपमा आंध्र दा रोज़ दा टिफिन ऐ: सूजी गी प्याज, हरी मिर्चें ते कड़ी पत्ते आह्ले तड़के आह्ले पानी च नरम पकाया जंदा ऐ. जीडिपप्पु उपमा उसदा सजेआ-धजेआ रूप ऐ, जिस च घ्यो च सुनैह्री तले दे काजुएं दी इक भरोची मुट्ठी होंदी ऐ, जि'यां परौह्नें आस्तै, त्यौहार दी सवेर ते ब्याहें च बनदा ऐ, ते अक्सर पेसरट्टु कन्नै जां इक चमचा चीनी कन्नै परोसेआ जंदा ऐ.
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's everyday tiffin: semolina is cooked soft in water tempered with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is its dressed-up form, in which there is a heaped handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, as is made for guests, festival mornings and weddings, and it is often served with pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: साढ़े जीडिपप्पु काजू साबत ते सादे न, इस करी ओह् इक बरोबर तलोंदे न ते नरम रवे दे बिच्च कुरकुरे रौंह्दे न. एह् तकरीबन 25 मिंटें च मेज पर होंदा ऐ. एह् रेसिपी 3 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy amid the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: रवा भुन्नो, काजू घ्यो च तलो, फ्ही तड़का लाओ ते प्याज ते मिर्चां नरम करो. पानी च लूण पाइयै उबालो, रवा रलाओ, ढक्की देओ ते अखीर च काजू पाओ.
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften the onion and chillies. Boil the water with salt, mix in the rava, cover and at the end add the cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 कप बॉम्बे रवा ⟦1⟧दरम्यानी सूजी, तकरीबन 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina, about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.t: 2½ कप पानी ⟦1⟧सख्त उपमा आस्तै 2 कप बरतो⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for a firm upma use 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ कप काजू ⟦1⟧साबत जां अद्धे, तकरीबन 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halves, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे घ्यो ⟦1⟧जां 2 बड्डे चमचे तेल ते 1 बड्डा चमचा घ्यो⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 हरी मिर्चां ⟦1⟧चीरियां दियां; होर तिक्खे उपमा आस्तै 3 बरतो⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; for a hotter upma use 3⟦/1⟧

seg.46ba774a4c39.t: 2 बड्डे चमचे हरा धनिया ⟦1⟧कट्टेआ दा, मर्जी मताबक⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: प्याज, अदरक ते हरा धनिया कट्टो, हरी मिर्चां चीरो, ते पानी माप्पी लैओ.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Chop the onion, ginger and green coriander, slit the green chillies, and measure the water.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: रवे गी सुक्के पैन च भुन्नो जिच्चर उदे चा भुन्नने दी खुशबो नेईं औन लगदी, तकरीबन 5 मिंट. इसदा रंग फिक्का गै रक्खो. मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर लगातार हलांदे रवो, फ्ही इसी इक थाली च कड्ढी देओ.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the rava in a dry pan until a roasted aroma starts coming from it, about 5 minutes. Keep its colour pale only. Keep stirring continuously on medium-low flame, then take it out onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: इक चौड़े, भारी पैन च मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर घ्यो गर्म करो.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low flame.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: काजुएं गी घ्यो च सुनैह्री होने तगर तलो; उनेंगी कड्ढी लैओ. इस च तकरीबन 1–2 मिंट लगदे न; घ्यो पैन च गै रौह्न देओ.
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry the cashews in ghee until golden; take them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; let the ghee stay in the pan.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: राई, दालें ते कड़ी पत्ते दा तड़का लाओ. प्याज ते मिर्चां नरम करो, पानी ते लूण पाओ, ते उबालो. कड़ी पत्ता पाने शा पैह्लें राई गी तिड़कन देओ ते दालें गी हल्का सुनैह्री होन देओ, फ्ही प्याज कन्नै अदरक पाओ ते प्याज नरम होने तगर 3–4 मिंट पकाओ.
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard splutter and the dals turn light golden before adding curry leaves, then add ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: उबाल औने पर पानी चक्खो; एह् थोढ़ा लूणा लगना चाहिदा ऐ, कीजे रवा लूण सोखी लैंदा ऐ.
seg.be01d433ae80.back: When the boil comes taste the water; it should taste a little salty, because the rava absorbs salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: अग्ग मट्ठी करो. हलांदे होई रवा पतली धार च पाओ. 3 मिंट मट्ठी अग्गी पर ढक्की देओ; उप्पर काजू पाओ.
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Make the flame low. While stirring, pour the rava in a thin stream. Cover 3 minutes on low flame; put cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: काजू पाने शा पैह्लें उपमा जांचो: रवा नरम होना चाहिदा ऐ, कोई सख्त दाना नेईं, ते उपमा पैन दे पासें गी छोड़ना चाहिदा ऐ. जेकर अजें बी दानेदार ऐ, तां 2 बड्डे चमचे गर्म पानी छिड़को, ढक्की देओ ते 1 मिंट होर पकाओ.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Check the upma before adding cashews: the rava should be soft, no hard grain, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, then sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: जेकर बरता करदे ओ तां इक चमचा होर घ्यो ते हरा धनिया, कन्नै मते सारे काजू, रलाओ.
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: If you are using them, mix in one more spoon of ghee and green coriander, along with most of the cashews.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: गर्म परोसो, बाकी काजू उप्पर पाइयै.
seg.351e9512c914.back: Serve hot, with the remaining cashews put on top.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: हलांदे होई रवा पतली धार च पाओ तां जे गुठलियां नेईं बनन.
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so that lumps do not form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
