seg.3c98bb62770b.t: पैह्लें रवा भुन्नने कन्नै हर दाना बक्खरा रौंह्दा ऐ; एह् छोड़ी देओ तां उपमा चिपचिपा होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: Roasting the rava first keeps every grain separate; skip this and the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: काजुएं गी मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर तलो ते सुनैह्री होंदे गै कड्ढी लैओ; गर्म घ्यो च ओह् गूढ़े होंदे गै रौंह्दे न.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry the cashews on medium-low flame and take out as soon as they are golden; in hot ghee they keep getting darker.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: पेदा रेहने पर उपमा सख्त होई जंदा ऐ, इस करी उसी उसलै गै अग्गी परा लाही लैओ जिसलै ओह् तुंदी पसंद शा थोढ़ा नरम होऐ.
seg.975560a8a158.back: On standing the upma becomes firm, so take it off the fire right when it is a little softer than your liking.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: सब्जियें आह्ला उपमा: प्याज कन्नै ½ कप कट्टी दी गाजर, बीन्स ते मटर पाओ ते पानी पाने शा पैह्लें 3–4 मिंट पकाओ.
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: with the onion add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and peas and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: टमाटर उपमा: प्याज दे बाद 1 कट्टेआ दा टमाटर पाओ ते पानी पाने शा पैह्लें नरम होने तगर पकाओ.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: after the onion add 1 chopped tomato and cook until soft before adding water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: गोधुमा रवा उपमा: उन्ना गै कणक दा रवा 3 कप पानी कन्नै बरतो ते ढक्कियै 5–6 मिंट पकाओ.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: नाश्ते दे टिफिन दे तौर पर नारियल दी चटनी, अल्लम पच्चडी (अदरक दी चटनी) जां इक चमचा चीनी कन्नै गर्म परोसो, जां पेसरट्टु उपमा आस्तै पेसरट्टु दे कन्नै.
seg.01300d94ad36.back: As a breakfast tiffin serve hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi (ginger chutney) or a spoon of sugar, or alongside pesarattu for pesarattu upma.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: उपमा बनने दे फौरन बाद गर्म-गर्म खाना सारें शा बधिया ऐ. बचेआ दा उपमा ढक्कियै फ्रिज च 1 दिन तगर रक्खो ते दबारा गर्म करने शा पैह्लें पानी छिड़को.
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma is best eaten piping hot right after it is made. Keep leftover upma covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle water before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.t: बिना गुठलियें दे उपमा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How to make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: पानी उबलदा रक्खो, अग्ग मट्ठी करो ते इक हत्थै कन्नै रवा पतली धार च पाओ ते दूए हत्थै कन्नै हलांदे रवो.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, make the flame low and pour the rava in a thin stream with one hand and keep stirring with the other hand.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: उपमा आस्तै रवे ते पानी दा सही अनुपात केह्ड़ा ऐ?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right ratio of rava and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: नरम आंध्र तरीके दे उपमा आस्तै, 1 कप बॉम्बे रवे आस्तै 2½ कप पानी बरतो. सख्त, होर दानेदार उपमा आस्तै 2 कप बरतो.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water for 1 cup Bombay rava. For a firm, more grainy upma use 2 cups.

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: रवा भुन्नेआ नेईं गेआ, जां बड़ा मता पानी पेई गेआ. रवे गी भुन्नने दी खुशबो औने तगर भुन्नो, ते हर कप आस्तै 2½ कप पानी दे करीब रौह्.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava until the roasted aroma comes, and stay near 2½ cups water for each cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.t: उपमा च काजू कदूं पाने चाहिदे न?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When should cashews be added to upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: पैह्लें उनेंगी घ्यो च तलियै कड्ढी लैओ, फ्ही अखीर च रलाओ. पैह्लें पाने पर ओह् उपमा च नरम होई जंदे न.
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry them in ghee and take them out, then mix in at the end. On adding them earlier they become soft in the upma.

seg.6cb14eaca16a.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా · जीडिपप्पु उपमा दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. घ्यो च सुनैह्री तले दे जीडिपप्पु काजुएं कन्नै आंध्र दा रवा उपमा, नरम ते झट्ट बनने आह्ला सवेर दा टिफिन. कदम-ब-कदम तरीका, नुक्ते ते सुआल-जवाब. 3 जनें आस्तै.
seg.8b57b24af158.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick-to-make morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers. For 3 people.

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: जीडिपप्पु उपमा: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: कोडी वेपुडु आंध्र दा सुक्का चिकन फ्राई ऐ: चिकन दे निक्के टुकड़े अपने गै रस च पकाए जंदे न, फ्ही कड़ी पत्ते, हरी मिर्चें ते तुरंत भुन्ने दे मसाले कन्नै तेलै च तगड़े तले जंदे न, जिच्चर ओह् गूढ़े ते मसाले कन्नै चिपचिपे नेईं होई जंदे. एह् आंध्र दे ब्याहें च स्टार्टर ऐ ते घरै च रसम-चौलें जां पप्पु दे कन्नै रक्खी जाने आह्ली साइड डिश.
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is Andhra's dry chicken fry: small pieces of chicken are cooked in their own juice, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and freshly roasted masala, until they become deep and sticky with masala. It is a starter at Andhra weddings and at home a side dish kept alongside rasam-rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: साढ़ा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर इसी गूढ़ा लाल रंग ते ओह् तिखास दिंदा ऐ जिसदे आस्तै आंध्र दे फ्राई जाने जंदे न, साढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर मसाले च पांदा ऐ, ते साढ़ी साबत काजू गिरी, सुनैह्री तली दी, अखीर च पांदी ऐ. साइड डिश दे तौर पर 4 जनें आस्तै.
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that heat for which Andhra fries are known, our turmeric powder goes into the masala, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. For 4 people as a side dish.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: चिकन गी तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, अदरक-लसन दे पेस्ट ते निंबू च लपेटियै रक्खो, उसदे अपने रस च पकाओ, फ्ही कड़ी पत्ते, हरी मिर्चें, भुन्ने दे मसाले ते काजुएं कन्नै सुक्का तलो.
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Keep the chicken coated in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook in its own juice, then fry dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g बिना हड्डी दा चिकन ⟦1⟧1 इंच दे टुकड़ें च कट्टेआ दा; जां 600 g हड्डी आह्ले निक्के टुकड़े⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1 inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15 काजू ⟦1⟧साबत काजू गिरी; बड्डे होन तां अद्धे करो⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; if big then halve⟦/1⟧

seg.e43b68ea429f.t: 2 टैह्नियां कड़ी पत्ता ⟦1⟧पत्ते तोड़े दे, तकरीबन 30⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: चिकन गी कप्पड़े कन्नै थपथपाइयै सुक्का करो तां जे मसाला चिपकै.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so that the masala sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: चिकन गी तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी, अदरक-लसन दे पेस्ट, निंबू दे रस ते लूण च 30 मिंट लपेटियै रक्खो. हत्थें कन्नै चंगी चाल्ली रलाओ तां जे हर टुकड़े पर मसाला चढ़ी जा.
seg.075327f4deca.back: Keep the chicken coated for 30 minutes in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt. Mix well with hands so that masala gets on every piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: इस बिच्च, साबत धनिया, जीरा, सौंफ, लौंग ते दालचीनी गी इक निक्के पैन च मट्ठी अग्गी पर बिना तेलै दे भुन्नो जिच्चर खुशबो नेईं औन लगदी ते इक रंग गूढ़े नेईं होई जंदे, तकरीबन 2 मिंट. ठंडा करियै मोटा पाउडर पीसो. एह् फ्राई दा मसाला ऐ.
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile, dry-roast whole coriander, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low flame without oil until aroma starts coming and they become one shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: चिकन गी बिना पानी दे इक भारी कड़ाही च पाओ, ढक्की देओ ते मध्धम अग्गी पर रक्खो.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken without water in a heavy kadai, cover and keep on medium flame.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: ढक्कियै उसदे अपने रस च पकाओ जिच्चर कोई गुलाबीपन नेईं बचदा, तकरीबन 12 मिंट. इक-दो बारी हलाओ; पकदे होई चिकन पानी छोड़दा ऐ.
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook covered in its own juice until no pinkness remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; while cooking the chicken releases water.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: ढक्कन हटाओ ते तेज़ अग्गी पर हलांदे होई पकाओ, जिच्चर पानी तकरीबन सुक्की नेईं जंदा, 3–4 मिंट. चिकन गी इक थाली च कड्ढो ते कड़ाही पूंझी लैओ.
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Remove the lid and cook on high flame while stirring, until the water almost dries up, 3–4 minutes. Take the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.t: कड़ाही च मध्धम अग्गी पर तेल गर्म करो.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadai on medium flame.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: काजुएं गी तेलै च सुनैह्री होने तगर तलो; कड्ढी लैओ. इस च इक मिंट शा घट्ट लगदा ऐ, इस करी लगातार हलांदे रवो ते छेकें आह्ले चमचे कन्नै कड्ढो.
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take them out. This takes less than a minute, so keep stirring continuously and take out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: जेकर बरता करदे ओ तां प्याज पाओ, ते सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो. हरी मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता भुन्नो. पिच्छें होई जाओ; पत्ते चटकदे ते छिड़कदे न.
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If you are using it add the onion, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and splutter.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: चिकन ते फ्राई दा मसाला पाओ. तेज़ अग्गी पर सुक्का ते गूढ़ा होने तगर तलो, फ्ही काजू पाइयै उछालो. 6–8 मिंट उछालदे रवो, जिच्चर मसाला टुकड़ें कन्नै चिपकी नेईं जंदा ते कंढे गूढ़े ते कुरकुरे नेईं होई जंदे.
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and the fry masala. Fry on high flame until dry and deep, then add the cashews and toss. Keep tossing 6–8 minutes, until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges become deep and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: चक्खो, लोड़ होऐ तां लूण पाओ, हरा धनिया छिड़को ते गर्म परोसो.
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, add salt if needed, sprinkle green coriander and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: अखीर च तेज़ अग्गी पर तलो तां जे मसाला हर टुकड़े कन्नै चिपकी जा.
seg.349c72ce839a.back: At the end fry on high flame so that the masala sticks to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ. दरम्यानी तिखास आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा बरतो, जां लाल रंग ते घट्ट तिखास आस्तै उसदी थाह्र सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर बरतो.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour and less heat use Sannam chilli powder in its place.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: टुकड़े निक्के ते इक बरोबर कट्टो तां जे ओह् इक्कै बेल्लै अंदर तगर पकन ते फ्राई च चंगी चाल्ली कुरकुरे होन.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and even so that they cook through to the inside at the same time and become nicely crisp in the fry.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: फ्राई दा मसाला पकाने शा ठीक पैह्लें पीसो; भुन्ने दे मसालें दी खुशबो गै चंगे वेपुडु दी जान ऐ.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the fry masala just before cooking; the aroma of roasted spices is the very life of a good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: हड्डी आह्ला: 600 g हड्डी आह्ले निक्के टुकड़े बरतो ते उनेंगी उंदे रस च 18–20 मिंट पकाओ, जिच्चर हड्डी कोल कोई गुलाबीपन नेईं बचदा.
seg.62d6684e446e.back: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juice for 18–20 minutes, until no pinkness remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: कोब्बरी वेपुडु: फ्राई च मसाले कन्नै 3 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा सुक्का नारियल पाओ ते भूरा होने तगर उछालो.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari vepudu: in the fry add 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut with the masala and toss until brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g बिना हड्डी दे मटन गी मसाले ते ½ कप पानी कन्नै 5–6 सीटियां लाइयै प्रेशर कुकर च पकाओ, फ्ही इस्सै चाल्ली तलो.
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless mutton with masala and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles, then fry the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: रसम-चौलें, पप्पु ते चौलें जां सांबर-चौलें कन्नै साइड डिश दे तौर पर गर्म परोसो, जां कट्टे दे प्याज ते निंबू दियें फांकें कन्नै स्टार्टर दे तौर पर कल्ला.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot as a side dish with rasam-rice, pappu and rice or sambar-rice, or alone as a starter with chopped onion and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: ढक्कियै फ्रिज च 2 दिनें तगर रक्खो. गर्म पैन च तेलै दियां किश बूंदां पाइयै अंदर तगर भाप निकलने तगर गर्म करो; एह् फ्ही कुरकुरा होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Heat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steam comes out right through the inside; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: आंध्र च चिकन फ्राई ते चिकन करी च के फर्क ऐ?
seg.551573b4b443.back: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: वेपुडु सुक्का होंदा ऐ: चिकन अपने गै रस च पकाया जंदा ऐ, फ्ही तलेआ जंदा ऐ जिच्चर मसाला बिना ग्रेवी दे उस पर चढ़ी नेईं जंदा. कोडी कूरा चौलें आस्तै प्याज-टमाटर दी ग्रेवी आह्ली करी ऐ.
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juice, then fried until the masala coats it without gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: वेपुडु आस्तै बिना हड्डी दा चिकन बरतचै जां हड्डी आह्ला?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: Should boneless or bone-in chicken be used for vepudu?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: दोऐ चलदे न. बिना हड्डी दा झट्ट पकदा ऐ ते होर कुरकुरा होंदा ऐ; हड्डी आह्ले निक्के टुकड़ें च सुआद मता होंदा ऐ पर उनेंगी अपने रस च तकरीबन 8 मिंट होर लगदे न.
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and is crisper; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 more minutes in their own juice.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: सारें शा मोटे टुकड़े गी कट्टियै खोलो. चिकन तां पक्का ऐ जिसलै बिच्च (जां हड्डी कोल) कोई गुलाबीपन नेईं बचदा ते रस साफ निकलदा ऐ.
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is done when no pinkness remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice comes out clear.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: कोडी वेपुडु गी घट्ट तिक्खा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How to make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 निक्का चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बरतो, जां उसदी थाह्र सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर पाओ, ते सिर्फ 2 हरी मिर्चां चीरो. काजू ते कड़ी पत्ता सुआद भरपूर रक्खदे न.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or add Sannam chilli powder in its place, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: కోడి వేపుడు · कोडी वेपुडु (आंध्र चिकन फ्राई) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra chicken fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: కోడి వేపుడు. आंध्र चिकन फ्राई: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ते हल्दी पाउडर च लपेटेआ चिकन, कड़ी पत्ते, हरी मिर्चें, भुन्ने दे मसाले ते साढ़े काजुएं कन्नै सुक्का तलेआ दा.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken coated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted spices and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: कोडी वेपुडु: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6c7ec0c5bf7b.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा ⟦1⟧(आंध्र दे निंबू आह्ले चौल)⟦/1⟧

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा आंध्र दे घरें दे चमकदे पीले निंबू आह्ले चौल न: पके दे चौलें गी मूंगफली, छोलें दी दाल, माह् दी दाल, राई, हरी मिर्चें ते कड़ी पत्ते दे चटकदे तड़के कन्नै रलाया जंदा ऐ, फ्ही निंबू दे रस कन्नै खट्टा कीता जंदा ऐ. एह् ओह् चौल न जेह्ड़े रेल सफर, स्कूल दे टिफिन बॉक्स ते मंदर आह्ले दिनें आस्तै पैक कीते जंदे न, ते त्यौहारें ते पूजाएं आस्तै बड्डे घानें च बनदे न.
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice is mixed with a crackling tempering of groundnuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard, green chillies and curry leaves, then made sour with lemon juice. This is the rice which is packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: साढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर किश सकिंटें आस्तै गर्म तेलै च पांदा ऐ, जिस कन्नै हर दाना इक बरोबर सुनैह्री पीला होई जंदा ऐ ते उसदा कच्चापन चली जंदा ऐ. एह् रेसिपी 4 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which makes every grain evenly golden yellow and its rawness goes away. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: कुल समें च चौल पकाना ते 15 मिंट पेदा रक्खना शामल ऐ तां जे सुआद टिकी जान.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: The total time includes cooking the rice and keeping it standing 15 minutes so that the flavours settle.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: मूंगफली, दालें, राई, मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता तेलै च भुन्नो, हल्दी पाउडर ते हींग पाओ, फ्ही ठंडे चौलें, लूण ते निंबू दे रस कन्नै रलाओ.
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry groundnuts, dals, mustard, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and asafoetida, then mix with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 कप चौल ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, तकरीबन 200 g; इस कन्नै तकरीबन 3 कप पके दे चौल बनदे न⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; this makes about 3 cups cooked rice⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 कप पके दे चौल ⟦1⟧थोढ़े सख्त पकाए दे, दाने बक्खरे-बक्खरे⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे निंबू दा रस ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 2 निंबुएं दा; सुआद मताबक होर पाओ⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧आमतौर पर मूंगफली दा तेल बरतेआ जंदा ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.985dfde69f06.t: 1 निक्का चमचा कद्दूकस कीता दा अदरक ⟦1⟧मर्जी मताबक⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: चौल धोओ ते 2 कप पानी कन्नै बस पकने तगर पकाओ, तां जे दाने बक्खरे रौह्न. तुसेंगी तकरीबन 3 कप पके दे चौल चाहिदे न.
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook with 2 cups water just until cooked, so that the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups cooked rice.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: पके दे चौलें गी ठंडा करने आस्तै इक थाली च फलाओ; लूण पाओ. कांटे कन्नै उनेंगी खिलारो ते तकरीबन 10 मिंट रक्खी देओ जिच्चर ओह् कोसे नेईं होई जंदे, गर्म नेईं, तां जे रलांदे बेल्लै दाने नेईं टुट्टन.
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Fluff it with a fork and leave about 10 minutes until it becomes lukewarm, not hot, so that the grains do not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: तेल गर्म करो; मूंगफली, दालें, राई, मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता भुन्नो. मूंगफली कन्नै मध्धम अग्गी पर शुरू करो ते उनेंगी तकरीबन 2 मिंट भुन्नो जिच्चर ओह् चटकन नेईं लगदियां ते छिल्के गूढ़े नेईं होई जंदे.
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat the oil; fry groundnuts, dals, mustard, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the groundnuts on medium flame and fry them about 2 minutes until they start crackling and the skins become dark.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: छोलें दी दाल ते माह् दी दाल पाओ ते हल्की सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो, तकरीबन 1 मिंट.
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: राई पाओ ते तिड़कन देओ, फ्ही सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां, हरी मिर्चां, अदरक ते कड़ी पत्ता पाओ ते किश सकिंट भुन्नो जिच्चर पत्ते कुरकुरे नेईं होई जंदे.
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard and let it splutter, then add dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves become crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: हल्दी पाउडर ते हींग पाइयै हलाओ; अग्ग बंद करो. सिर्फ 5–10 सकिंट हलाओ तां जे हल्दी गर्म तेलै च पकी जा पर सड़ै नेईं.
seg.6e856356980b.back: Add turmeric powder and asafoetida and stir; turn off the flame. Stir only 5–10 seconds so that the turmeric cooks in the hot oil but does not burn.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: चौलें पर पाओ, निंबू दा रस पाओ ते हौली-हौली रलाओ. उंगलियां जां चपटा कड़छा बरतो ते चौलें गी थल्लेआ चुक्को तां जे हर दाना पीला होई जा पर गुलगुला नेईं होऐ.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add lemon juice and mix gently. Use fingers or a flat ladle and lift the rice from below so that every grain becomes yellow but does not become mushy.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: चक्खो ते लोड़ होऐ तां होर लूण जां निंबू दा रस पाओ. चौल साफ तौर पर खट्टे ते लूणे लगने चाहिदे न, कीजे पेदा रेहने पर सुआद नरम होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and if needed add more salt or lemon juice. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, because on standing the flavour softens.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: परोसने शा पैह्लें पुलिहोरा गी ढक्कियै 15 मिंट रक्खी देओ तां जे चौलें च निंबू ते तड़का रची जा.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving keep the pulihora covered 15 minutes so that the lemon and tempering soak into the rice.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: निंबू दा रस अग्ग बंद करियै पाओ तां जे उसदा खट्टापन तेज़ रौह्. पकाया दा निंबू दा रस कौड़ा होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add lemon juice after turning off the flame so that its sourness stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice becomes bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: चौल थोढ़े सख्त पकाओ ते रलाने शा पैह्लें ठंडे होन देओ; गर्म, नरम चौल लेई आंगर होई जंदे न.
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice a little firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice becomes like paste.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: हल्दी पाउडर गी तेलै च सिर्फ किश सकिंट गै रक्खो; सड़ी दी हल्दी गूढ़ा रंग ते कौड़ा सुआद दिंदी ऐ.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: सवेरै दे बचे दे चौल बधिया चलदे न, कीजे उंदे दाने पैह्लें गै सख्त ते बक्खरे होंदे न.
seg.747474140bbf.back: Leftover rice from the morning works excellently, because its grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: काजू: त्यौहार आह्ली पुलिहोरा आस्तै मूंगफली कन्नै 10 अद्धे काजू तलो.
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festive pulihora fry 10 cashew halves with the groundnuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: मामिडिकाया पुलिहोरा: निंबू दे रस दी थाह्र तड़के कन्नै 1 कप कद्दूकस कीता दा कच्चा अंब रलाओ.
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice mix 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: कद्दूकस कीता दा नारियल: हल्के चौलें आस्तै निंबू दे रस कन्नै 2 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा नारियल पाओ.
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for milder rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: कमरे दे तापमान पर दई, अचार जां पापड़ (अप्पडम) कन्नै परोसो. एह् टिफिन-बॉक्स ते सफर आस्तै मशहूर चौल न.
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or papad (appadam). This is the famous rice for tiffin boxes and journeys.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: एह् कमरे दे तापमान पर तकरीबन 6 घैंटे चंगी चाल्ली चलदे न, इस्सै करी सफर च लेई जंदे न. बचे दे चौल ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते इक दिनै दे अंदर खाई लैओ.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: It keeps well at room temperature about 6 hours, that is why it is taken on journeys. Keep leftover rice covered in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: मेरे निंबू आह्ले चौल कौड़े कीं लगदे न?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: जां तां निंबू दा रस पकाया गेआ, जां हल्दी तेलै च सड़ी गेई. हल्दी पाने शा पैह्लें चुल्हा बंद करो, ते निंबू दा रस सिर्फ चौलें च पाओ, अग्ग बंद करियै.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Either the lemon juice was cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Turn off the stove before adding turmeric, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, with the flame off.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: पुलिहोरा ते निंबू आह्ले चौलें च के फर्क ऐ?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: पुलिहोरा खट्टे कीते दे चौलें दा तेलुगु नां ऐ. चिंतपंडु पुलिहोरा इमली दे पेस्ट कन्नै खट्टी कीती जंदी ऐ; निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा निंबू आह्ली किस्म ऐ, बनाने च झट्ट ते रंग च हल्की.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name of soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon variety, quicker to make and lighter in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: निंबू आह्ले चौलें गी गुलगुला होने शा कि'यां बचाचै?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: How to save lemon rice from becoming mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: घट्ट पानी कन्नै चौल थोढ़े सख्त पकाओ, थाली च ठंडे करो, ते दबाने दी थाह्र थल्लेआ चुक्कियै हौली-हौली रलाओ.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.t: 3 कप चौलें आस्तै किन्ना निंबू दा रस?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: तकरीबन 3 बड्डे चमचे, 2 दरम्यानी निंबुएं दा रस. हौली-हौली पाओ ते चक्खदे रवो, कीजे निंबुएं दा खट्टापन बक्खरा-बक्खरा होंदा ऐ.
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add gradually and keep tasting, because the sourness of lemons varies.

seg.0251508f9c8b.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర · निंबू आह्ले चौलें दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. आंध्र दे निंबू आह्ले चौल: ठंडे चौलें गी मूंगफली ते दाल दे तड़के, साढ़े हल्दी पाउडर ते निंबू दे रस कन्नै रलाया दा. कदम-ब-कदम तरीका, नुक्ते ते सुआल-जवाब.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice mixed with a groundnut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.a6f13e97318a.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा (आंध्र दे निंबू आह्ले चौल) · 1acrefarms

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ebc4d47e1a30.t: 1 निक्का चमचा कद्दूकस कीता दा अदरक

seg.88fbc87f4a71.t: पसुपु अन्नम ⟦1⟧(आंध्र दे हल्दी आह्ले चौल)⟦/1⟧

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: पसुपु अन्नम सादे चौल न जेह्ड़े हल्दी कन्नै चमकदे पीले कीते जंदे न ते राई, छोलें दी दाल, कड़ी पत्ते ते हरी मिर्चें दे चटकदे तड़के च रलाए जंदे न, उप्पर तले दे काजू. आंध्र दे घर इसी लंच बॉक्स आस्तै, हफ्ते दे दिनें दे झट्ट खाने आस्तै ते पूजा आह्ले दिनें परशाद दे तौर पर बनांदे न, अक्सर सवेरै दे बचे दे चौलें कन्नै.
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice which is made bright yellow with turmeric and mixed into a crackling tempering of mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for the lunch box, for quick weekday meals and as prasad on puja days, often with leftover rice from the morning.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: साढ़ा प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर (कोंडा पसुपु) चौलें गी गूढ़ा पीला रंग ते मिट्टी आह्ली हल्दी दी खुशबो दिंदा ऐ, इस करी 4 जनें आस्तै अद्धा निक्का चमचा काफी ऐ. उस्सै तेलै च तले दे साबत काजू (जीडिपप्पु) कुरकुरापन जोड़दे न.
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric aroma, so for 4 people half a teaspoon is enough. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add crunch.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: कुल समें च पके दे चौलें गी ठंडा होने आस्तै तकरीबन 15 मिंट शामल न.
seg.38badedc8d11.back: The total time includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: चौल पकाओ ते ठंडे होन देओ. काजू, राई, छोलें दी दाल, मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता तेलै च भुन्नो, प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर पाओ ते चौल रलाओ.
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 कप चौल ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, तकरीबन 200 g; इस कन्नै तकरीबन 3 कप पके दे चौल बनदे न⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; this makes about 3 cups cooked rice⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ निक्का चमचा प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.t: 1 बड्डा चमचा घ्यो (मर्जी मताबक) ⟦1⟧अखीर च रलाया दा⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧mixed in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.afe3b0737680.t: ⟦1⟧हल्दी पाउडर⟦/1⟧ कन्नै बी बधिया बनदे न.
seg.afe3b0737680.back: It also turns out excellent with ⟦1⟧turmeric powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: चौलें गी 2–3 बारी पानी बदलियै धोओ ते पानी कड्ढी देओ.
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice 2–3 times changing the water and drain the water.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: चौल इस चाल्ली पकाओ जे दाने बक्खरे रौह्न, फ्ही ठंडे करने आस्तै इक थाली च फलाओ. पतीले जां प्रेशर कुकर (2 सीटियां) च 1 कप चौलें आस्तै 2 कप पानी बरतो, ते फलाने शा पैह्लें कांटे कन्नै खिलारी लैओ.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice in such a way that the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate to cool. In a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles) use 2 cups water for 1 cup rice, and fluff with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: चौलें गी तकरीबन 15 मिंट ठंडा होन देओ जिच्चर ओह् बस कोसे नेईं रेही जंदे. उंदे उप्पर लूण छिड़को.
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until it stays just lukewarm. Sprinkle salt over it.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: इक चौड़ी कड़ाही च मध्धम अग्गी पर तेल गर्म करो.
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadai on medium flame.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: काजुएं गी तेलै च सुनैह्री होने तगर तलो; कड्ढी लैओ. राई ते छोलें दी दाल पाओ. काजू इक थाली च रक्खो; ओह् तकरीबन 1 मिंट च सुनैह्री होई जंदे न.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take them out. Add mustard and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they become golden in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: जिसलै राई तिड़कै, माह् दी दाल ते सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां पाओ ते हलाओ.
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: When the mustard splutters, add urad dal and dry red chillies and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: जिसलै दाल सुनैह्री होई जा, मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता पाओ, फ्ही मट्ठी अग्गी पर हल्दी. कड़ी पत्ते कन्नै अदरक ते हींग पाओ, ते हल्दी गी सिर्फ 5–10 सकिंट हलाओ.
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal turns golden, add chillies and curry leaves, then turmeric on low flame. With the curry leaves add ginger and asafoetida, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: फौरन अग्ग बंद करो तां जे हल्दी नेईं सड़ै.
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Turn off the flame immediately so that the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: चौल, काजू ते लूण पाओ ते इक बरोबर पीले होने तगर हौली-हौली रलाओ. चपटा कड़छा बरतो ते दबाने दी थाह्र चुक्कियै मोड़ो, तां जे दाने साबत रौह्न.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add rice, cashews and salt and mix gently until evenly yellow. Use a flat ladle and fold by lifting instead of pressing, so that the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: लूण चक्खो, जेकर बरता करदे ओ तां घ्यो रलाओ, ढक्की देओ ते परोसने शा पैह्लें 5 मिंट रक्खी देओ तां जे चौलें च तड़का रची जा.
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste the salt, if you are using it mix in ghee, cover and leave 5 minutes before serving so that the tempering soaks into the rice.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: पैह्लें चौलें गी ठंडा करने आस्तै फलाओ तां जे दाने नेईं टुट्टन.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: First spread the rice to cool so that the grains do not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: हल्दी मट्ठी अग्गी पर पाओ ते सिर्फ किश सकिंट हलाओ; सड़ी दी हल्दी चौलें गी कौड़ा करी दिंदी ऐ.
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add turmeric on low flame and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर तगड़ा रंग दिंदा ऐ; 1 कप चौलें आस्तै ½ निक्के चमचे कन्नै शुरू करो ते जेकर होर गूढ़ा पीला चाहिदा ऐ तां गै इक चुटकी होर पाओ.
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives strong colour; for 1 cup rice start with ½ teaspoon and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: सवेरै दे बचे दे चौल बधिया चलदे न, बशर्ते दाने बक्खरे होन.
seg.505872469eb9.back: Leftover rice from the morning works excellently, provided the grains are separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: हल्दी पाउडर: साढ़ा रोज़ दा पसुपु हल्दी पाउडर बी इस्सै चाल्ली कम्म करदा ऐ; उन्ना गै ½ निक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; use the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: मूंगफली: होर कुरकुरेपन आस्तै काजुएं शा पैह्लें तेलै च 2 बड्डे चमचे कच्ची मूंगफली तलो.
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnuts: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw groundnuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: निंबू: चटपटे, पुलिहोरा आंगर चौलें आस्तै चौलें कन्नै अद्धे निंबू दा रस नचोड़ो.
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for tangy, pulihora-like rice squeeze the juice of half a lemon with the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: नारियल: चौलें कन्नै गै 2 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा नारियल रलाओ.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: mix in 2 tablespoons grated coconut along with the rice.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: गर्म जां कमरे दे तापमान पर दई, पापड़ (अप्पडालु) जां सुक्के आलू फ्राई कन्नै परोसो. लंच बॉक्स ते सफर आस्तै बी एह् चंगी चाल्ली पैक होंदे न.
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, papad (appadalu) or dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and journeys.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: उस्सै दिन खाना सारें शा बधिया ऐ. बचे दे चौल ढक्कियै फ्रिज च 1 दिन तगर रक्खो ते थोढ़ा पानी छिड़कियै गर्म करो.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Eating it the same day is best. Keep leftover rice covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and heat with a little water sprinkled.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: चौल इस चाल्ली पकाओ जे दाने बक्खरे रौह्न ते ठंडे होन देओ. काजू, राई, छोलें दी दाल, मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता तेलै च भुन्नो, मट्ठी अग्गी पर किश सकिंटें आस्तै हल्दी पाओ, फ्ही चौलें गी लूण कन्नै रलाओ.
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice in such a way that the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric for a few seconds on low flame, then mix the rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: हल्दी आह्ले चौलें च किन्ना हल्दी पाउडर पांदा ऐ?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 कप कच्चे चौलें (तकरीबन 3 कप पके दे) आस्तै तकरीबन ½ निक्का चमचा. प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर तगड़ा रंग दिंदा ऐ, इस करी घट्ट कन्नै शुरू करो ते लोड़ होऐ तां इक चुटकी होर पाओ.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: For 1 cup raw rice (about 3 cups cooked) about ½ teaspoon. Hill turmeric powder gives strong colour, so start with less and if needed add a pinch more.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: मेरे हल्दी आह्ले चौल कौड़े कीं न?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: हल्दी गर्म तेलै च सड़ी गेई, जां बड़ी मती पेई गेई. इसी मट्ठी अग्गी पर पाओ, सिर्फ किश सकिंट हलाओ ते चौल पाने शा पैह्लें अग्ग बंद करो.
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low flame, stir only a few seconds and turn off the flame before adding the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: के अ'ऊं बचे दे चौलें कन्नै पसुपु अन्नम बनाई सकनां?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: हां. बक्खरे दानें आह्ले बचे दे चौल बधिया चलदे न. तड़के च रलाने शा पैह्लें उंगलियें कन्नै गुठलियां तोड़ी लैओ.
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works excellently. Break the lumps with your fingers before mixing into the tempering.

seg.42238d687a8f.t: పసుపు అన్నం · पसुपु अन्नम दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: పసుపు అన్నం. पसुपु अन्नम, आंध्र दे हल्दी आह्ले चौल: पके दे चौल राई, छोलें दी दाल ते कड़ी पत्ते दे तड़के च, प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर ते तले दे काजुएं कन्नै रलाए दे. 4 जनें आस्तै.
seg.720281a9dc26.back: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed in a tempering of mustard, chana dal and curry leaves, with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.990c8e1c30cf.t: पसुपु अन्नम (आंध्र दे हल्दी आह्ले चौल) · 1acrefarms

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: पसुपु अन्नम: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ निक्का चमचा प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: रागी जावा पानी च पकाए दे रागी दे आटे दा पतला, पीने आह्ला दलिया ऐ, जेह्ड़ा आंध्र ते रायलसीमा दे मते घरें च रोज़ दा पेय ऐ. लूणी किस्म लस्सी कन्नै बनदी ऐ; एह् मिट्ठी किस्म दुद्धै कन्नै पतली कीती जंदी ऐ ते गुड़ कन्नै मिट्ठी, ते इसी नाश्ते च जां संञां स्टील दे गलास चा गर्म-गर्म पीता जंदा ऐ.
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a thin, drinkable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, which is an everyday drink in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty variety is made with buttermilk; this sweet variety is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk piping hot from a steel glass at breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: साढ़ा ताटि बेल्लम ताड़ दा गुड़ रागी दे मिट्टी आह्ले सुआद कन्नै जचदा ऐ ते जावा गी टॉफी आंगर भूरा रंग दिंदा ऐ. शुरू थमां अखीर तगर तकरीबन 15 मिंट लगदे न. एह् रेसिपी 2 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. From start to end it takes about 15 minutes. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: कुल समें च गुड़ पाने शा पैह्लें 2 मिंट रक्खने दा समां बी शामल ऐ.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: The total time also includes 2 minutes of resting before adding jaggery.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: रागी दे आटे गी पानी च घोलो, उबलदे पानी च गाढ़ा ते चमकदार होने तगर पकाओ, फ्ही दुद्ध पाओ. अग्ग बंद करियै ताड़ दा गुड़ ते लाची रलाओ.
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Dissolve the ragi flour in water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. With the flame off mix in palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ कप रागी दा आटा ⟦1⟧मंडुए दा आटा, तकरीबन 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 कप पानी ⟦1⟧1 कप आटा घोलने आस्तै, 1 कप उबालने आस्तै⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup for dissolving the flour, 1 cup for boiling⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा ताड़ दा गुड़ ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 30 g; जेकर होर मिट्ठा पसंद ऐ तां इक चमचा होर⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; if you like it sweeter then one spoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.0a94735294ba.t: इसी ⟦1⟧गन्ने दे गुड़⟦/1⟧ कन्नै मिट्ठा करो.

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.t: रागी दा आटा इक कटोरी च पाओ.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: रागी दे आटे गी 1 कप पानी च बिना गुठलियें दे मुलायम होने तगर फेंटो. व्हिस्क जां कांटा बरतो ते कुसै बी गुठली गी कटोरी दे पासे कन्नै दबाइयै तोड़ो.
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk the ragi flour in 1 cup water until smooth without lumps. Use a whisk or fork and break any lump by pressing it against the side of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: बचेआ दा 1 कप पानी इक भारी थल्ले आह्ले पैन च पाओ ते मध्धम अग्गी पर रक्खो.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Put the remaining 1 cup water in a heavy-bottomed pan and keep on medium flame.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: दूआ कप पानी उबालो, रागी पाओ ते मट्ठी अग्गी पर गाढ़ा ते चमकदार होने तगर हलाओ, 6–8 मिंट. पाने शा पैह्लें मिश्रण गी इक बारी होर हलाओ, कीजे आटा कटोरी दे थल्ले बैह्ई जंदा ऐ.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the second cup of water, add the ragi and stir on low flame until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Before adding, stir the mixture once more, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: लगातार हलांदे रवो. जावा तां पक्की ऐ जिसलै ओह् फिक्के गुलाबी-भूरे थमां गूढ़े, चमकदार भूरे रंग दी होई जा ते चमचे दी पिट्ठ पर चढ़ी जा.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring continuously. The java is done when it turns from pale pinkish-brown to a deep, glossy brown colour and coats the back of the spoon.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: दुद्ध पाओ ते 2 मिंट मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ. अग्ग बंद करो ते 2 मिंट रक्खी देओ. रिज्झदे बेल्लै इक-दो बारी हलाओ तां जे थल्ले नेईं लग्गै.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add the milk and let it simmer slowly 2 minutes. Turn off the flame and leave 2 minutes. While simmering stir once or twice so that it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: जिच्चर जावा पेदी ऐ, ताड़ दा गुड़ बारीक कद्दूकस करी लैओ, तां जे ओह् झट्ट पिघली जा.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java rests, grate the palm jaggery finely, so that it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: ताड़ दा गुड़ ते लाची रलाओ. गर्म परोसो. गुड़ पूरी चाल्ली पिघलने तगर हलाओ, फ्ही चक्खो ते लोड़ होऐ तां थोढ़ा होर पाओ.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Mix in palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve hot. Stir until the jaggery melts fully, then taste and if needed add a little more.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: गलासें जां कटोरियें च पाओ. जेकर पीने आस्तै बड़ी गाढ़ी ऐ, तां किश चमचे गर्म दुद्ध रलाओ.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into glasses or bowls. If it is very thick for drinking, then mix in a few spoons of hot milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: रागी दा आटा हमेशां पैह्लें पानी च घोलो; सिद्धा उबलदे पानी च पाया दा आटा गुठलियां बनाई दिंदा ऐ जेह्ड़ियां नेईं टुटदियां.
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always dissolve ragi flour in water first; flour put directly into boiling water makes lumps which do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: पकाने च जल्दबाजी नेईं करो; घट्ट पकी दी रागी कच्ची ते आटे आह्ली लगदी ऐ.
seg.966098732312.back: Do not hurry the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: गलास चा पीने आस्तै पतली जावा आस्तै 2 बड्डे चमचे रागी दा आटा बरतो; चमचे कन्नै खाने आह्ले दलिये आस्तै ⅓ कप बरतो.
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: For thin java to drink from a glass use 2 tablespoons ragi flour; for porridge eaten with a spoon use ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: सुक्के मेवें कन्नै: अखीर च किश कट्टे दे काजू जां बदाम ते इक चमचा किशमिश रलाओ.
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dry fruits: at the end mix in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: बिना दुद्धै दे: रागी गी 2½ कप पानी च पकाओ ते उबाल बंद होने पर गुड़ रलाओ; पतली, गूढ़ी जावा बनग.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and mix in jaggery when the boil stops; it will make a thin, deep java.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: नाश्ते आस्तै स्टील दे गलास जां कटोरी च गर्म परोसो, जां संञां किश बिस्कुटें जां मुरुकुलु कन्नै पेय दे तौर पर. किश लोक गर्मियें च इसी ठंडी पीना पसंद करदे न.
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve hot in a steel glass or bowl for breakfast, or in the evening as a drink with some biscuits or murukulu. Some people like to drink it cold in summer.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: जिस दिन बनै उस्सै दिन पीना सारें शा बधिया ऐ. बची दी जावा ढक्कियै फ्रिज च 1 दिन तगर रक्खो ते दबारा गर्म करदे बेल्लै, अग्ग बंद करियै, थोढ़ा गर्म दुद्ध रलाओ.
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Drinking it the same day it is made is best. Keep leftover java covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and while reheating, with the flame off, mix in a little hot milk.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: बिना गुठलियें दे रागी जावा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How to make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: पैह्लें रागी दे आटे गी कमरे दे तापमान आह्ले पानी च मुलायम होने तगर फेंटो, फ्ही इसी लगातार हलांदे होई उबलदे पानी च पाओ.
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk the ragi flour in room-temperature water until smooth, then add it to boiling water while stirring continuously.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: मिगी कि'यां पता लग्गै जे रागी जावा पक्की गेई ऐ?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How do I know that ragi java has cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: ओह् गूढ़ी ते चमकदार होई जंदी ऐ, इन्नी गाढ़ी जे चमचे दी पिट्ठ पर चढ़ी जा, ते उसदा सुआद आटे आह्ला नेईं रौंह्दा. मट्ठी अग्गी पर इस च तकरीबन 6–8 मिंट लगदे न.
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes deep and glossy, so thick that it coats the back of the spoon, and its taste does not remain floury. On low flame this takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: के अ'ऊं रागी जावा च ताड़ दा गुड़ बरती सकनां?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: हां. ताड़ दा गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) बारीक कद्दूकस करो ते चुल्हा बंद करने दे बाद रलाओ, तां जे दुद्ध नेईं फटै. एह् गूढ़ा रंग ते हल्की धूंएं आह्ली मिठास दिंदा ऐ.
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely and mix in after turning off the stove, so that the milk does not curdle. It gives a deep colour and lightly smoky sweetness.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: रागी जावा ते रागी माल्ट च के फर्क ऐ?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: एह् इक्कै पेय दे बक्खरे-बक्खरे नां न. रागी जावा तेलुगु नां ऐ; रागी माल्ट ओह् नां ऐ जेह्ड़ा अक्सर हट्टियें ते मेनू च लखोंदा ऐ.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: These are different names of the same drink. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is the name which is often written in shops and menus.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: రాగి జావ · मिट्ठी रागी जावा दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: రాగి జావ · Sweet ragi java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: రాగి జావ. आंध्र तरीके दी मिट्ठी रागी जावा: रागी दा आटा पानी च चमकदार होने तगर पकाया दा, दुद्धै कन्नै पतला कीता दा ते ताटि बेल्लम ताड़ दे गुड़ कन्नै मिट्ठा कीता दा. तरीका ते नुक्ते.
seg.708e3c523d72.back: రాగి జావ. Andhra-style sweet ragi java: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with tati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.8ee2205b2e8b.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा ताड़ दा गुड़

seg.7dee83c87fea.t: समुंदरी कंढे दी करी · 4 जनें आस्तै

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: इगुरु मास जां झींगें गी प्याज दे गाढ़े मसाले च तकरीबन सुक्का होने तगर पकाने दा आंध्र तरीका ऐ, तां जे मसाले हर टुकड़े कन्नै चिपकी जान. रोय्याला इगुरु समुंदरी कंढे दे जिलें, नेल्लोर थमां गोदावरी ते श्रीकाकुलम तगर, दा पकवान ऐ, जित्थें समुंदरी खाड़ियें ते समुंदर दे झींगे ऐतवार दे दपैह्र दे खाने च चौलें कन्नै खाए जंदे न.
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so that the spices stick to every piece. Royyala iguru is a dish of the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where backwater and sea prawns are eaten with rice in the Sunday lunch.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: साढ़ा प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर (कोंडा पसुपु) पैह्लें झींगें पर लगदा ऐ ते फ्ही मसाले च पांदा ऐ. तेजा मिर्च पाउडर गूढ़ा लाल रंग ते ओह् तगड़ी तिखास दिंदा ऐ जेह्ड़ी समुंदरी कंढे दे घरें गी पसंद ऐ, इस करी इसी अपने टब्बर मताबक घट्ट-बद्ध करो.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) first goes on the prawns and then into the masala. Teja chilli powder gives a deep red colour and that strong heat which coastal homes like, so adjust it as per your family.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: त्यारी च झींगें गी साफ करना ते हल्दी कन्नै 10 मिंट रक्खना शामल ऐ.
seg.885826f68de3.back: Preparation includes cleaning the prawns and keeping them with turmeric for 10 minutes.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: झींगें पर हल्दी ते लूण मलो. प्याज ते अदरक-लसन दा पेस्ट भुन्नो, तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ते धनिया पाउडर पाओ, फ्ही झींगें गी मसाले च पकाओ जिच्चर मसाला उंदे पर चढ़ी नेईं जंदा.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt on the prawns. Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g झींगे ⟦1⟧दरम्यानी साइज दे, छिल्लियै काली नाड़ी कड्ढी दी, साफ करने दे बाद तोले दे⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, peeled and black vein removed, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ निक्का चमचा लूण ⟦1⟧बंडियै, जां सुआद मताबक⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧divided, or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.8c4c1b789de7.t: 3 बड्डे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧आमतौर पर मूंगफली दा तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ निक्का चमचा प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु; ¼ निक्का चमचा झींगें आस्तै, ¼ निक्का चमचा मसाले आस्तै⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ निक्का चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧बड़ा तिक्खा; दरम्यानी तिखास आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा, हल्की आस्तै ½ निक्का चमचा बरतो⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, for mild ½ teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: झींगें गी छिल्लो ते काली नाड़ी कड्ढो, चंगी चाल्ली धोओ ते छलनी च पानी नचोड़ी देओ.
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Peel the prawns and remove the black vein, wash well and drain the water in a strainer.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: झींगें पर अद्धी हल्दी ते थोढ़ा लूण मलो; 10 मिंट बक्खरा रक्खी देओ. ¼ निक्का चमचा हल्दी ते ¼ निक्का चमचा लूण बरतो.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt on the prawns; keep aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: इक भारी कड़ाही च मध्धम अग्गी पर तेल गर्म करो ते राई पाओ. जिसलै राई तिड़कै, हरी मिर्चां ते कड़ी पत्ता पाओ.
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat oil in a heavy kadai on medium flame and add mustard. When the mustard splutters, add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: प्याजें गी तेलै च सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो, फ्ही अदरक-लसन दे पेस्ट गी पकने दी खुशबो औने तगर. प्याजें गी तकरीबन 8–10 मिंट लगदे न; पेस्ट गी तकरीबन 1 मिंट, जिच्चर कच्ची बास्सना नेईं चली जंदी.
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onions in the oil until golden, then the ginger-garlic paste until the cooked aroma comes. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes away.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: जेकर टमाटर बरता करदे ओ, तां हुन पाओ ते नरम ते गुदेदार होने तगर पकाओ, तकरीबन 4 मिंट.
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If you are using tomato, then add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: अग्ग मट्ठी करो. बाकी हल्दी, तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ते धनिया पाउडर पाओ; 1 मिंट भुन्नो. बचेआ दा लूण पाओ ते हलांदे रवो तां जे मसाले थल्ले नेईं लग्गन.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Make the flame low. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and keep stirring so that the spices do not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: पानी पाओ ते मसाले गी मध्धम अग्गी पर पकाओ जिच्चर कंढें पर तेल बक्खरा होन नेईं लगदा, तकरीबन 3–4 मिंट.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Add water and cook the masala on medium flame until oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: झींगे पाओ ते मुड़ने ते गुलाबी होने तगर पकाओ, 5–6 मिंट. अखीर च गरम मसाला पाओ. मध्धम-तेज़ अग्गी पर बार-बार हलाओ तां जे मसाला सुक्कियै झींगें पर चढ़ी जा.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until curled and pink, 5–6 minutes. At the end add garam masala. On medium-high flame stir again and again so that the masala dries and coats the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: पकने दी जांच करो: झींगे तां पक्के न जिसलै ओह् अंदर तगर गुलाबी ते अपारदर्शी होन ते ढिल्ले C आंगर मुड़ी जान. जेकर पक्का नेईं पता, तां इक कट्टियै खोलो; बिच्च कोई सलेटी, आर-पार दिक्खने आह्ला हिस्सा नेईं होना चाहिदा.
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check for doneness: the prawns are done when they are pink and opaque right through to the inside and curl like a loose C. If not sure, then cut one open; there should be no grey, see-through part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: लूण चक्खो, हरा धनिया छिड़को ते अग्ग बंद करो. झींगे पकने दे बाद पकांदे नेईं रवो, नेईं तां ओह् रबड़ आंगर होई जंदे न.
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste the salt, sprinkle green coriander and turn off the flame. Do not keep cooking the prawns after they are cooked, otherwise they become like rubber.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: तेजा बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ: 1½ निक्का चमचा उस चाल्ली दा बड़ा तिक्खा इगुरु बनांदा ऐ जि'यां समुंदरी कंढे दे घरें गी पसंद ऐ; दरम्यानी तिखास आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा, जां हल्की आस्तै ½ निक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: 1½ teaspoons makes a very hot iguru of the kind coastal homes like; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for mild ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: प्याजें गी चंगी चाल्ली सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो; इगुरु दा रंग ते गाढ़ापन चंगी चाल्ली भुन्ने दे प्याजें थमां गै औंदा ऐ.
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onions well until golden; the colour and thickness of the iguru come only from well-fried onions.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: झींगे झट्ट पकदे न. ढिल्ला C आकार मतलब पक्के; कस्सेआ दा O मतलब बड़े पकी गे ते चबने आह्ले.
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A loose C shape means cooked; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: धोने दे बाद झींगें गी थपथपाइयै सुक्का करो तां जे ओह् पानी च उबलने दी थाह्र मसाले च तलोन.
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing pat the prawns dry so that they fry in the masala instead of boiling in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: थोढ़े तेलै च मुरझाए ते मसले दे ½ कप गोंगुरा पत्ते झींगें कन्नै रलाओ.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: mix ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted and mashed in a little oil, with the prawns.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: नारियल: नरम, भरपूर मसाले आस्तै अखीरी 2 मिंटें च 2 बड्डे चमचे कद्दूकस कीता दा नारियल जां 3 बड्डे चमचे गाढ़ा नारियल दुद्ध पाओ.
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a softer, richer masala add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: ग्रेवी आह्ला: चौलें पर पाने आस्तै पतली रोय्याला कूरा आस्तै झींगें दे बाद ¾ कप पानी पाओ.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: With gravy: for a thinner royyala kura for pouring over rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: गर्म उबले दे चौलें ते इक चमचा घ्यो कन्नै परोसो, जां रसम जां सांबर-चौलें कन्नै. चपाती कन्नै बी बधिया लगदा ऐ.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve with hot boiled rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar-rice. It also tastes excellent with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: बचेआ दा ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 1 दिनै दे अंदर खाई लैओ. पैन च हौली-हौली गर्म करो; मता चिर गर्म करने कन्नै झींगे सख्त होई जंदे न.
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Keep the leftover covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat gently in a pan; heating for a long time makes the prawns hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: मिगी कि'यां पता लग्गै जे झींगे पक्की गेदे न?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How do I know that the prawns have cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: ओह् अंदर तगर गुलाबी ते अपारदर्शी होई जंदे न ते ढिल्ले C आकार च मुड़ी जंदे न, आमतौर पर गर्म मसाले च 5–6 मिंटें च. बिच्च सलेटी, आर-पार दिक्खने आह्ला हिस्सा मतलब उनेंगी थोढ़ा होर समां चाहिदा ऐ.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and opaque right through to the inside and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in hot masala. A grey, see-through part in the middle means they need a little more time.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: इगुरु ते वेपुडु च के फर्क ऐ?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: इगुरु प्याज दे मसाले च गाढ़ा ते तकरीबन सुक्का होने तगर पकाया जंदा ऐ, ते मसाला झींगें कन्नै चिपकेआ दा रौंह्दा ऐ. वेपुडु इक फ्राई ऐ, जिस च प्याज दी ग्रेवी घट्ट जां बिल्कुल नेईं होंदी, ते झींगें दे कंढे कुरकुरे होने तगर पकाया जंदा ऐ.
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, and the masala stays stuck to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, in which there is little or no onion gravy, and the prawns are cooked until the edges are crisp.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: रोय्याला इगुरु गी घट्ट तिक्खा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How to make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: दरम्यानी तिखास आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर जां हल्की आस्तै ½ निक्का चमचा बरतो, ते हरी मिर्चां नेईं पाओ. अखीर च इक बड्डा चमचा दई जां नारियल दुद्ध बी तिखास नरम करदा ऐ.
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: For medium heat use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or for mild ½ teaspoon, and do not add green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.

seg.d024c66a11b8.t: के अ'ऊं जमे दे (फ्रोज़न) झींगे बरती सकनां?
