seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: हां. उनेंगी फ्रिज च पिघलाओ, पानी चंगी चाल्ली नचोड़ो ते हल्दी ते लूण मलने शा पैह्लें थपथपाइयै सुक्का करो. जमे दे झींगे मता पानी छोड़दे न, इस करी मसाले गी थोढ़ा होर पकाओ.
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, squeeze out the water well and pat dry before rubbing turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.

seg.3120e29b987a.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు · रोय्याला इगुरु दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. रोय्याला इगुरु, समुंदरी कंढे आह्ले आंध्र दा झींगा रोस्ट: प्हाड़ी हल्दी पाउडर ते बड़े तिक्खे तेजा मिर्च पाउडर कन्नै प्याज दे मसाले च पकाए दे झींगे. 4 जनें आस्तै.
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and very hot Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: रोय्याला इगुरु: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.231bf528146c.t: सुन्नुंडलु ⟦1⟧(माह् दी दाल ते गुड़ दे लड्डू)⟦/1⟧

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: सुन्नुंडलु आंध्र दे माह् दी दाल दे लड्डू न: दली दी माह् दी दाल मेवे आह्ली खुशबो औने तगर भुन्नी जंदी ऐ, गुड़ कन्नै बारीक पीसी जंदी ऐ ते गर्म घ्यो कन्नै बन्नी जंदी ऐ. चाशनी नेईं बनानी पौंदी, इस करी एह् तकरीबन अद्धे घैंटे च बनी जंदे न. आंध्र दे घर संक्रांति ते दीवाली आस्तै इक डब्बा भरी लैंदे न, परदेस जाने आह्ले रिश्तेदारें आस्तै पैक करदे न, ते संञां चाह् कन्नै मिठाई दे तौर पर रक्खदे न.
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: split urad dal is roasted until a nutty aroma comes, ground fine with jaggery and bound with hot ghee. No syrup has to be made, so they get made in about half an hour. Andhra homes fill a box for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives going abroad, and keep them as a sweet with evening tea.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: साढ़ा ताटि बेल्लम ताड़ दा गुड़ सुन्नुंडलु गी गूढ़ा भूरा रंग ते भरपूर, हल्की धूंएं आह्ली मिठास दिंदा ऐ जेह्ड़ी भुन्नी दी दाल कन्नै जचदी ऐ. इस रेसिपी कन्नै तकरीबन 15 लड्डू बनदे न.
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, lightly smoky sweetness which suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: कुल समें च पीसने शा पैह्लें भुन्नी दी दाल गी ठंडा करने दा समां बी शामल ऐ.
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: The total time also includes the time for cooling the roasted dal before grinding.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: माह् दी दाल सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो, ठंडी करियै बारीक पीसो, फ्ही ताड़ दा गुड़ ते लाची पाइयै पीसो. गर्म घ्यो कन्नै रलाओ ते लड्डू बनाओ.
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast the urad dal until golden, cool and grind fine, then add palm jaggery and cardamom and grind. Mix with hot ghee and make laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 कप चिट्टी माह् दी दाल ⟦1⟧दली दी, बिना छिल्के (मिनपप्पु), तकरीबन 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, without skin (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 कप कद्दूकस कीता दा ताड़ दा गुड़ ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 180 g, हल्का दबाइयै भरेआ; पैह्लें टुकड़ें गी कुट्टो जां कद्दूकस करो⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly pressed and filled; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ कप घ्यो ⟦1⟧पिघलेआ दा ते गर्म; 1–2 बड्डे चमचे होर कोल रक्खो⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons more at hand⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: माह् दी दाल चा निक्के पत्थर चुगी लैओ. इसी धोओ नेईं; भुन्नने आस्तै इसदा सुक्का रौह्ना ज़रूरी ऐ.
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick out small stones from the urad dal. Do not wash it; for roasting it is necessary for it to stay dry.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: दाल गी इक भारी पैन च मट्ठी अग्गी पर रक्खो.
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Keep the dal in a heavy pan on low flame.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: माह् दी दाल गी मट्ठी अग्गी पर बिना तेलै दे सुनैह्री ते मेवे आह्ली खुशबो औने तगर भुन्नो, तकरीबन 10 मिंट. लगातार हलांदे रवो तां जे हर दाना इक बरोबर रंगोऐ; इसदी भुन्नने आह्ली खुशबो औनी चाहिदी ऐ ते इक दाना चबने पर कड़क करियै टुट्टना चाहिदा ऐ.
seg.65588a76c883.back: Roast the urad dal on low flame without oil until golden and a nutty aroma comes, about 10 minutes. Keep stirring continuously so that every grain colours evenly; its roasted aroma should come and a grain should break with a crack when chewed.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: दाल गी इक थाली च कड्ढो ते फलाई देओ. ठंडी करो, फ्ही बारीक पाउडर पीसो. छोटे-छोटे झटकें च पीसो तां जे मिक्सर गर्म नेईं होऐ, ते मोटे टुकड़ें गी छानियै फ्ही पीसो.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Take the dal out onto a plate and spread it. Cool, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so that the mixer does not get hot, and sieve the coarse bits and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: ताड़ दा गुड़ बारीक कद्दूकस करो, जां टुकड़ें गी कुंडी च कुट्टो, सख्त गुठलियां तोड़दे होई.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking the hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: मिक्सर दे जार च दाल दे पाउडर च गुड़ ते लाची पाउडर पाओ. गुड़ ते लाची गी इक बरोबर रलने तगर पीसो. किश झटके काफी न; सारा मसाला इक चौड़ी कटोरी च कड्ढी लैओ.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixer jar add jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind until the jaggery and cardamom mix evenly. A few bursts are enough; take out the whole mix into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: इक निक्के पैन च घ्यो पिघलाओ जिच्चर ओह् गर्म नेईं होई जंदा पर धूंआं नेईं देऐ.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: Melt ghee in a small pan until it becomes hot but does not smoke.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: गर्म घ्यो पाओ, चंगी चाल्ली रलाओ ते दबाइयै निक्के लड्डू बनाओ. पैह्लें मता सारा घ्यो पाओ, चमचे कन्नै रलाओ, फ्ही छूहने जोग ठंडा होने पर हत्थें कन्नै रलाओ.
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Add the hot ghee, mix well and press to make small laddus. First add most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then when cool enough to touch mix with hands.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: इक निक्की मुट्ठी लैओ ते उसी मुट्ठी च कस्सियै दबाओ, फ्ही तलियें बिच्च गोल घुमाओ. जेकर भुरभुरा होऐ, तां कटोरी च इक चमचा होर गर्म घ्यो पाइयै रलाओ.
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a small handful and press it tightly in your fist, then roll it round between the palms. If it is crumbly, then add one more spoon of hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: रक्खने शा पैह्लें लड्डुएं गी इक थाली च 15–20 मिंट सख्त होन देओ.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before storing let the laddus set firm on a plate for 15–20 minutes.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: दाल मट्ठी अग्गी पर भुन्नो तां जे ओह् बिना सड़े अंदर तगर भुन्नोई जा.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low flame so that it roasts right through to the inside without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: दाल पूरी चाल्ली ठंडी होने दे बाद गै पीसो; गर्म दाल मिक्सर च लेई आंगर होई जंदी ऐ.
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after it has cooled fully; hot dal becomes like paste in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: मसाला गर्म होंदे गै लड्डू बनाओ; घ्यो दी गर्मी कन्नै एह् सारें शा बधिया जुड़दा ऐ.
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Make the laddus while the mix is still warm; with the warmth of the ghee it binds best.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: ताड़ दे गुड़ दे टुकड़ें दी सख्ती बक्खरी-बक्खरी होंदी ऐ, इस करी मिक्सर च पाने शा पैह्लें उनेंगी कद्दूकस करो जां निक्का-निक्का कुट्टो.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: The hardness of palm jaggery pieces varies, so grate them or pound them small before putting in the mixer.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: गन्ने दा गुड़: उन्ना गै कद्दूकस कीता दा गन्ने दा गुड़ बरतो; रंग हल्का ते मिठास कैरेमल आह्ली होग.
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery; the colour will be lighter and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: छिल्के कन्नै: होर गूढ़े, दानेदार सुन्नुंडलु आस्तै छिल्के आह्ली काली माह् दी दाल बरतो, जि'यां किश ग्रां दे घर बनांदे न.
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: for darker, grainy sunnundalu use black urad dal with skin, as some village homes make.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: चीनी कन्नै: गुड़ दी थाह्र ¾ कप पीसी दी चीनी बरतो; फिक्के, मुंह च घुलने आह्ले लड्डू बनडन.
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: in place of jaggery use ¾ cup powdered sugar; it will make pale, melt-in-the-mouth laddus.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: संञां चाह् जां काफी कन्नै मिठाई दे तौर पर परोसो, जां संक्रांति ते दीवाली दी मिठाई दी थाली दे हिस्से दे तौर पर.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet with evening tea or coffee, or as part of the sweet platter of Sankranti and Diwali.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: कमरे दे तापमान पर हवाबंद स्टील दे डब्बे च रक्खो ते 2 हफ्तें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. गर्म मौसम च एह् फ्रिज च मता चिर चलदे न; खाने शा पैह्लें उनेंगी कमरे दे तापमान पर आई जान देओ.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel box at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In hot weather they last longer in the fridge; before eating let them come to room temperature.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.t: मेरे सुन्नुंडलु अपनी शक्ल कीं नेईं बनाई रखदे?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why don't my sunnundalu hold their shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: मसाले गी होर गर्म घ्यो चाहिदा ऐ, जां ओह् ठंडा होई गेआ ऐ. इक-दो चमचे घ्यो गर्म करो, रलाओ ते मसाला गर्म होंदे गै लड्डू बनाओ.
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mix needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled. Heat one or two spoons of ghee, mix in, and make the laddus while the mix is still warm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: के अ'ऊं ताड़ दे गुड़ कन्नै सुन्नुंडलु बनाई सकनां?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: हां. ताड़ दा गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) बारीक कद्दूकस करो जां कुट्टो ते गन्ने दे गुड़ जिन्ना गै बरतो. लड्डू गूढ़े होई जंदे न ते उंदा सुआद होर गैह्रा ते हल्का धूंएं आह्ला होंदा ऐ.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely and use the same amount as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become darker and their flavour deeper and lightly smoky.

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: कमरे दे तापमान पर हवाबंद डब्बे च तकरीबन 2 हफ्ते, ते फ्रिज च होर मता चिर. उनेंगी कड्ढने आस्तै सुक्का चमचा जां सुक्के हत्थ बरतो.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: About 2 weeks in an airtight box at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: माह् दी दाल छिल्के कन्नै बरतचै जां बिना छिल्के?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should urad dal be used with skin or without skin?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: आंध्र च दोऐ बनदे न. बिना छिल्के दी चिट्टी माह् दी दाल कन्नै मुलायम, हल्के भूरे लड्डू बनदे न; छिल्के आह्ली काली माह् दी दाल कन्नै गूढ़े, दानेदार.
seg.b12320430e22.back: Both are made in Andhra. White urad dal without skin makes smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin makes darker, grainy ones.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: సున్నుండలు. आंध्र दे सुन्नुंडलु: भुन्नी दी माह् दी दाल ताटि बेल्लम ताड़ दे गुड़ कन्नै पीसी दी ते गर्म घ्यो कन्नै बन्नियै लड्डू बनाए दे. कदम-ब-कदम तरीका, नुक्ते ते सुआल-जवाब.
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with tati bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.9357798f39be.t: सुन्नुंडलु (माह् दी दाल ते गुड़ दे लड्डू) · 1acrefarms

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: सुन्नुंडलु: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.7940a19ab961.t: 1 कप कद्दूकस कीता दा ताड़ दा गुड़

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी आंध्र दियें रसोइयें दी रोज़ दी चटनी ऐ: पके दे टमाटर भुन्नी दियें दालें कन्नै तेलै च गलने तगर पकाए जंदे न, फ्ही मिर्च, लसन ते थोढ़ी इमली कन्नै मोटे पीसे जंदे न. मते घर अजें बी इसी पत्थरै दी सिल (रोटि) पर पीसदे न तां जे खुरदरा, चमचे कन्नै खाने आह्ला बनै, हालांकि मिक्सर च छोटे झटके बी एह् कम्म करी दिंदे न. एह् गर्म चौलें ते घ्यो, डोसा, इडली ते पेसरट्टु कन्नै खाई जंदी ऐ.
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes are cooked with roasted dals in oil until melted, then coarsely ground with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it on a stone slab (rolu) so that it is coarse and eaten with a spoon, although short bursts in a mixer also do this job. It is eaten with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: साढ़ा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर इसी गूढ़ा लाल रंग ते टिकी दी, दरम्यानी तिखास दिंदा ऐ, ते टमाटरें कन्नै थोढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर बी पांदा ऐ. इस रेसिपी कन्नै तकरीबन 1½ कप बनदी ऐ.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and a steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder also goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: कुल समें च पीसने शा पैह्लें टमाटरें गी ठंडा होने आस्तै 5 मिंट बी शामल न.
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: The total time also includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: दालें ते मेथी गी तेलै च भुन्नो, टमाटरें गी हल्दी ते लूण कन्नै गलने तगर पकाओ, फ्ही सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर, लसन ते इमली कन्नै मोटा पीसो. अखीर च राई ते कड़ी पत्ते दा तड़का लाओ.
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry the dals and fenugreek in oil, cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until melted, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end temper with mustard and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 बड्डे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧मूंगफली जां तिलें दा तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ निक्का चमचा मेथी दाने ⟦1⟧मेथी; इस शा मते नेईं, नेईं तां पच्चडी कौड़ी होई जंदी ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧methi; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 दरम्यानी टमाटर ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 500 g, पके दे ते लाल, कट्टे दे⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 निक्के चमचे सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧होर तिक्खी पच्चडी आस्तै 1 बड्डे चमचे तगर⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: बंटे जिन्नी इमली ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 5 g, बीज कड्ढे दे⟦/1⟧

seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.t: ¼ कप हरा धनिया (मर्जी मताबक) ⟦1⟧मोटा कट्टेआ दा⟦/1⟧

seg.350dec8c6594.t: ½ निक्का चमचा माह् दी दाल

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: इक कड़ाही च मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर 2 बड्डे चमचे तेल गर्म करो.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a kadai on medium-low flame.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: माह् दी दाल, छोलें दी दाल ते मेथी गी तेलै च सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो; कड्ढी लैओ. इस च 2–3 मिंट लगदे न; लगातार हलांदे रवो, कीजे मेथी झट्ट सड़ियै कौड़ी होई जंदी ऐ.
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil until golden; take them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; keep stirring continuously, because fenugreek quickly burns and becomes bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: उस्सै तेलै च कट्टे दे टमाटर पाओ ते मध्धम अग्गी पर इक मिंट हलाओ.
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium flame.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: टमाटरें गी हल्दी ते लूण कन्नै नरम होने ते रस सुक्कने तगर पकाओ. पैह्ले 5 मिंट ढक्की देओ, फ्ही बिच-बिच च हलांदे होई बिना ढक्के पकाओ, कुल मिलाइयै तकरीबन 12–15 मिंट, जिच्चर टमाटर गुदेदार नेईं होई जंदे ते कंढें पर तेल नेईं लब्भन लगदा.
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered stirring in between, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes become pulpy and oil starts to show at the edges.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: अग्ग बंद करो, इमली रलाओ तां जे गर्मी च ओह् नरम होई जा, ते सारें गी तकरीबन 5 मिंट ठंडा होन देओ.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the flame, mix in the tamarind so that it softens in the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: पत्थरै दी सिल जां मिक्सर दे जार च, पैह्लें तली दियां दालें ते मेथी गी मोटा पाउडर पीसो.
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On a stone slab or in a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and fenugreek to a coarse powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: दालें, लसन, इमली, मिर्च पाउडर ते टमाटरें गी मोटा पीसो. मिक्सर च, दाल दे पाउडर च लसन, मिर्च पाउडर ते पके दे टमाटर पाओ ते बिना पानी दे 4–5 बारी चलाओ; जिच्चर अजें बी खुरदरापन होऐ, रुकी जाओ. जेकर बरता करदे ओ तां हरा धनिया रलाओ.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In the mixer, add garlic, chilli powder and the cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it is still coarse. If you are using it mix in green coriander.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: चक्खियै ठीक करो: इक चुटकी होर लूण, जां जेकर होर तिक्खी चाहिदी ऐ तां थोढ़ा होर मिर्च पाउडर पाइयै चलाओ.
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and correct: add a pinch more salt, or if you want it hotter then a little more chilli powder, and pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: पच्चडी गी इक कटोरी च कड्ढो. इक निक्के पैन च 1 बड्डा चमचा तेल गर्म करो ते राई पाओ; जिसलै ओह् तिड़कै, माह् दी दाल पाओ ते सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Take the pachadi out into a bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a small pan and add mustard; when it splutters, add urad dal and fry until golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: लाल मिर्चां, हींग ते कड़ी पत्ता पाओ ते किश सकिंट हलाओ.
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: राई, लाल मिर्चें ते कड़ी पत्ते दा तड़का लाओ; उप्पर पाओ. परोसने शा ठीक पैह्लें रलाओ.
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Temper mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour on top. Mix just before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: टमाटरें गी रस सुक्कने तगर पकाओ तां जे पच्चडी मता चिर टिकै ते कच्ची नेईं लग्गै.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook the tomatoes until the juice dries up so that the pachadi keeps long and does not taste raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: पके दे, गूढ़े लाल टमाटर सारें शा बधिया रंग दिंदे न; जेकर तुंदे टमाटर खट्टे न, तां इमली अद्धी करी देओ.
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour, then halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा चलाओ, मिक्सर लगातार नेईं चलाओ: आंध्र दे घरें गी मोटी पच्चडी पसंद ऐ, ते मुलायम पेस्ट च ओह् खुरदरापन चली जंदा ऐ.
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Pulse a little at a time, do not run the mixer continuously: Andhra homes like a coarse pachadi, and in a smooth paste that coarseness goes away.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर दरम्यानी तिखास दिंदा ऐ. 2 निक्के चमचें कन्नै शुरू करो ते चक्खने दे बाद होर पाओ; पच्चडी पेदी रेहने पर तिखास थोढ़ी घट्ट होई जंदी ऐ.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and add more after tasting; on standing the pachadi's heat reduces a little.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: हरी मिर्च: मिर्च पाउडर दी थाह्र 4–5 हरी मिर्चां बरतो, दालें कन्नै भुन्नी दियां.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: in place of chilli powder use 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: प्याज-टमाटर: टमाटर पाने शा पैह्लें 1 कट्टेआ दा प्याज नरम होने तगर भुन्नो.
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding the tomatoes fry 1 chopped onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: होर तिक्खी: 1 निक्के चमचे सन्नम दी थाह्र 1 निक्का चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बरतो; तेजा बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ, इस करी हौली-हौली पाओ.
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: in place of 1 teaspoon Sannam use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so add gradually.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: बिना लसन दे: लसन नेईं पाओ ते तड़के च इक चुटकी होर हींग पाओ.
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: do not add garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: इक चमचा गर्म चौलें च थोढ़े घ्यो कन्नै रलाओ, जां डोसा, इडली, पेसरट्टु जां उपमा कन्नै परोसो.
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix a spoon into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: इक साफ, सुक्के कच्चै दे मर्तबान च फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 4 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. हमेशां सुक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.t: आंध्र दी टोमाटो पच्चडी कि'यां बनांदे न?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How is Andhra tomato pachadi made?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: माह् दी दाल, छोलें दी दाल ते मेथी गी तेलै च भुन्नो, कट्टे दे टमाटरें गी हल्दी ते लूण कन्नै रस सुक्कने तगर पकाओ, फ्ही सारें गी मिर्च पाउडर, लसन ते इमली कन्नै मोटा पीसो. अखीर च राई, लाल मिर्च ते कड़ी पत्ते दा तड़का लाओ.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook the chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end temper with mustard, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: मेरी टोमाटो पच्चडी कौड़ी कीं ऐ?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: आमतौर पर मेथी दाने सड़ी गे जां बड़े मते पेई गे. 500 g टमाटरें आस्तै सिर्फ ¼ निक्का चमचा बरतो ते उनेंगी मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर भुन्नो, सुनैह्री होंदे गै कड्ढी लैओ.
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Usually the fenugreek seeds burnt or too many went in. For 500 g tomatoes use only ¼ teaspoon and fry them on medium-low flame, taking them out as soon as they are golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: के अ'ऊं बिना इमली दे टोमाटो पच्चडी बनाई सकनां?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: हां, जेकर तुंदे टमाटर काफी खट्टे न. पकाने दे बाद चक्खो; पके दे, मिट्ठे टमाटरें गी संतुलन आस्तै इमली दे उस निक्के टुकड़े दी लोड़ होंदी ऐ.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are quite sour. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need that small piece of tamarind for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी किन्ना चिर टिकदी ऐ?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How long does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: इक साफ, सुक्के मर्तबान च फ्रिज च तकरीबन 4 दिन, बशर्ते टमाटर चंगी चाल्ली पकाए गेदे होन ते तुस सुक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: About 4 days in a clean, dry jar in the fridge, provided the tomatoes were cooked well and you use a dry spoon.

seg.4dbd4103e7fb.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి · टोमाटो पच्चडी दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి. आंध्र दी टोमाटो पच्चडी: हल्दी पाउडर कन्नै गलने तगर पकाए दे टमाटर, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर, लसन ते इमली कन्नै मोटे पीसे दे, फ्ही तड़का लाया दा.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked until melted with turmeric powder, ground coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: टोमाटो पप्पु आंध्र दे घरें दी रोज़ दी दाल ऐ: अरहर दी दाल (कंदि पप्पु) टमाटरें ते हरी मिर्चें कन्नै नरम पकाई जंदी ऐ, मसलियै मुलायम कीती जंदी ऐ ते लसन दे तड़के कन्नै पूरी कीती जंदी ऐ. एह् हफ्ते दे मते दिनें बनदी ऐ ते गर्म चौलें, इक चमचा घ्यो ते कन्नै पापड़ (अप्पडम) जां अचार कन्नै खाई जंदी ऐ.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) is cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and completed with a garlic tempering. It is made most days of the week and is eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and papad (appadam) or pickle alongside.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: साढ़ा हल्दी पाउडर दाल कन्नै कुकर च पांदा ऐ ते उसी गूढ़ा पीला रंग दिंदा ऐ. सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर इक लाल झलक ते इक टिकी दी, दरम्यानी तिखास जोड़दा ऐ जेह्ड़ी खट्टे टमाटर दे पिच्छें रौंह्दी ऐ. एह् रेसिपी 4 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat which stays behind the sour tomato. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: कुल समें च कुकर दी भाप अपने आप निकलने दा समां बी शामल ऐ.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: The total time also includes the time for the cooker's steam to release on its own.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: अरहर दी दाल गी टमाटरें, हरी मिर्चें ते हल्दी पाउडर कन्नै प्रेशर कुकर च पकाओ, सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण कन्नै मसलो, ते अखीर च लसन ते राई दा तड़का लाओ.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook the toor dal in a pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and at the end temper with garlic and mustard.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ कप अरहर दी दाल ⟦1⟧कंदि पप्पु, तकरीबन 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ निक्का चमचा हल्दी पाउडर ⟦1⟧कुकर च पांदा ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes into the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 निक्का चमचा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧मसलने दे बाद पांदा ऐ; होर तिखास आस्तै 2 निक्के चमचें तगर⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for more heat⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ कप पानी ⟦1⟧ते ठीक करने आस्तै ½ कप होर⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧and ½ cup more for adjusting⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 बड्डा चमचा इमली दा पानी (मर्जी मताबक) ⟦1⟧जेकर टमाटर बड़े खट्टे नेईं न⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: अरहर दी दाल गी 2–3 बारी पानी बदलियै धोओ ते पानी कड्ढी देओ.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal 2–3 times changing the water and drain the water.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: दाल गी टमाटरें, हरी मिर्चें, प्याज ते 2½ कप पानी कन्नै प्रेशर कुकर च पाओ.
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: दाल गी टमाटरें, हरी मिर्चें ते हल्दी पाउडर कन्नै 4 सीटियां लाइयै प्रेशर कुकर च पकाओ. ढक्कन बंद करने शा पैह्लें हल्दी पाउडर पानी च रलाओ, फ्ही मध्धम अग्गी पर पकाओ.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Before closing the lid mix the turmeric powder into the water, then cook on medium flame.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: प्रेशर अपने आप उतरन देओ, तकरीबन 10 मिंट. दाल तां पक्की ऐ जिसलै इक दाना दो उंगलियें बिच्च पूरी चाल्ली मसलोई जा.
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure release on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes fully between two fingers.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: चंगी चाल्ली मसलो; मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण पाओ. लकड़ी दा घोटना (पप्पु गुत्ति) जां कड़छी दी पिट्ठ बरतो ते दाल गर्म होंदे गै मसलो, जिच्चर टमाटर ते दाल इक मुलायम मिश्रण नेईं बनी जंदे.
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal become one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: थोढ़ा पानी पाइयै 5 मिंट मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ. पतली करने आस्तै ½ कप तगर पानी पाओ, ते जेकर बरता करदे ओ तां इमली दा पानी, ते अग्ग मट्ठी रक्खो तां जे थल्ले नेईं लग्गै.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Add a little water and let it simmer slowly 5 minutes. To thin it add up to ½ cup water, and if you are using it the tamarind water, and keep the flame low so that it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: लूण ते खट्टापन चक्खो, फ्ही हरा धनिया रलाओ ते अग्ग बंद करो.
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste the salt and sourness, then mix in green coriander and turn off the flame.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: इक निक्के पैन च मध्धम अग्गी पर घ्यो गर्म करो ते राई पाओ; तिड़कन देओ.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: Heat ghee in a small pan on medium flame and add mustard; let it splutter.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: घ्यो च राई, जीरा, लसन ते कड़ी पत्ता भुन्नो; उप्पर पाओ. राई दे बाद जीरा, लसन ते सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां पाओ ते लसन सुनैह्री होने तगर भुन्नो, फ्ही कड़ी पत्ता ते हींग पाओ, ते छन-छन करदा तड़का दाल पर पाओ.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in ghee; pour on top. After the mustard add cumin, garlic and dry red chillies and fry until the garlic is golden, then add curry leaves and asafoetida, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: 2 मिंट ढक्की देओ तां जे तड़के दा सुआद दाल च रची जा, फ्ही हलाओ ते गर्म परोसो.
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Cover 2 minutes so that the tempering's flavour soaks into the dal, then stir and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: मुलायम पप्पु आस्तै दाल गर्म होंदे गै मसलो. ठंडी होने पर दाने जम्मी जंदे न ते गुठलीदार रौंह्दे न.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For smooth pappu mash the dal while it is still hot. On cooling the grains set and stay lumpy.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर दरम्यानी तिक्खा ऐ. 1 निक्के चमचे कन्नै शुरू करो; होर तिक्खे पप्पु आस्तै 2 निक्के चमचें तगर पाओ.
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; for hotter pappu add up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: पके दे, खट्टे देसी टमाटर (नाटु टमाटर) सारें शा बधिया सुआद दिंदे न; हल्के हाइब्रिड टमाटरें कन्नै इमली दा पानी पाओ.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour native tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: कड़ी पत्ता पाने शा पैह्लें तड़के च लसन गी सुनैह्री होन देओ; फिक्का लसन कच्चा लगदा ऐ.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Let the garlic in the tempering turn golden before adding curry leaves; pale garlic tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: तेजा मिर्च पाउडर: होर तिक्खे पप्पु आस्तै सन्नम दी थाह्र ½ निक्का चमचा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर बरतो. तेजा बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ, इस करी 1 निक्के चमचे शा मता नेईं पाओ.
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for hotter pappu use ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder in place of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not add more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: पालकूरा टोमाटो पप्पु: मसलने दे बाद दाल च 2 कप कट्टी दी पालक पाओ ते 5 मिंट मट्ठा-मट्ठा रिज्झन देओ.
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomato pappu: after mashing add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal and let it simmer slowly 5 minutes.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: पेसरपप्पु: इसी पीली मूंगी दी दाल कन्नै बनाओ ते सिर्फ 2 सीटियां लाओ.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and take only 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: गर्म उबले दे चौलें, इक चमचा घ्यो ते कन्नै पापड़ (अप्पडम) जां आवकाया (अंबै दा अचार) कन्नै गर्म परोसो. चपाती कन्नै बी बधिया लगदी ऐ.
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot with hot boiled rice, a spoon of ghee and papad (appadam) or avakaya (mango pickle) alongside. It also tastes excellent with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: बची दी दाल ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. ठंडी होने पर दाल गाढ़ी होई जंदी ऐ; परोसने शा पैह्लें थोढ़ा गर्म पानी पाइयै चंगी चाल्ली गर्म करो.
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Keep leftover dal covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. On cooling the dal becomes thick; before serving heat well adding a little hot water.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: प्रेशर कुकर च अरहर दी दाल आस्तै किन्नियां सीटियां?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: मध्धम अग्गी पर तकरीबन 4 सीटियां, फ्ही प्रेशर अपने आप उतरन देओ. पुरानी दाल जां चंगी चाल्ली नेईं धोती दी दाल गी 5 दी लोड़ पेई सकदी ऐ.
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium flame, then let the pressure release on its own. Old dal or dal not washed well may need 5.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: टोमाटो पप्पु ते सांबर च के फर्क ऐ?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: टोमाटो पप्पु इक गाढ़ी, मसली दी दाल ऐ जिस च सादा तड़का होंदा ऐ ते सांबर पाउडर जां सब्जियां नेईं होंदियां. सांबर पतला होंदा ऐ, ते उस च इमली, सब्जियां ते भुन्ने दे मसालें दा पाउडर पांदा ऐ.
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal in which there is a plain tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thin, and tamarind, vegetables and roasted spice powder go into it.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: के अ'ऊं बिना प्रेशर कुकर दे टोमाटो पप्पु बनाई सकनां?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: हां. दाल गी 30 मिंट भिगोओ ते ढक्के दे पतीले च 3½ कप पानी कन्नै तकरीबन 40–45 मिंट पकाओ, बिच-बिच च हलांदे होई, जिच्चर ओह् सौखी मसलोन नेईं लगदी.
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot with 3½ cups water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring in between, until it starts to mash easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: मेरा टोमाटो पप्पु बड़ा खट्टा कीं ऐ?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why is my tomato pappu very sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: किश टमाटर बड़े खट्टे होंदे न. दाल गी किश मिंट होर रिज्झन देओ ते संतुलन आस्तै इक चुटकी गुड़ जां इक चमचा होर मसली दी दाल रलाओ.
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Let the dal simmer a few more minutes and for balance mix in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon more of mashed dal.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: టమాటో పప్పు · आंध्र दी टमाटर दाल दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra tomato dal recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: టమాటో పప్పు. आंध्र दी टमाटर दाल: टमाटरें ते हरी मिर्चें, साढ़ी हल्दी ते सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर कन्नै नरम पकाई दी अरहर दी दाल, ते लसन दा तड़का. 4 जनें आस्तै.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: टोमाटो पप्पु: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f112ac607ab2.t: 1 बड्डा चमचा इमली दा पानी (मर्जी मताबक)

seg.87c5b474feae.t: पोडि · तकरीबन ¾ कप बनदा ऐ

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · वेल्लुल्लि कारम · लसन दी सुक्की चटनी

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम लसन-मिर्च दा ओह् पोडि ऐ जेह्ड़ा आंध्र दे खाने दे मेजें पर रक्खेआ रौंह्दा ऐ: लाल मिर्च पाउडर गी मते सारे लसन, भुन्ने दे धनिये ते जीरे, ते लूण कन्नै कुट्टेआ जंदा ऐ. गर्म चौलें दी पैह्ली मुट्ठी च घ्यो कन्नै रलाइयै, जां इडली ते डोसे पर थोढ़े तेलै कन्नै छिड़कियै, एह् रुझे दे दिनें च झट्ट खाना ऐ ते टिफिन बॉक्स दी पक्की चीज़.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Velluli karam is that garlic-chilli podi which stays kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder is pounded with lots of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed with ghee into the first handful of hot rice, or sprinkled with a little oil on idli and dosa, it is a quick meal on busy days and a sure item of the tiffin box.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: साढ़ा तेजा मिर्च पाउडर इसी गूढ़ा लाल ते बड़ा तिक्खा बनांदा ऐ, जि'यां गुंटूर दे घरें गी पसंद ऐ. घट्ट तिखास आस्तै, अद्धा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर बरतो.
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, as Guntur homes like. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: कुल समें च पीसने शा पैह्लें बीजें ते लसन गी ठंडा करने दा समां बी शामल ऐ.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: The total time also includes the time for cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: धनिया ते जीरा भुन्नो, पीसो, फ्ही तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, लूण ते हल्के गर्म कीते दे लसन कन्नै थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा चलाइयै मोटा पोडि बनाओ. इसी गर्म चौलें ते घ्यो, इडली जां डोसे कन्नै खाओ.
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast coriander and cumin, grind, then pulse a little at a time with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic to make a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 लसन दियां तुरियां ⟦1⟧तकरीबन ½ कप, छिल्लियां दियां; अंदर दा पतला छिल्का रेही सकदा ऐ⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ कप तेजा मिर्च पाउडर ⟦1⟧बड़ा तिक्खा; हल्का बनाने आस्तै नुक्ते दिक्खो⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it mild⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 निक्के बंटे जिन्नी इमली (मर्जी मताबक) ⟦1⟧सुक्की, बीज कड्ढे दे⟦/1⟧
seg.33ac26ca8201.back: Tamarind the size of 1 small marble (optional) ⟦1⟧dry, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: घ्यो जां तेल ⟦1⟧हर परोस आस्तै 1 निक्का चमचा⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon per serving⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: लसन छिल्लो ते तुरियें गी कप्पड़े कन्नै पूरी चाल्ली सुक्का करो; कोई बी पानी पोडि दे टिकने दा समां घट्ट करी दिंदा ऐ.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and dry the cloves fully with a cloth; any water at all reduces how long the podi keeps.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: धनिया ते जीरे गी खुशबो औने तगर बिना तेलै दे भुन्नो; ठंडा होन देओ. मध्धम-मट्ठी अग्गी पर निक्का पैन बरतो; इस च 1–2 मिंट लगदे न, ते धनिया इक रंग गूढ़ा होना चाहिदा ऐ, भूरा नेईं.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Dry-roast coriander and cumin without oil until aroma comes; let cool. Use a small pan on medium-low flame; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should be one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: लसन गी 1 निक्के चमचे तेलै च 2 मिंट गर्म करो. अग्ग मट्ठी रक्खो ते हलाओ; तुरियां कंढें पर थोढ़ियां नरम होनियां चाहिदियां न पर भूरियां नेईं. ठंडा होन देओ.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil for 2 minutes. Keep the flame low and stir; the cloves should become a little soft at the edges but not brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: बीजें गी पाउडर पीसो, फ्ही मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण कन्नै थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा चलाओ. जेकर बरता करदे ओ तां इमली बीजें कन्नै गै पाओ, तां जे ओह् इक बरोबर पीसोई जा.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds to powder, then pulse a little at a time with chilli powder and salt. If you are using it add the tamarind along with the seeds, so that it grinds evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: लसन पाओ ते छोटे-छोटे झटकें च चलाइयै मोटा, गिल्ला पाउडर बनाओ. हर 2–3 झटकें बाद रुकियै जार दे पासे खुरचो, कीजे लसन पासें कन्नै चिपकी जंदा ऐ.
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to make a coarse, moist powder. Every 2–3 bursts stop and scrape the sides of the jar, because garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: पत्थरै दी कुंडी च, पैह्लें बीज कुट्टो, फ्ही लूण कन्नै लसन, ते अखीर च मिर्च पाउडर रलाओ.
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar, first pound the seeds, then the garlic with salt, and at the end mix in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: इक चुटकी थोढ़े चौलें ते घ्यो कन्नै चक्खो, ते लोड़ होऐ तां लूण पाओ.
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: पोडि गी 10 मिंटें आस्तै इक थाली च फलाओ तां जे भाप निकली जा, फ्ही इक साफ, सुक्के मर्तबान च भरो.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so that steam escapes, then fill it into a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: तेजा बड़ा तिक्खा ऐ; हल्के पोडि आस्तै अद्धा सन्नम बरतो, जां उन्ने गै लसन आस्तै मिर्च पाउडर घट्ट करियै 3 बड्डे चमचे करी देओ.
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a mild podi use half Sannam, or for the same garlic reduce the chilli powder to 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: लसन गी चंगी चाल्ली सुकाओ ते तेलै च गर्म करो; गिल्ला लसन पोडि गी झट्ट खराब करी दिंदा ऐ.
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic spoils the podi quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा चलाओ, मिक्सर लगातार नेईं चलाओ: मता चिर चलाओ तां लसन पेस्ट बनी जंदा ऐ.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Pulse a little at a time, do not run the mixer continuously: run it long and the garlic becomes paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: इक कप गर्म चौलें च 1 निक्का चमचा पोडि 1 निक्के चमचे घ्यो कन्नै रलाओ; सुआद मताबक घट्ट-बद्ध करो.
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 teaspoon podi with 1 teaspoon ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust as per taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: दालें कन्नै: मेवे आह्ले, थोढ़े हल्के पोडि आस्तै बीजें कन्नै 1 बड्डा चमचा छोलें दी दाल ते 1 बड्डा चमचा माह् दी दाल बिना तेलै दे भुन्नो.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dals: for a nutty, slightly milder podi dry-roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal without oil along with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: कच्चा लसन: होर तेज़ सुआद आस्तै लसन गर्म नेईं करो, ते इक हफ्ते दे अंदर खाई लैओ.
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper flavour do not warm the garlic, and eat within a week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: दरम्यानी तिखास: 2 बड्डे चमचे तेजा ते 2 बड्डे चमचे सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर बरतो.
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: use 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: गर्म चौलें दी पैह्ली मुट्ठी च घ्यो कन्नै रलाओ, जां इडली, डोसा जां पेसरट्टु पर थोढ़े तेलै जां घ्यो कन्नै छिड़को.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix with ghee into the first handful of hot rice, or sprinkle on idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: इक साफ, सुक्के, हवाबंद मर्तबान च कमरे दे तापमान पर तकरीबन 2 हफ्ते, जां फ्रिज च इक म्हीना रक्खो. हमेशां सुक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge a month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: धनिया ते जीरा भुन्नो, पीसो, मिर्च पाउडर ते लूण पाओ, फ्ही छिल्लियां दियां लसन दियां तुरियां पाइयै थोढ़ा-थोढ़ा चलाइयै मोटा, गिल्ला पाउडर बनाओ. आंध्र दे घर अक्सर इसी पत्थरै दी कुंडी च कुट्टदे न.
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast coriander and cumin, grind, add chilli powder and salt, then add peeled garlic cloves and pulse a little at a time to make a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: लसन पोडि गी घट्ट तिक्खा कि'यां बनाचै?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How to make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: अद्धे तेजा दी थाह्र अद्धा सन्नम मिर्च पाउडर बरतो, जां कुल मिलाइयै 3 बड्डे चमचे मिर्च पाउडर बरतो. मते घ्यो कन्नै खाने कन्नै बी तिखास घट्ट होई जंदी ऐ.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: In place of half the Teja use half Sannam chilli powder, or use 3 tablespoons chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also reduces the heat.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम किन्ना चिर टिकदा ऐ?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How long does velluli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: सुक्के, हवाबंद मर्तबान च कमरे दे तापमान पर तकरीबन 2 हफ्ते, जां फ्रिज च इक म्हीना. लसन गी चंगी चाल्ली सुकाओ ते पैह्लें तेलै च गर्म करो तां जे मता चिर टिकै.
seg.a620f29950c0.back: About 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and first warm it in oil so that it keeps long.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: के अ'ऊं मिर्च पाउडर दी थाह्र साबत सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां बरती सकनां?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can I use whole dry red chillies in place of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: हां. तकरीबन 20 सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां तेलै दियां किश बूंदां पाइयै कुरकुरियां होने तगर भुन्नो, ठंडी करो ते लसन पाने शा पैह्लें पीसी लैओ.
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.a2202c094baa.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం · वेल्लुल्लि कारम दी रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. आंध्र दा लसन-मिर्च पोडि: भुन्ने दे धनिये ते जीरे गी लसन, लूण ते तेजा मिर्च पाउडर कन्नै कुट्टेआ दा. गर्म चौलें ते घ्यो, जां इडली ते डोसे कन्नै रलाओ.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic-chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or with idli and dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम: 1acrefarms दा रेसिपी कार्ड, सामान ते तरीके कन्नै
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Velluli Karam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.2b0c8026598d.back: Tamarind the size of 1 small marble (optional)

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: चिकन पर दई, तेजा मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर ते लूण मलो. 30 मिंट रक्खी देओ. बर्तन ढक्की देओ ते जिन्ना चिर एह् रक्खेआ रौह्ग, उन्ना चिर इसगी फ्रिज च रक्खो.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt on the chicken. Let it rest 30 minutes. Cover the vessel and for as long as it stays resting, keep it in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g मच्छी दे टुकड़े ⟦1⟧सख्त मच्छी, मोटे गोल टुकड़ें च कट्टी दी: रोहू, कतला (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (मरल) जां सुरमई (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish, cut into thick round pieces: rohu, catla (boccha), koramenu (murrel) or surmai (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g इमली ⟦1⟧निंबू जिन्नियां तकरीबन दो गोलियां, 2 कप कोसे पानी च 15 मिंट भिज्जियां दियां⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups warm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: बची दी करी ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. पैन च हौली-हौली, बिना हलाए, गर्म करो, जिच्चर एह् अंदर तगर पूरी चाल्ली भाप छोड़दी गर्म नेईं होई जंदी.
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftover curry, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat slowly in a pan, without stirring, until it is fully steaming hot all the way inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: दरेआ जां समुंदर दी सख्त मच्छी, मोटे टुकड़ें च कट्टी दी: रोहू, कतला (बोच्चा), मरल (कोरमीनु) जां सुरमई. कंडें आह्लियां निक्कियां मच्छियां बी चली जंदियां न पर उनेंगी हौली हत्थें बरतना पौंदा ऐ.
seg.379b410c6994.back: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, catla (boccha), murrel (koramenu) or surmai. Small bony fish also work, but must be handled gently.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: बची दी करी ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. पुलुसु गी पैन च थोढ़ा पानी पाइयै गर्म करो, जिच्चर एह् अंदर तगर पूरी चाल्ली भाप छोड़दा गर्म नेईं होई जंदा.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftover curry, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan adding a little water, until it is fully steaming hot all the way inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g बिना हड्डी दे मटन गी मसाले ते ½ कप पानी कन्नै 5–6 सीटियां लाइयै, नर्म होने तगर, प्रेशर कुकर च पकाओ, फ्ही इस्सै चाल्ली तलो.
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: दोऐ चलदे न. बिना हड्डी दा झट्ट पकदा ऐ ते होर कुरकुरा होंदा ऐ; हड्डी आह्ले निक्के टुकड़ें च सुआद मता होंदा ऐ पर उनेंगी अपने रस च 6–8 मिंट होर लगदे न.
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and gets crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 more minutes in their own juices.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: लंच बॉक्स जां निक्के सफर आस्तै पैक करो ते तकरीबन 4 घैंटें दे अंदर खाई लैओ. बचे दे चौल ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते इक दिनै दे अंदर खाई लैओ.
seg.d20a641bec03.back: Pack for a lunch box or short journey and eat within about 4 hours. Cover the leftover rice, keep in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: जां तां निंबू दा रस पकाया गेआ, जां हल्दी तेलै च सड़ी गेई. हल्दी सारें शा अखीर च पाओ, उसदे फौरन बाद चुल्हा बंद करो ते सिर्फ 5–10 सकिंट हलाओ; निंबू दा रस अग्ग शा लाहियै चौलें च पाओ.
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add turmeric at the very end, switch off the stove right after and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice off the heat.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: बचेआ दा इक कप पानी इक भारी थल्ले आह्ले पैन च पाओ; पतले पैन च रागी थल्ले लग्गी जंदी ऐ.
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the remaining one cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; in a thin pan the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: के अ'ऊं रागी जावा च गन्ने दा गुड़ बरती सकनां?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can I use sugarcane jaggery in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: हां. उन्ना गै कद्दूकस कीते दा गन्ने दा गुड़ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) लैओ ते चुल्हा बंद करने दे बाद रलाओ, तां जे दुद्ध नेईं फटै. एह् हल्का रंग ते हल्की, कैरामेल आह्ली मिठास दिंदा ऐ.
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not curdle. It gives a lighter colour and a soft, caramel-like sweetness.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: बची दी करी ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 1 दिनै दे अंदर खाई लैओ. पैन च बस उन्ना चिर गर्म करो जिच्चर एह् अंदर तगर पूरी चाल्ली भाप छोड़दी गर्म नेईं होई जंदी; मता चिर गर्म करने कन्नै झींगे सख्त होई जंदे न.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftover curry, keep in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan just as long as it takes to become fully steaming hot all the way inside; heating too long makes the prawns tough.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: के अ'ऊं गन्ने दे गुड़ कन्नै सुन्नुंडलु बनाई सकनां?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can I make sunnundalu with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: हां. गन्ने दा गुड़ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) बारीक कद्दूकस करो ते ताड़ दे गुड़ जिन्ना गै बरतो. लड्डुएं दा रंग हल्का होई जंदा ऐ, ते मिठास हल्की, कैरामेल आह्ली होंदी ऐ.
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Finely grate sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus come out lighter in colour, and the sweetness is soft, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: कच्चा लसन: होर तेज़ सुआद आस्तै लसन गर्म नेईं करो; इसगी फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 3 दिनें दे अंदर खाई लैओ.
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste skip heating the garlic; keep it in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: इक साफ, सुक्के, हवाबंद मर्तबान च फ्रिज च रक्खो ते 2 हफ्तें दे अंदर बरती लैओ. हमेशां सुक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use up within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: सुक्के, हवाबंद मर्तबान च फ्रिज च 2 हफ्तें तगर. लसन गी चंगी चाल्ली सुकाओ ते पैह्लें तेलै च गर्म करो, ते हमेशां सुक्का चमचा बरतो.
seg.367798df40e3.back: In a dry, airtight jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Dry the garlic well and heat it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: हां. तकरीबन 20 सुक्कियां लाल मिर्चां तेलै दियां किश बूंदां च कुरकुरियां होने तगर भुन्नो, ठंडी करो ते लसन पाने शा पैह्लें पीसी लैओ.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.c473a3556357.t: आंध्र दी मिठाई · 2 जनें आस्तै · 10 मिंट

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु ⟦1⟧(ताड़ दे गुड़ आह्ला मिट्ठा पोहा)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet poha with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु तेलुगु घरें दी 10 मिंटें दी मिठाई ऐ. एह् ओह् पोहा ऐ जेह्ड़ा कृष्णाष्टमी पर कृष्ण गी चढ़ाया जंदा ऐ, कुचेल दे तोह्फे दी याद च, ते स्कूलै परैंत्त बच्चें आस्तै झट-पट मिठाई बी. पोहे गी सिर्फ धोता जंदा ऐ, पानी च कदें बी नेईं पकाया जंदा, ते फ्ही कोसी गुड़ दी चाशनी च रलाया जंदा ऐ.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. This poha is offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, in remembrance of Kuchela's gift; and also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only washed, never cooked in water, and then mixed into lukewarm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: साढ़ा ताटि बेल्लम ताड़ दा गुड़ इसी गूढ़ा भूरा रंग ते भरपूर सुआद आह्ली, हल्की धूंएं आह्ली झलक कन्नै मिठास दिंदा ऐ. एह् रेसिपी 2 जनें आस्तै ऐ.
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our Tati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a full-flavoured, slightly smoke-like sweetness. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: त्यारी च धोते दे पोहे दे नरम होने आस्तै 5 मिंट शामल न.
seg.25e28614accb.back: Prep includes 5 minutes for the washed poha to soften.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: मोटे पोहे गी नरम करो, नारियल ते लाची कन्नै कोसी ताड़ दे गुड़ दी चाशनी च रलाओ, ते अखीर च घ्यो पाओ.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Soften the thick poha, mix into lukewarm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and add ghee at the end.

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ कप कद्दूकस कीता दा ताड़ दा गुड़ ⟦1⟧तकरीबन 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ कप कद्दूकस कीता दा नारियल ⟦1⟧सिर्फ चिट्टा हिस्सा⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ निक्का चमचा लाची पाउडर ⟦1⟧जां 2–3 लाचियें दे कुट्टे दे दाने⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ teaspoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.5f1854fd1277.t: 6–8 काजू, मर्जी मताबक ⟦1⟧घ्यो च सुनैह्री तले दे⟦/1⟧
seg.5f1854fd1277.back: 6–8 cashews, as per wish ⟦1⟧fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: पोहे गी छाननी च पाओ ते भूसे दे टुकड़े चुगियै कड्डी देओ.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out the husk pieces.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: पोहे गी छाननी च चलदे पानी हेठ किश सकिंट धोओ, पानी निचड़न देओ, ते नरम होने आस्तै 5 मिंट छोड़ी देओ. दबाने पर एह् नरम लग्गै, पर गिल्ला नेईं.
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Wash the poha in the sieve under running water for a few seconds, let the water drain, and leave 5 minutes to soften. When pressed they should feel soft, but not wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: ताड़ दे गुड़ गी बारीक कद्दूकस करो, सख्त डलियां तोड़दे होई.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking hard lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: ताड़ दे गुड़ गी 2 बड्डे चमचे पानी कन्नै मट्ठी अग्गी पर पघलाओ, फ्ही छानी लैओ. पैन पूंझियै चाशनी फ्ही उस च पाओ.
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tablespoons of water on low flame, then strain. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: जेकर काजू पा करदे ओ, तां उनेंगी थोढ़े घ्यो च सुनैह्री होने तगर तलो.
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If using cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: कोसी चाशनी च पोहा, नारियल ते लाची पाओ ते मट्ठी अग्गी पर 1–2 मिंट हौली-हौली रलाओ, जिच्चर हर दाने पर चाशनी नेईं चढ़ी जंदी. हल्के हत्थै कन्नै करो तां जे दाने नेईं टुट्टन.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the lukewarm syrup and gently mix on low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated with syrup. Work with a light hand so the flakes do not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: जि'यां गै दानें पर चाशनी चढ़ी जा, उस्सै बेल्लै पैन अग्गी परा तुआरी लैओ; बद्ध पकाने कन्नै एह् चिम्मड़ होई जंदे न.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the flakes are coated with syrup, take the pan off the flame immediately; cooking longer makes them chewy.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: घ्यो ते काजू पाइयै पूरा करो. गर्म जां कमरे दे तापमान पर परोसो.
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: Finish by adding ghee and cashews. Serve warm/hot or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: मोटा पोहा बरतो. पतला पोहा चाशनी च लेई बनी जंदा ऐ.
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: पोहे गी कटोरी भर पानी च नेईं भिगोओ; झट धोना काफी ऐ, नेईं तां एह् बद्ध नरम ते चिपचिपा होई जंदा ऐ.
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not soak the poha in a bowlful of water; a quick wash is enough, otherwise it becomes too soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: पोहा पांदे बेल्लै चाशनी कोसी रक्खो, उबलदी नेईं, तां जे दानें पर इक बरोबर चाशनी चढ़ै.
seg.972f174730fe.back: Keep the syrup lukewarm, not boiling, when adding the poha, so that every flake gets coated evenly with syrup.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: दुद्धै कन्नै: होर नरम मिठाई आस्तै त्यार पोहे पर 2–3 बड्डे चमचे कोसा दुद्ध पाओ.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: for a softer sweet, add 2–3 tablespoons of lukewarm milk on the ready poha.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: तिलें कन्नै: नारियल कन्नै गै 1 बड्डा चमचा भुन्ने दे तिल पाओ.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 tablespoon of roasted sesame along with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: कृष्णाष्टमी पर नैवेद्य दे रूप च परोसो, जां स्कूलै परैंत्त बच्चें गी झट-पट मिठाई दे रूप च देओ.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or give to children after school as a quick sweet.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: जिस दिन बनै उस्सै दिन खाना सबनें शा बधिया. बचे दे गी ढक्कियै फ्रिज च रक्खो ते अगले दिन खाई लैओ; पेदा रेहने कन्नै पोहा सख्त होई जंदा ऐ.
